- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Knowledge of critical data center or mission critical mechanical and electrical equipment and hands-on experience trouble-shooting mechanical components and systems
- 6+ years of experience developing Mechanical and/or Mechanical Cooling Products and launching them into production
- 6+ years of project experience with cooling systems or components
- Experience with Product Lifecycle Management and related systems

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Ability to design for manufacturability, create assembly specifications and work with contract manufacturers and OEMs

title: Learning Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
Als Learning Coordinator gehörst du zu dem Team, das für die Schulung der Mitarbeiter:innen an unseren Logistikstandorten verantwortlich ist.
Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeiter:innen die erforderlichen Fähigkeiten erwerben, um ihre täglichen Aufgaben unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Produktivitätsstandards ausführen.
Du bist die Ansprechperson für die operativen Teams vor Ort und verfolgst den Einarbeitungsprozess unserer neuen Mitarbeiter:innen, um sie zu unterstützen.
Du arbeitest mit mehreren Support-Teams zusammen, um Schulungsunterlagen zu aktualisieren, Prozessänderungen umzusetzen und deren Einführung an den Standorten sicherzustellen. Es wird empfohlen einen gültigen Führerschein zu haben.

Key job responsibilities
• Organisation von Erst- und Auffrischungsschulungen, um unsere Leistungsindikatoren zu erfüllen
• Aufzeichnung aller Schulungen und Bewertung der Kompetenzverteilung
• Überwachung der Kompetenzentwicklung unserer Mitarbeiter:innen durch Schulungen in verschiedenen Aufgabenbereichen, um sie auf die Peak-Season vorzubereiten
• Training der Kolleg:innen, welche die Einarbeitung vor Ort durchführen und neuen Mitarbeiter:innen ihre Station sowie die Prozesse näherbringen
• Überprüfung von Dashboards, Überwachung von Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs), Analyse von Ursachen und Einleitung von Korrekturmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Abteilungen (Stakeholder)
• Verantwortung für ca. 3 Lieferstationen (DS) in deinem Gebiet mit regelmäßigen Reisen zwischen den Delivery Stations

A day in the life
Du wirst eine wichtige Rolle bei der Leistungsverbesserung und beim Onboarding neuer Mitarbeiter:innen durch Schulungen spielen, die du in unseren Delivery Stations durchführen wirst. Die Rolle des Learning Coordinators besteht auch darin, den täglichen Fortschritt der Delivery Stations und die Einhaltung der Amazon-Standardarbeitsverfahren und -ziele zu verfolgen.

About the team
Als Teil des Amazon-Customer-Excellence-System (ACES) Teams arbeiten wir an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Logistik bei Amazon. Wir betreuen High-Impact-Initiativen und helfen bei der Entwicklung, Einführung und Beaufsichtigung verschiedener Logistikprojekte. Jüngste Beispiele sind unter anderem die Einführung und Erweiterung von Lieferungen mit mikromobilen Fahrzeugen (mit E-Lastenrädern oder zu Fuß) in ganz Europa sowie Lieferungen per Elektrofahrzeug. Mithilfe von datengestützten Tools erkennen wir, wie wir Prozesse verbessern oder effizienter machen und die im ganzen Unternehmen entstehenden Abfallmengen reduzieren können.
Unser Team unterstützt die Einführung neuer Programme und technologiebasierter Lösungen vor Ort in ganz Europa. Die Programme helfen bei der Erfüllung der Kundennachfrage und der Förderung kundenorientierter Innovationen. Wir setzen außerdem die anspruchsvollen Standards für unsere Schulungsteams und gestalten das Onboarding-Erlebnis für Partnerfirmen, Lieferpartner und Manager:innen so ansprechend wie möglich.
Im ACES-Team gibt es zahlreiche Möglichkeiten. Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten sind jederzeit willkommen. Wir sind in einem Netzwerk von insgesamt über 200 Logistikstandorten tätig und stellen sicher, dass vom Onboarding bis hin zu den Liefermethoden alles so effektiv wie möglich abläuft. Zweck unserer Arbeit ist es letztendlich, Amazon zu einer sicheren und angenehmen Umgebung für unsere Mitarbeitenden zu machen und jederzeit pünktliche Lieferungen zu gewährleisten.

- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse (C1 gemeinsamer europäischer Referenzrahmen, CEFR)
- Gute Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift (B2)
- Relevante Erfahrung im Bereich klarer Kommunikation, einschließlich nachweisbarer Durchführung von Schulungen und Erstellung entsprechender Kommunikations- und Schulungsmaterialien

title: Program Manager, eDiscovery and Legal Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Legal Operations organization is looking for a Program Manager to lead eDiscovery program delivery at a global scale. In this role, you will own the technology roadmap for eDiscovery, drive cross-functional programs across engineering, legal, and vendor teams, and stand up AI-powered capabilities that transform how Amazon manages litigation support. You will report to the Head of eDiscovery and lead programs spanning the full eDiscovery lifecycle—from data collection through production—while building the systems and vendor partnerships that reduce cost and accelerate outcomes.

The Legal Operations team is data-driven and systems-oriented— we measure what matters, automate what we can, and build for scale. This role requires someone who can troubleshoot an eDiscovery escalation, run an AI pilot, negotiate a vendor SOW, and present results to VP-level stakeholders in the same week. You will operate with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, working across engineering, legal, and vendor teams to deliver without direct authority over resources. This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.


Key job responsibilities
- Program Ownership & Delivery: Own the eDiscovery Transformation Program end-to-end: define the roadmap, set milestones, manage cross-team dependencies, proactively identify risks, and drive resolution or escalation with appropriate judgment. Define success metrics for program initiatives and build reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into matter health, vendor performance, and operational efficiency.

- Technology & Architecture: Define technical requirements and drive design reviews for vendor integrations, data pipelines, and system interoperability between eDiscovery platforms and internal tools. Collaborate with IT, Security, and Microsoft 365/Purview teams on legal hold automation, custodian data collection, and preservation workflows. Drive process automation by identifying opportunities to eliminate manual steps through scripting, API orchestration, or platform configuration.

- AI & Tool Strategy: Lead the evaluation, piloting, and procurement of AI-powered tools (TAR, generative AI, NLP classification) for document review and legal analytics—defining evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and defensibility standards, and building business cases that quantify ROI.

- Vendor & Standards: Own the vendor strategy: manage the preferred partner program, drive RFP processes, negotiate rate cards and SLAs, conduct performance reviews, and define quality standards for ESI processing, review, and production workflows.

- Stakeholder Alignment & Communication: Drive alignment across legal, engineering, and vendor stakeholders with competing priorities; author program narratives and business cases for senior leadership. Mentor team members and contribute to hiring, interview processes, and talent development within the organization.


A day in the life
Your morning might be a program review for a vendor API integration you're managing. By mid-morning you're configuring an AI pilot—tuning recall thresholds on a document review model. After lunch you're drafting a business case for a platform migration, pulling cost and throughput data into a narrative for senior leadership. Late afternoon, a legal hold workflow breaks and you're coordinating the fix across IT and compliance before a preservation deadline. No two days look the same—some weeks are technical delivery, others are vendor negotiations and program roadmaps. You connect the technical reality to the business outcome, and you own both.


About the team
Legal Operations enables Amazon Legal to operate with maximum efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness through world-class operational support and technology solutions. Our programs include:
- Outside Counsel Management: Building long-term relationships with outside counsel and preferred law firms, including pricing negotiations, budget management, value-added services utilization, diversity tracking, billing, onboarding, and conflict waiver reviews.
- eDiscovery: Providing technology-enabled discovery services leveraging AI and advanced analytics for litigation and investigation matters.
- Paralegal & Litigation Program Management: Delivering paralegal support and program management expertise to litigation teams.
- Legal Infrastructure: Supporting technology infrastructure, systems, and processes including knowledge management, communications, attorney licensing, records management, and CLE programs.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- 5+ years of eDiscovery program management experience including end-to-end ownership
- Experience with eDiscovery platforms (Relativity, RelativityOne, Nuix, or equivalent) and the EDRM lifecycle

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating with customers, technical, regulatory, business teams, and management to collect requirements, describe product features, and technical designs
- Experience designing or managing system integrations, data pipelines, or platform migrations
- Experience building programs from scratch in ambiguous environments with minimal precedent
- Hands-on experience evaluating or deploying AI/ML tools in a legal or compliance context—TAR, predictive coding, NLP classification, or generative AI

title: Principal AI Security SA, AWS Security & Networking
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal AI Security Solutions Architect to define and drive technical strategy for secure AI adoption and AI-enabled security outcomes across North America. You will work with CISOs, Chief AI Officers, security leaders, enterprise architects, and builders as they move generative AI and agentic systems into production.

Customers need security architectures that support the speed and autonomy of AI systems while preserving control over identities, data, permissions, software supply chains, and runtime actions. Security organizations are also evaluating how AI can improve detection, investigation, vulnerability prioritization, remediation, and analyst productivity. You will help customers make sound decisions across both areas, define measurable outcomes, and carry the lessons from individual engagements into guidance that serves the broader field.

You will operate across organizational boundaries and in areas where the business objective, technology strategy, and solution design remain ambiguous. You will align account teams, security and AI specialists, service teams, partners, and field communities around a coherent technical direction. Your work will produce reference architectures, decision frameworks, assessments, customer offerings, and operating mechanisms that other Solutions Architects can apply consistently.

This is a customer-facing Principal Solutions Architect role. Success requires the ability to move between executive strategy and deep architecture, influence product and field priorities with customer evidence, and build mechanisms that continue producing results without direct involvement from the role holder.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year technical strategy for Security AI across the AGS Security & Networking SA Team, including priorities, architectural positions, field mechanisms, success measures, and cross-organization dependencies.
- Advise senior customer leaders on security strategy for AI adoption, translating business goals and risk tolerance into clear architecture decisions, governance models, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
- Lead significantly complex customer engagements involving generative AI and agentic systems, including agent identity, least privilege, data protection, prompt and context risks, retrieval security, memory, tool and connector access, software supply chain risk, adversarial testing, runtime monitoring, incident response, and auditability.
- Define architectures for applying AI to security workflows such as detection, triage, investigation, vulnerability prioritization, security posture analysis, remediation, and control validation. Establish evaluation criteria for accuracy, safety, explainability, human oversight, and operational impact.
- Turn recurring customer problems into repeatable field mechanisms, including reference architectures, decision frameworks, assessments, workshops, reusable demonstrations, implementation guidance, engagement qualification, and escalation paths.
- Establish outcome measures that connect technical work to reduced risk, faster secure deployment, improved detection or response, customer adoption, field reuse, and product improvement. Use these measures to adjust strategy and resource focus.
- Build durable working relationships across AWS security and AI service teams, AGS field organizations, the Security and AI/ML Technical Field Communities, account teams, Professional Services, Support, and AWS Partners.
- Gather evidence across customers and use it to influence product strategy, roadmap priorities, service integration, documentation, and field investment. Represent customer requirements in product narratives and senior leadership reviews.
- Create executive and technical narratives that give customers and AWS teams a clear point of view on secure AI adoption and AI-enabled security. Represent AWS in customer forums and industry events where deep technical judgment is required.
- Develop Principal-level technical capability across the SA community through mentoring, architecture reviews, content standards, technical assessments, and communities of practice.
- Identify emerging security risks and capability gaps early, determine which require customer guidance, field education, partner engagement, or product investment, and lead the right organizations toward resolution.
- Serve as an escalation point for high-impact customer decisions where AI architecture, security risk, business priorities, and multiple AWS organizations intersect.

A day in the life
A day may begin with a CISO and Chief AI Officer working session on the control model for production agents that can access sensitive data and take actions through external tools. You may then review a proposed reference architecture with security and AI service teams, resolve conflicting design assumptions, and document the decision criteria for field use.

Later, you may examine results from customer engagements to identify a recurring gap in agent identity, AI workload detection, or AI-assisted investigation. You will decide whether the right response is a customer offering, a reusable architecture, a field enablement mechanism, a partner pattern, or product feedback. You may close the day mentoring a Principal candidate, reviewing an executive narrative, or presenting a data-backed investment recommendation to Directors and VPs.

About the team
The AGS Security & Networking SA Team is part of AWS Customer Solutions & Scale Innovation within AGS NAMER Tech. The team includes Solutions Architects across the United States and Canada who help customers connect and operate applications securely and resiliently on AWS.

Our mission is to accelerate customers' confidence in the cloud through secure and well-connected operations. We work directly with customers, account teams, service teams, and partners to solve complex security and networking problems, create reusable guidance, and turn field evidence into improvements across AWS. The team's 2026 AI security goal covers both security for AI and AI for security, with an emphasis on opinionated guidance, direct customer work, and mechanisms that scale beyond one contributor.

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Experience in one or more of the following: application security frameworks, security code reviews, incident response, security infrastructure, penetration testing, mobile security, cloud security, AI security, identity and access controls

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Customer Service Finance
descriptionHtml:
Senior Finance Analyst — Customer Service Finance (CSF) — Hyderabad work from office


Role Summary

Function: Finance
Team: Worldwide Customer Service Finance (CSF)
Role: Senior Finance Analyst
Reports to: Finance Manager, Customer Service Finance
Experience: 3+ years of relevant business finance, accounting, FP&A, controllership and analytical experience
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — Mandatory


About Amazon Finance

Finance at Amazon is about much more than numbers. It is about understanding the story behind the data, challenging assumptions, identifying risks and opportunities, and partnering with business leaders to make informed, timely decisions.

Our Finance teams work closely with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and other cross-functional organizations. Finance professionals serve as trusted business advisors, combining financial expertise, data-driven analysis, business judgment, and strong communication skills to influence decisions and improve business outcomes.

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded, and proactive Chartered Accountant to join the Worldwide Customer Service Finance (CSF) team. The ideal candidate will bring strong controllership fundamentals along with experience in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, process improvement, automation, and stakeholder management.


About Customer Service Finance

Customer Service Finance (CSF) is a strategic finance partner to one of the world's largest Customer Service organizations. The team supports business leaders through financial analysis, controllership, planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.

Working across geographies and functions, CSF partners with Customer Service Operations, Retail, Technology, HR, and other Finance teams to optimize costs while maintaining and improving customer experience.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Chartered Accountant who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment and wants to operate as a strategic finance partner rather than focus solely on traditional accounting activities.



Role Overview

The Finance Analyst will support the Customer Service organization across financial controllership, planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis.

The role will serve as the financial owner and trusted advisor for assigned sites or business areas. This includes partnering closely with operational leadership to understand business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive actions that improve financial outcomes.

The successful candidate will go beyond reporting historical results to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken.


Key areas of responsibility include:

Financial controllership
Month-end close and reporting
Forecasting and financial planning
Variance and root-cause analysis
Financial modeling
KPI and metrics analysis
Business partnering
Cost optimization and productivity
Process improvement and automation
Data analytics and reporting
Risk and opportunity management
Management reporting

Key Responsibilities


1. Financial Controllership

Own controllership activities for assigned Customer Service sites or business areas.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes.
Prepare and review monthly financial metrics and management reports.
Ensure financial information is accurate, complete, timely, and aligned with accounting and controllership standards.
Analyze performance against plan, forecast, and prior periods.
Identify financial risks, anomalies, and control gaps and drive corrective actions.
Partner with Accounting and business teams to resolve discrepancies.
Establish and maintain effective financial controls and mechanisms.

2. Financial Planning & Forecasting

Support annual operating plans, budgets, and periodic forecasting cycles.
Develop financial models for business planning and investment decisions.
Analyze actuals against budget, forecast, and prior-year performance.
Identify key drivers of financial movements and communicate them clearly to leadership.
Develop forward-looking views of business performance.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
Assess the financial impact of operational initiatives, investments, and cost-saving opportunities.

3. Variance Analysis & Business Insights

Conduct detailed variance analysis across costs, headcount, productivity, and other financial and operational KPIs.
Identify the underlying business drivers behind financial performance.
Perform deep dives to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes.
Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management.
Challenge assumptions and proactively highlight areas requiring management attention.

4. Business Partnering

Act as a trusted financial advisor to Customer Service Operations and site leadership.
Partner with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and Finance teams.
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decisions through data and financial insights.
Understand operational processes and connect business drivers with financial outcomes.
Provide timely financial guidance to business leaders.
Help stakeholders understand the financial implications of their decisions.
Constructively challenge assumptions and recommend alternative solutions where appropriate.

5. "CFO of Your Sites" Ownership

For assigned sites or business areas, operate as the CFO of the site, taking end-to-end ownership of financial performance.

This includes:

Owning the financial performance narrative.
Partnering directly with site leadership.
Understanding the operational drivers of financial performance.
Identifying and quantifying risks and opportunities.
Tracking financial actions through completion.
Establishing effective finance mechanisms.
Driving accountability for financial performance.
Ensuring leadership has timely and accurate financial information.
Recommending actions that improve both cost efficiency and customer experience.

6. Cost Optimization & Productivity

Identify opportunities to reduce costs while maintaining or improving customer experience.
Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers and productivity metrics.
Evaluate the financial impact of operational and process changes.
Develop business cases for cost-reduction and productivity initiatives.
Track benefits realization and ensure savings are measurable.
Benchmark performance and identify opportunities for standardization and scalability.

7. Data Analytics & Reporting

Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data.
Build recurring reports, dashboards, and financial metrics.
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities through data analysis.
Develop automated reporting solutions to reduce manual effort.
Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract and transform data.
Partner with Data and Technology teams to improve data quality and accessibility.
Ensure reporting is consistent, scalable, and aligned with stakeholder needs.

8. Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve Finance processes.
Eliminate unnecessary manual activities and reduce reporting complexity.
Design scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple sites or businesses.
Lead automation initiatives that improve accuracy, efficiency, and controllership.
Standardize financial reporting and business mechanisms where appropriate.
Measure and communicate the impact of process improvements.
Challenge existing mechanisms and develop better solutions as business needs evolve.

9. Reconciliation & Financial Systems

Reconcile financial reports across businesses, systems, and reporting sources.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial and operational data.
Work with financial systems such as Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards, Essbase, Cognos, or similar platforms.
Maintain data integrity across reporting mechanisms.
Identify recurring reconciliation issues and implement sustainable solutions.
Support system and process changes that affect financial reporting.

10. Management Reporting & Communication

Prepare regular financial reviews and business performance updates.
Present results, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Communicate financial concepts clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
Develop concise narratives explaining key financial and business movements.
Ensure leaders understand both the numbers and the underlying business drivers.
Influence decisions through fact-based analysis and strong financial judgment.

Key Performance Indicators

The role may involve analyzing and reporting on metrics such as:

Actual vs. Budget and Actual vs. Forecast
Month-over-month and year-over-year performance
Operating expenses and cost per contact/transaction
Cost per customer interaction
Headcount and labor costs
Productivity and capacity utilization
Staffing efficiency
Forecast accuracy
Financial controllership metrics
Cost savings and productivity benefits
Process efficiency
Customer-experience-related financial metrics

Basic Qualifications

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — mandatory.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
3+ years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controllership, financial analysis, FP&A, business finance, or a related analytical role.
Strong understanding of accounting and financial principles.
Proven experience in financial analysis, variance analysis, forecasting, and management reporting.
Experience working with financial KPIs and business performance metrics.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, financial modeling, and data analysis.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA, Master's degree in Finance, or equivalent advanced qualification.
Experience in a multinational, technology, e-commerce, shared-services, or high-growth environment.
Experience with SQL and large-scale data analysis.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with Oracle, SAP, Essbase, Cognos, JD Edwards, Lawson, MS Access, or other financial/reporting systems.
Experience in financial controllership and month-end close.
Experience in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning.
Experience leading process improvement or Finance automation initiatives.
Experience working with large datasets and developing automated reporting solutions.
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or process re-engineering.
CPA, MBA, or equivalent professional qualification in addition to CA is an advantage.

Core Competencies

Financial Acumen

Strong accounting and finance fundamentals.
Ability to understand financial statements and business drivers.
Strong financial modeling and forecasting capabilities.

Analytical Thinking

Ability to analyze complex datasets.
Strong root-cause analysis skills.
Ability to distinguish meaningful insights from low-value details.

Business Judgment

Understands the commercial and operational implications of financial decisions.
Balances cost, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

Stakeholder Management

Comfortable working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
Able to influence without direct authority.
Builds credibility as a trusted Finance partner.

Problem Solving

Takes ownership of ambiguous and complex problems.
Uses data to identify root causes.
Develops practical, scalable solutions.

Process Improvement

Continuously seeks opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, and scale.
Demonstrates measurable impact from improvement initiatives.

Communication

Converts complex financial analysis into clear and compelling business narratives.
Confidently presents findings and recommendations to senior leadership.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant who combines strong accounting fundamentals with commercial awareness and analytical thinking.

The ideal candidate:

Thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Independently owns financial deliverables from data gathering through executive communication.
Has strong controllership and financial analysis experience.
Understands how operational decisions translate into financial outcomes.
Is comfortable working with large datasets and financial systems.
Uses data to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
Demonstrates strong ownership and a bias for action.
Can simplify complex financial problems.
Enjoys collaborating across functions and geographies.
Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
Has a continuous-improvement mindset.
Communicates effectively with both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.
Wants to grow into a strategic business partner rather than remain focused solely on traditional accounting.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

Financial reporting is accurate, timely, and well controlled.
Forecasts and financial plans are reliable and supported by clear assumptions.
Leadership has clear visibility into financial risks and opportunities.
Variances are understood at their root cause rather than simply reported.
Finance insights translate into measurable business decisions and outcomes.
Cost-reduction and productivity opportunities are proactively identified and delivered.
Finance processes become increasingly automated, scalable, and efficient.
Manual reporting and reconciliation activities are reduced.
Site and business leaders view Finance as a trusted strategic partner.
Financial risks and opportunities are identified early and driven through to closure.

Why Join Customer Service Finance?

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Operations, Technology, Data, and Customer Experience. As a Finance Analyst and qualified Chartered Accountant, you will have the opportunity to:

Serve as a trusted Finance advisor to a global Customer Service organization.
Work directly with senior business and operational leaders.
Influence significant business and investment decisions.
Analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets.
Build and automate Finance mechanisms.
Drive measurable cost and productivity improvements.
Gain exposure to a highly international and cross-functional environment.
Develop from a Finance specialist into a broader business leader.
Make a measurable impact on both customer experience and business performance.

Ideal Candidate at a Glance

Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — Mandatory
Experience: 3+ years of relevant finance, accounting, or analytical experience
Finance: Controllership, FP&A, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and financial modeling
Analytics: Advanced Excel; SQL preferred; Tableau/Power BI preferred
Systems: ERP/financial systems experience preferred, including Oracle, SAP, Essbase, or Cognos
Business Skills: Business partnering, stakeholder management, cost optimization
Process Skills: Automation, standardization, and continuous improvement
Communication: Strong English communication and executive presentation skills
Mindset: Analytical, curious, ownership-driven, customer-focused, and comfortable with ambiguity

Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History.

Amazon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Basic qualifications

- professional tax, accounting or legal qualification (e.g., Chartered Accountant (CA), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), Chartered Institute of Taxation (CIOT) or similar), or LL.M. (Taxation)
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results, or experience in finance role where you owned financial reporting for a business area
- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query), or experience in financial modeling
- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses, or experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions
- Experience working with stakeholders, or experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Software Dev Engineer III, AWS Elastic Beanstalk
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE3) to help build and extend the service. Elastic Beanstalk is how developers get an application running on AWS without becoming infrastructure experts — you upload your code, and we handle capacity provisioning, load balancing, auto scaling, and application health monitoring.

Our team builds the orchestration system at the center of the service: the public API, the workflow system that provisions and mutates customer environments, the health monitoring subsystem, the eventing pipeline, and the AWS Console experience. We are also in the middle of the most significant architectural expansion in the service's history — extending Elastic Beanstalk to run on Kubernetes and EKS, while continuing to support the millions of environments already running on our classic architecture. Doing both at once, without customer disruption, is a genuinely hard distributed systems problem.

If you are someone who is passionate about building high quality services, delighting developers, and reducing the distance between "I have code" and "it's running in production," this job is for you. You will be joining a small team where an SDE3 has real design ownership from day one — you will lead design and implementation efforts on services used at AWS scale, and act as a force multiplier for the engineers around you.

To learn more about AWS Elastic Beanstalk, visit https://aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/.

Key job responsibilities
Design and Development: Take ownership of designing, developing, testing, and deploying services that facilitate a seamless "build from source" experience.
Scalability and Resilience: Work on ensuring that the service runs and scales reliably and efficiently.
Collaboration: Engage with a talented and diverse team to collectively architect and implement modern products. Embrace different backgrounds, experiences, and viewpoints to foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

title: Technical Program Manager, AWS DC Community-Availability Serviceability
descriptionHtml:
At AWS, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, driven people. The team is seeking a Technical Program Manager II (TPM II) to serve as the Global Process Owner (GPO) for one of our global maintenance programs — owning the standard end-to-end, from definition through global execution and continuous improvement. You will be a highly visible owner who drives the communication, coordination, cross-organizational consensus, and execution of a multi-year program vision, and who owns the decision and unblocks the path forward when consensus cannot be reached.
Our Serviceability team owns serviceability excellence across AWS's global data center fleet. We set and maintain the preventive-maintenance (PM) standards, critical-spares strategy, and operational readiness testing programs for the electrical, controls, mechanical, and generator infrastructure that keeps AWS data centers online. We operate on a Global Process Owner (GPO) model: each Technical Program Manager owns a global program end-to-end — defining the maintenance standard, driving it through a gated review-and-approval lifecycle, and stewarding it globally across every AWS region. We turn field data into standardized, data-driven maintenance decisions that reduce risk, extend asset life, and lower cost at fleet scale.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
You'll join a diverse team of infrastructure, software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate is able to:
• Own operational relationships with support teams, internal operations business partners, and cross-organizational stakeholders to drive increased performance.

• Effectively interact and collaborate with customers, project sponsors, technical product managers, and multiple internal teams, and drive cross-organizational consensus to define and deliver complex solutions.
• Proactively recognize and drive opportunities to simplify and standardize processes across the program.
• Own the technical standard for your program and influence related technical designs.
• Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities.
• Lead the effective and efficient delivery of large, complex technical projects and programs.
• Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make tradeoffs, own the decision, and unblock the path forward when consensus cannot be reached.

• Travel up to 25%.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you will:

• Drive both the fuels and regulatory-compliance scopes through their full lifecycle — develop, execute, manage, and report.
• Own the annual goals and reporting cadence for both scopes.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Sr. Hardware Development Engineer, PCIe Manufacturing, PCIe & Signal Integrity Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS EC2 owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS server instances. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS compute, storage, accelerator servers and ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of hardware engineers, software engineers, system engineers, technical program managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
AWS Hardware Engineering is looking for a customer-obsessed, team-driven technology leader to take our engineering of server hardware and software to the next level. As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer on the PCIe and Signal Integrity team within the Core Components Organization, you will develop, deploy, qualify, and continuously improve PCIe components with vendors and at our manufacturing sites for current and next-generation servers. Your scope spans firmware readiness reviews, risk assessment, and test and fixture design through NPI test system setup, qualification builds, firmware/software provisioning, validation, Bill of Material and Engineering Change Order review, and test readiness sign-off for volume manufacturing. You will perform PCIe component and subsystem debug and root-cause failure analysis, create runbooks, train technicians and operators, and support recurring certification programs to ensure consistent quality across all sites. You analyze failure data to identify trends and recommend test systems, test processes, and design improvements that strengthen the test-to-design feedback loop. You lead PCIe hardware, firmware, and system yields and throughput improvement campaigns with manufacturing partners, vendors, and design teams, establishing metrics and tracking progress toward targets. You provide DFT recommendations and feedback on test coverage, fault isolation capability, and failure trends to continuously improve test effectiveness at scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
- 6+ years' experience in high-volume manufacturing operations, working directly with international Original Design Manufacturers, Contract Manufacturers, and component vendors across global manufacturing networks.
- 6+ years of manufacturing engineering work with server platforms, silicon, PCBA, or complex electromechanical hardware such (eg. PCIe devices and systems).
- 3+ years of end-to-end NPI participation from concept/design through mass production ramp.
- Demonstrated expertise in failure analysis, root-cause investigation, corrective/preventive action (CAPA), and statistical process control (SPC, Cpk, yield, DPMO) including development of test metrics dashboards to drive improvement decisions.
- Hands-on proficiency with lab equipment and strong analytical problem-solving and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
- 10+ years of manufacturing test experience specifically for server, networking, or data center PCBA platforms.
- 6+ years deploying, qualifying, and maintaining complex test systems in high-volume manufacturing environments, including functional tests.
- 6+ years of production ramp, yield management, and throughput optimization, including capacity planning across multiple testers and production locations; proficiency with statistical methods (SPC, Cpk, DPMO) and Lean/Six Sigma methodologies to drive improvement at scale.
- Experience qualifying and debugging high-speed interconnects, including PCIe.
- Demonstrated track record driving manufacturing documentation, assembly drawings, BOM ingestion into PLM systems, and validating producibility through DFM/DFA reviews.

title: Operations Manager für Führungskräfte mit militärischem Hintergrund (m/w/d) - standortübergreifend
descriptionHtml:
Wir setzen alles daran, einen Standort in Ihrer bevorzugten Region zu finden — deutschlandweit. Sprechen Sie uns an, und wir prüfen gemeinsam die Möglichkeiten.

Amazon leistet Pionierarbeit.

Seit dem Start unserer Online-Plattform im Jahre 1995 haben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen immer wieder neu definiert.

"We actively seek leaders, who can Invent, think big, have a bias for action, and deliver results on behalf of our customers." – Jeff Bezos

Entscheidend für eine Führungsposition in unseren Logistikzentren ist die Fähigkeit ein Team zu führen, Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter zu motivieren und zu inspirieren, sich und dem Team ambitionierte und erreichbare Ziele zu setzen und diese Ziele dann zusammen umzusetzen.

Viele Zeitsoldatinnen und -soldaten haben jahrelang solche wertvollen Erfahrungen gesammelt und Amazon bietet die Möglichkeit, diese Erfahrungen und das Wissen nun in der Wirtschaft einzubringen.

Das Military Recruiting Team von Amazon steht zur Verfügung, um die zahlreichen Möglichkeiten innerhalb von Amazon Operations zu erörtern.

Wir haben die gleichen Erwartungen an alle Führungskräfte, egal ob sie militärische Erfahrung haben oder nicht: Pionierarbeit für die Kundinnen und Kunden leisten und weiter daran arbeiten, Amazon zum kundenorientiertesten Unternehmen der Welt zu machen.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Operations Manager (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Logistikteams.

Als Operations Manager sind Sie in der Lage, Ihre Teams zu begeistern und zu unterstützen. Gleichzeitig sind Sie bereit, die Ärmel hochzukrempeln und mit anzupacken, wenn Bedarf besteht.

Sie werden die Führung eines Teams von Area Managern und deren Mitarbeitern übernehmen und gleichzeitig dem Senior Operations Manager Ihres Versandzentrums Bericht erstatten. Die Qualität Ihrer Führungsarbeit ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Position: Sie begeistern und motivieren Ihre Teams zu Bestleistungen und sorgen durch die Planung von Terminen und Aktivitäten für ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mitarbeiter- und Unternehmensanforderungen.

Ein weiterer wichtiger Bestandteil Ihrer Tätigkeit wird die Leitung von Projekten zur Prozessoptimierung sein, mit dem Ziel, alle Aktivitäten, sowohl Ihre eigenen als auch die Ihrer Teammitglieder, zu vereinfachen. Die Ideen, Innovationen und Veränderungen des Status quo, die Sie entwickeln, könnten im gesamten Amazon Netzwerk umgesetzt werden: Lassen Sie sich diese Riesenchance nicht entgehen.

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre zentralen Aufgaben werden das Management, die Kontrolle, die Organisation und Führung operativer Outbound- oder Inbound-Bereiche an Ihrem Standort sein. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

• Umsetzung von Gesundheits- und Arbeitsschutzstandards in Ihrem Aufgabenbereich sowie Förderung und Anregung einer Gesundheits- und Arbeitsschutzkultur vor Ort • Aneignung von Fachwissen über spezifische übergeordnete Prozesse und Aktivitäten innerhalb der Versandzentren, z. B. Kenntnisse zu 5S-Audits • Zeitnahe Datenerfassung durch stündliche Aktualisierung der operativen Kennzahlen in Ihrer Bestandskontroll- und Systemumgebung • Einhaltung von Produktivitätszielen, Reduzierung von Kosten pro Einheit, Vermeidung von Fehlern und Sicherstellung eines herausragenden Einkaufserlebnisses für unsere Kunden • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen (Personal, Finanzen, Anlagen, Sicherheit, IT) im Hinblick auf Personalbesetzungs- und Zeitpläne sowie Leistungsniveaus • Umsetzen von Prozessänderungen und Teilnahme an funktionsübergreifenden Six-Sigma-Maßnahmen an Ihrem Standort und dem weiteren europäischen Logistiknetzwerk von Amazon

Basic qualifications

- - Sie verfügen über eine Abschlussqualifikation einer anerkannten Einrichtung, mind. auf Bachelorniveau.
- - Sie haben bereits Erfahrung in der Leitung großer, vielseitiger Teams gesammelt.
- - Sie verfügen über hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift in fließendem Deutsch und Englisch.
- - Sie sind in mindestens zwei Bereichen der Fertigungs- oder Logistikkette fachlich kompetent und können eine beachtliche Erfolgsbilanz in einer ähnlichen dynamischen Logistik-, Distributions- oder Fertigungsumgebung nachweisen.
- - Sie arbeiten detailorientiert, wenden Ursachenanalysen an und sind in der Lage, die hierbei generierten Daten auszuwerten.
- - Sie sehen Veränderungen als Entwicklungsmöglichkeit an und sind bei Bedarf bereit, Ihren Standort zu wechseln.
- - Sie wissen dass Schichtarbeit und Wochenendarbeit in unserem Umfeld unumgänglich sind.

Preferred qualifications

- - Masterabschluss.
- - Kaizen- und Lean-Methoden sowie verwandte Techniken sind Ihnen nicht unbekannt.
- Was wir bieten
- Wir erwarten von Ihnen höchste Einsatzbereitschaft und werden diese entsprechend honorieren. Neben einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung, Bezugsrechten für Aktien und standortabhängigen Leistungsprämien bieten wir zahlreiche weitere Arbeitgeberleistungen, wie z. B. Belegschaftsrabatte.
- Amazon verfolgt als Arbeitgeber den Grundsatz der Chancengleichheit. Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft wesentlich zu unserem Erfolg beiträgt. Wir treffen Einstellungsentscheidungen basierend auf Ihren Erfahrungen und Qualifikationen. Wir wissen Ihre Begeisterung für das Entdecken, Erfinden, Vereinfachen und Erstellen zu schätzen. Bei gleicher Qualifikation werden Schwerbehinderte bevorzugt behandelt.
- Amazon nimmt den Schutz Ihrer persönlichen Daten ernst und respektiert die nationalen Datenschutzgesetze sowie die EU-Rechtsvorschriften zum Datenschutz. Sofern nicht anders vereinbart, erlauben Sie dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon durch Einreichung Ihres Lebenslaufs, Ihre persönlichen Daten in der elektronischen Datenbank zu speichern, die von Amazon Corporate LLC. in den USA oder von einer Tochtergesellschaft zum Zweck der Feststellung Ihrer Eignung für diese und für zukünftig angebotene Stellen sowie zur Verfolgung Ihres Bewerbungsprozesses unterhalten wird.
- Wenn Sie wünschen, dass Ihre persönlichen Daten gelöscht werden, können Sie das einstellende Unternehmen jederzeit darüber benachrichtigen. Amazon gibt Ihre Daten ohne Ihre vorherige Zustimmung nicht an Dritte weiter. Im Rahmen des Interviewprozesses mit Amazon werden Sie möglicherweise dazu aufgefordert, dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon zu gestatten, Ihre Bewerbungsdaten und Ihren Lebenslauf separat durch einen Drittanbieter prüfen zu lassen.

When you join Amazon as an Area/Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritising routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.
Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

descriptionHtml:

Do you want to build the infrastructure that keeps Artificial Intelligence compute capacity available to Generative AI customers? Do you want to solve problems at the boundary between physical hardware and software - at cloud scale?

AWS Hardware Engineering is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to own the health and development of server platforms at worldwide fleet scale. You will develop automation, analyze hardware telemetry across tens of thousands of hosts, and build tooling that directly determines whether capacity is available to customers. Your work spans the full stack — from hardware monitoring interfaces, to health diagnostics up through fleet-wide data pipelines and operational dashboards.


Key job responsibilities
Fleet Health & Data Analysis

- Analyze hardware failure patterns using fleet telemetry, system event logs, and datacenter tooling to identify root causes and quantify customer impact
- Contribute to predictive failure detection using sensor data, error trending, and log correlation
- Build and maintain operational dashboards and metrics for platform fleet health.
- Build tooling to track component lifecycle (firmware versions, part revisions, supply chain status) across large-scale fleets

- Develop and maintain automation for hardware test, firmware qualification, and capacity recovery workflows

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Collaborate with software, hardware, manufacturing, networking, and vendor teams to validate and qualify new compute solutions
- Troubleshoot complex system-level issues in production environments, correlating across firmware, operating systems, drivers, and physical layers
- Participate in sprint-based planning and oncall rotation for platform-level escalations



A day in the life
Some days you are deep in system event logs chasing a failure pattern across thousands of hosts; other days you are writing automation that eliminates a manual triage workflow entirely. You work with hardware engineers, firmware teams, datacenter operations, and vendor partners - driving quality and reliability from manufacturing through steady-state operations. Located in Cupertino, Seattle, or Denver, you work with global development teams on servers deployed in datacenters worldwide.

AWS Hardware Engineering designs and delivers next-generation cloud infrastructure - the servers, accelerators, and storage platforms that power AWS. Our team builds custom systems for AI training, inference, and compute workloads at global scale. We are directly responsible for launching and maintaining server hardware in the fleet, working across internal development teams, and design partners.

We value work-life harmony, inclusive culture, and continuous learning. Even if you do not meet all preferred qualifications listed below, we encourage you to apply.

- 1+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki -  Poznań (Sady) 2027
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.
Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:
Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin


Key job responsibilities
Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowania.

Wsparcie:

* Program stażowy obejmuje kompleksowy system wsparcia, w tym cotygodniowe dyżury dla stażystów, specjalistyczne wsparcie IT i HR oraz zespół programowy dbający o Twój sukces. Dzięki temu otrzymasz wskazówki i pomoc niezbędne do osiągnięcia sukcesu.

Sesje szkoleniowe:

* Dzięki specjalnym sesjom szkoleniowym jeszcze bardziej rozwiniesz swoje umiejętności, uzyskując dostęp do najnowocześniejszych platform szkoleniowych Amazon i wiedzy liderów branży. Te ustrukturyzowane możliwości rozwoju przygotują cię do kolejnego kroku w karierze.

Możliwości:

* Po pomyślnym ukończeniu stażu możemy rozważyć zatrudnienie Cię na stanowisku dla absolwentów lub zaproponować drugi staż, co pozwoli Ci kontynuować drogę zawodową w Amazon. Dodatkowo otrzymasz konkurencyjne miesięczne wynagrodzenie, wsparcie w relokacji oraz dostęp do szeregu świadczeń pracowniczych.

Daty rozpoczęcia stażu w ciągu roku:

* Przyjmujemy stażystów, którzy mogą rozpocząć pracę w dowolnym momencie od stycznia do lipca 2027 r. Każdego miesiąca organizujemy 1–2 dni wdrożeniowe dla nowych pracowników.

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization/Consultant en livraison – Modernisation d'applications, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
L'équipe AWS Professional Services (ProServe) recherche un Consultant en livraison – Modernisation d'applications expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe chez AWS. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les clients pour concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et moderniser des applications afin de tirer pleinement parti du cloud AWS, notamment via les techniques de modernisation accélérées par l'IA générative (GenAI). Vous serez un acteur clé de la réussite des clients dans leur adoption du cloud, en apportant votre expertise technique et les bonnes pratiques à chaque étape du cycle de vie des projets.

En tant que Consultant en livraison – Modernisation d'applications, vous mettrez votre expertise au service de la conception d'architectures complexes, évolutives et sécurisées, taillées sur mesure pour chaque client. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir les besoins, évaluer les applications existantes et proposer des stratégies de migration efficaces vers AWS. Conseiller de confiance de nos clients, vous les guiderez sur les tendances du secteur, les technologies émergentes et les solutions innovantes, et piloterez la mise en œuvre des projets en garantissant le respect des bonnes pratiques, l'optimisation des performances et la maîtrise des risques tout au long du projet.

L'organisation AWS Professional Services est une équipe mondiale d'experts qui aide les clients à concrétiser leurs objectifs métiers grâce au cloud AWS. Nous collaborons avec les équipes clientes et le réseau de partenaires AWS (APN) pour mener des initiatives cloud en entreprise. Notre équipe propose une gamme de prestations qui aide les clients à atteindre des résultats concrets dans leur adoption du cloud en entreprise. Nous apportons également des conseils ciblés via nos pôles d'expertise mondiaux, couvrant un large éventail de solutions, de technologies et de secteurs d'activité.
--------------------------------------------------
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant – Application Modernization, to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, develop, implement and re-engineer applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud, including GenAI-accelerated modernization techniques. You'll be a key leader in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

As a Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization, you will be proficient in leading the architecture of complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current applications, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions AWS complexes, évolutives et sécurisées, adaptées aux besoins des clients

Fournir des conseils techniques et un support au dépannage tout au long du projet

Collaborer avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir les besoins et proposer des stratégies de migration efficaces

Agir comme conseiller de confiance auprès des clients sur les tendances du secteur et les technologies émergentes

Partager les connaissances au sein de l'organisation par le mentorat, la formation et la création d'artefacts réutilisables

Aider les clients à moderniser leurs applications existantes via des approches éprouvées comme la migration progressive (Strangler Fig) et l'isolation par couche (Anti-Corruption Layer).

Décomposer les architectures monolithiques en microservices et architectures serverless (Lambda, ECS/EKS, Fargate, Step Functions, EventBridge)

title: Principal PMT, FBA IOS
descriptionHtml:
The FBA Inventory team is responsible for one of the most strategically critical and technically complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: managing the inventory volume sent to and stored in the Amazon Fulfillment Network (AFN) across 1MM+ sellers worldwide, while enabling sellers to grow at the pace they desire. Our team sits at the intersection of seller economics, network operations, and latest science thinking — uniquely positioned to align incentives between Amazon and sellers to maximize GMS, optimize network health, and deliver a best-in-class seller experience.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, results-oriented Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned inventory enforcement orchestration running inventory removal driven defects down to zero. This is a rare opportunity to own a platform that directly influences seller trust at scale, the integrity of Amazon's compliance posture across every marketplace, and the efficiency of the global fulfillment network. You will drive the strategy and roadmap spanning policy-authoring systems, action APIs, appeal-aware control logic, and the lifecycle-of-record systems that power them — building products that resolve policy intent, seller remediation, appeal state, and removal eligibility upstream, so downstream inventory and removal systems can correctly take execution actions.



Key job responsibilities
1. Own the FBA platform roadmap for Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned enforcement orchestration — and the next-generation enforcement experience that turns downstream systems into stateless executors of upstream policy decisions.
2) Drive the shift to policy-owned enforcement, replacing bundled downstream workflows with discrete, policy-issued action primitives each with its own timing, owner, and result.
3) Build seller-protecting controls that make enforcement deterministic, transparent, and appeal-aware — including irreversible-action gates checked against active appeal state, undo/resume logic, and a single lifecycle-of-record so sellers never receive conflicting dates, channels, or instructions.
4) Scale the enforcement platform beyond compliance — partnering with policy, science, and marketplace teams to extend the model to any future use case that touches inventory, offers, orders, removals, or seller communication, while distinguishing reversible (Compliance-Pending) from irreversible (Disposition-Required) violations.
5) Lead cross-functional alignment across CPP/Policy Manager, DISCO, Paragon/AHD, Issue Store, AFT/TASC, FBA, and Retail on the action API contract, policy-authoring validation, and evaluation/enforcement grain alignment — transforming fragmented, downstream-owned enforcement into an automated, policy-driven system with zero unauthorized removals.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 10+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
