title: Senior Data Engineer, Selling Partner Agentic Interfaces Data Products
descriptionHtml:
Own the architecture of a data product that makes AI-powered commerce measurable, trustworthy, and improvable for millions of sellers worldwide. Join SP-AI Data Products as a founding technical leader who will define how an entire organization observes, governs, and learns from every AI-driven interaction at scale, built entirely on AWS large-scale data processing infrastructure.

We're at an inflection point. AI agents are replacing traditional seller workflows, generating 7.5 million interactions annually across 50+ internal product teams, with thousands of Developers building on the ecosystem. Every one of these innovations creates a measurement obligation, and right now there's no unified infrastructure to fulfill it. You'll change that. You're joining a small team transforming from traditional reporting into a production data product organization, and this role determines what that product becomes. You'll design and build on AWS services including Kinesis for real-time streaming ingestion, EMR and Spark for large-scale distributed data processing, Glue for ETL orchestration, Redshift and Athena for analytical workloads, S3 and Lake Formation for governed storage, and Lambda and Step Functions for event-driven pipeline automation.

What you'll own:

- Design and govern the canonical event schema: the unified measurement format that makes every AI interaction across every surface produce a comparable, correlated record. You define what gets measured and how.
- Own end-to-end data architecture across telemetry layers (user engagement, action execution, domain response), ensuring cross-layer correlation through session-level tracing
- Build and operate streaming and batch ingestion pipelines on AWS with production SLAs, serving real-time observability for leadership, risk teams, applied scientists, and product teams simultaneously
- Architect tenantized data products that enable 50+ teams to onboard once and receive self-serve metrics (adoption, quality, risk, impact) without building custom pipelines
- Drive data engineering standards across the organization: schema governance, naming conventions, data quality, operational excellence. You set the bar others build to.
- Make architectural trade-offs that balance short-term delivery against long-term scalability: tiered storage, build-vs-buy decisions, schema evolution across dozens of consumers
- Identify and resolve systemic architecture deficiencies, proposing and leading cross-team initiatives that unblock innovation for adjacent teams
- Decompose complex, ambiguous problems into parallel workstreams executable by you and others, then reassemble them into cohesive solutions
- Elevate the engineering team through mentorship and technical leadership. Your presence makes the team stronger, but the team doesn't require your presence to succeed.

Why you'll love this role:

- Founding-team impact: You're defining the architecture an entire organization builds on, not inheriting legacy systems
- Breadth of influence: Your schema decisions, quality standards, and architectural patterns are consumed by risk teams, scientists, product managers, and leadership across the business
- Technical depth at scale: Streaming infrastructure, cross-surface correlation, schema governance for 50+ consumers, production SLAs on AWS. Hard, consequential engineering.
- Career-defining scope: Cross-cutting schema design and multi-team domain onboarding at this scale is the kind of work that shapes what comes next

If you've built large-scale data products on AWS that other teams depend on, thrive in ambiguity, and want to define how an organization measures AI-driven commerce at scale, we'd love to talk.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design, implementation, and evolution of large-scale data architecture on AWS (Kinesis, EMR, Spark, Glue, Redshift, Athena, S3, Lake Formation), providing system-wide technical guidance and ensuring all data products meet production-grade reliability, scalability, and security standards
- Write exemplary, production-quality code in Java, Scala, and Python to build streaming and batch data pipelines that process terabytes of telemetry data daily across distributed systems, with proper testing, lineage documentation, and quality controls. SQL proficiency is expected as a baseline.
- Design and maintain the canonical event schema and standardized, reusable data products following data mesh governance principles that eliminate metric inconsistencies and enable self-service analytics for 50+ domain teams
- Build and operate ETL and ELT pipelines using AWS-native services (Glue, EMR, Step Functions, Lambda) and JVM-based frameworks (Spark on Scala/Java) that transform raw telemetry into trusted, AI-ready datasets with defined SLAs for freshness and completeness
- Architect real-time observability infrastructure and analytical workloads (Kinesis, Redshift, Athena, QuickSight) that provide actionable insights on user engagement, operational health, risk detection, quality monitoring, and compliance tracking
- Collaborate with and influence peer Software Development Engineers, Applied Scientists, Product Managers, and Business Intelligence Engineers to define requirements, validate data quality, and align data product design with business and technical strategy
- Define and enforce data governance standards across the organization including schema governance, Fine-Grained Access Control, data classification, naming conventions, and lineage tracking across all data products
- Identify systemic data quality issues and architecture deficiencies, drive root-cause resolution, and automate manual processes to improve operational efficiency and eliminate recurring failures
- Document data products, architectural decisions, and design patterns clearly to ensure ease of use, extensibility, and maintainability by team members and downstream consumers across the organization
- Lead cross-team initiatives to enable GenAI capabilities through Amazon Quick Suite, defining how AI surfaces consume governed data while maintaining robust security, access controls, and auditability at scale

A day in the life
Your primary focus is owning the data architecture that powers AI-driven commerce for millions of sellers. Most of your day is spent writing Java, Scala, and Python code: building Spark pipelines on EMR, designing streaming ingestion on Kinesis, and optimizing how terabytes of interaction data flow through AWS infrastructure into governed, queryable products.

You'll be based in Bengaluru, working alongside a team split between Bengaluru and Seattle. Your mornings give you uninterrupted build time while Seattle is offline. You use this window for deep architectural work: writing design documents, pushing complex pipeline code, and leaving detailed code review feedback so your Seattle teammates wake up unblocked. During overlap hours, you join focused design reviews and cross-team discussions where your job is to bring clarity, shape schema decisions, and drive alignment across engineering teams consuming your data products.

Beyond the core technical work, you're the person domain teams come to when they need guidance on how to emit telemetry that conforms to the canonical schema. You're investigating why a streaming pipeline breached its SLA and fixing the root cause before it recurs. You're mentoring engineers through pull requests that teach long-term maintainability, not just correctness. Some days bring unexpected production issues that need fast diagnosis. Other days you're heads-down on a multi-week design for the next generation of tenantized data products that will serve 50+ teams.

The Bengaluru-Seattle structure means you operate with high autonomy. Decisions don't wait for handoffs across timezones. You own outcomes end-to-end, and the team trusts your judgment to move fast and get it right.

About the team
SP-AI Data Products is a small, high-autonomy team that builds the data infrastructure powering AI-driven commerce for millions of Amazon Selling Partners worldwide. Our mission is straightforward: make every AI agent interaction measurable, governable, and improvable through trusted, self-service data products. We exist so that product teams can ship with confidence, risk teams can detect abuse in real time, scientists can train better models, and leadership can see exactly how the business is performing without waiting for someone to compile a report.

We're a team of software engineers, data engineers, and business intelligence engineers split between Bengaluru and Seattle. We operate like a startup inside Amazon: small enough that every person's work is visible and consequential, but connected to a business growing at 7x year-over-year that serves 50+ domain teams, thousands third-party developers, and millions of sellers. Our customers are internal: the engineering teams building AI agents, the risk and trust teams protecting the ecosystem, the product managers tracking adoption, and the scientists improving model quality. We build for all of them simultaneously through governed, tenantized data products rather than one-off reports.

Our culture is built on ownership and craft. We write production-grade code in Java, Scala, and Python. We design schemas that dozens of teams consume. We hold each other to high engineering standards through rigorous code and design reviews, and we invest in mentorship because raising the bar across the team matters more than any individual contribution. We're transparent about what we are: a lean team executing an ambitious transformation from reactive reporting into a production data product organization built entirely on AWS. If you want to work somewhere your architectural decisions directly shape how an organization operates, where you'll have real autonomy to drive outcomes, and where the problems are genuinely hard and unsolved, this is the team.

- 7+ years of data engineering experience
- 5+ years of development/programming/scripting language (Python/Java/Bash/Perl) experience
- Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Sagemaker, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, and EC2
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead, or experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in any Bigdata architecture, or experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications and experience with automation and any version control tools
- Experience in Kafka, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Redshift

title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.


Key job responsibilities
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
- Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
- Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
- Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
- Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities
🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
- Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
- Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
- Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
- Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation
🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
- Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
- Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
- Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines
🔷 Handover & Documentation
- Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
- Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
- Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase
🔷 Rack Decommissioning
- Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
- Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
- Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
- Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
- Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool
🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
- Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
- Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
- Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity
🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
- Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
- Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
- Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately
🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
- Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
- Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
- Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
- Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
- Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

descriptionHtml:

title: Ground Systems Hardware Development Engineer, Amazon Leo Ground Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Hardware Development Engineer on the Ground Systems team, you will contribute to the design, development, integration, and validation of Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) and Ground Gateway hardware, and operate as an autonomous technical contributor who independently designs hardware components and significant technical portions of subsystems for tightly coupled and often ambiguous aerospace systems. These systems support satellite launch, early orbit operations, and ongoing command and control of the Leo constellation using full-motion tracking antenna terminals and their associated RF electronics.

You will be expected to perform under a combination of constraints, to include: satellite-system deployment consequences, limited post-deployment access, tight regulatory and export-control constraints, and immature supplier reference ecosystems that often require first-principles development.

You will be expected to make design decisions with awareness that reliability and quality must be established before deployment because repair, RMA, or post-deployment correction may be impractical.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
You will work alongside senior engineers and cross-functional partners to deliver hardware from concept through production and global deployment. Key responsibilities include:

- Support the design, development, and validation of RF hardware and electronics subsystems for TT&C and Gateway terminals, including antenna feed assemblies, RF front-end chains, and ancillary equipment.
- Perform CAD functions for new designs and improvements to our deployed infrastructure, and drive these through installation and implementation.
- Execute bring-up, hardware integration, and test campaigns for Gateway and TT&C subsystems.
- Develop and execute verification and validation plans to ensure hardware meets performance, environmental, and reliability requirements.
- Support root cause analysis and failure investigations on ground station hardware.
- Collaborate with internal teams and external suppliers to drive hardware development, procurement, and integration activities.
- Contribute to design review documentation, test reports, and engineering change processes.
- Support the transition of HW designs from development through qualification and into production and field deployment.
You will work closely with RF systems, mechanical, thermal, software, and operations teams to ensure TT&C and Gateway ground stations meet performance requirements and are deployable at global scale.

About the team
The Ground Systems team is developing globally distributed high data rate satellite communication terminals, which operate off of automated software driven systems and which maintain critical connectivity from the ground to the complete Leo constellation. This team is driving the development, deployment and long-term operability of Leo ground station terminals.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent engineering science
- 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of hardware development and CAD experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of satellite communications ground systems and operations experience

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon we're currently seeking for experienced Operations Managers to join our Customer Fulfillment team at our Robotics Fulfillment Center in Kemps Creek.

This is an excellent opportunity to be part of the AU Fulfillment Center (FC) leadership team during its phase of expansion and growth, whereby you get to define the process flows and shape up standard work routines as the operations scale up.

As an Operations Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, inclusive leadership for the teams you supervise. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Area Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Site Lead of your Fulfillment Center. The quality of your leadership is key to achievement in this role: you’ll motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of your role will be to coordinate on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you supervise. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.

Please note the shift pattern is set based on 4 days on and 3 days off, working at least one weekend day.

Key Job Responsibilities:
- Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your remit area, while promoting an inspiring Health and Safety culture on-site,
- Become a subject matter expert on specific, larger-scale processes and activities within FCs,
- In your inventory control and systems environment, you’ll handle timely data collection, updating operations metrics on an hourly basis,
- You’ll aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors and ensure a high-quality customer experience,
- Work closely with other support teams (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, IT) on staffing plans, schedules and performance levels,
- Implement process change and contribute in cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your site and the broader Amazon Operations network.

Basic qualifications

- Proven leadership experience in a similar, innovative logistics, distribution, manufacturing or fast pace retail environment with multi-site/store management experience,
- Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams,
- Experience in employee and performance management experience,
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written,
- Proven ability in establishing and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyse the data you generate,
- Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

Preferred qualifications

- Completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field,
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities,

title: Senior Business Coach, DSP Business Coach Team
descriptionHtml:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses.

The Senior Business Coach (BC) helps Amazon improve the flexibility and quality of its delivery network in the Americas—to help fuel a $4B investment in rural communities bringing even faster delivery to our millions of customers in less densely populated areas. This role’s primary focus is supporting DSP operations across the broader Americas delivery network, with particular emphasis on rural market expansion and mature-state optimization. Specifically, BCs support DSPs in making business decisions that enable them to build healthy, sustainable businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs, supporting business planning and strategy and helping owners address business and operational challenges.

Key job responsibilities
As Senior Business Coach (BC), you will manage a portfolio of Delivery Service Partner (DSP) owners within the Amazon delivery network. With the evolution of delivery modes and rural expansion planned for 2026, and continued strategic expansion into 2027, this role is integral to our program's evolution. Sr. BCs provide strategic guidance to DSP owners throughout their business life-cycle of their relationship with Amazon—from pre-launch preparation through mature-state optimization. You will facilitate solution-oriented approaches to remove business obstacles and drive continuous improvement in financial performance, operational efficiency, and safety standards across the network. The position requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations managers, program directors, compliance officers, legal counsel, and finance teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, strategic problem-solving skills, and the ability to implement data-driven recommendations that create meaningful change both internally and externally.

Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence & Financial Advisory
• Lead DSP owners through critical business phases including launch, operational scaling, and seasonal demand optimization
• Provide comprehensive consultation on financial management and operational optimization
• Support development of scalable business processes to ensure consistent performance metrics
• Navigate program evolution by helping owners implement and adapt to strategic changes within traditional DSP operations, including new service types and offerings such as rural delivery expansion and delivery capabilities
• Conduct data-driven business reviews, delivering performance insights and competitive benchmarking analysis

Business Development & Program Management
• Evaluate and interview potential candidates for the DSP program, ensuring alignment with program standards and objectives
• Guide strategic planning and execution of network capacity management

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Enhancement
• Foster strong DSP community engagement through coordination of local events and regional initiatives
• Build and maintain productive relationships with regional stakeholders
• Identify operational inefficiencies and champion process improvements across the network
• Design and implement solutions to enhance overall program effectiveness and DSP owner experience

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor and primary account manager, combining strategic insight with practical business acumen to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence across the DSP network.

A day in the life
Strategic Leadership & Decision Making
• Drive both strategic initiatives and tactical execution to achieve business objectives
• Leverage industry expertise to establish priorities, optimize account management strategies, and develop sustainable long-term solutions
• Navigate ambiguous business environments to formulate clear strategic direction and influence cross-functional priorities
• Demonstrate sound judgment in solution design, balancing complexity with efficiency

Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Lead resolution of complex business challenges through detailed analysis and effective escalation management
• Foster collaborative relationships across multiple business units and organizational levels
• Develop and maintain strong partnerships with key stakeholders through exceptional relationship management
• Deliver compelling verbal and written communications, including executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations

Location & Travel Requirements
• Position is headquartered at our Nashville or Manhattan Hub
• Work arrangement includes structured mix of office presence, field travel, and remote work days. One week per month is dedicated to in-office collaboration at respective/team’s Hub. Significant field engagement is required: minimum 3 days per week of travel for 3 weeks monthly to support portfolio of Delivery Service Partners
• Must be comfortable with regular travel and maintaining a flexible schedule

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional problem-solving capabilities, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

title: Lead Support Engineer, Mobility, Amazon LEO Enterprise Customer Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of over 3,000 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.




Key job responsibilities
We are seeking a Lead Support Engineer to join our Enterprise & Mobility Support team. The Lead Support Engineer is the senior technical lead for enterprise and mobility satellite connectivity customers. You define the product support layer behind fleet monitoring, tooling, and in-service operations. The ideal candidate has significant product support engineering experience in satellite communications, has led investigations across hardware, software, and operations teams, managed field engineers, and turned technical findings into program decisions that improve reliability.

• Define BITE fault taxonomies, impact classifications, and alerting thresholds for connectivity systems
• Build the playbook where one doesn’t exist. When a new system, failure mode, or customer scenario has no documented path, define the support approach and escalation logic from scratch
• Establish monitoring requirements, telemetry data points, and fault thresholds. Work with Product and Hardware Engineering to determine tracking and visualization (LRU health, connectivity KPIs, firmware states, telemetry pipelines)
• Look beyond individual faults. Review how systems are deployed end-to-end (terminals, network, software, ground infrastructure) and identify where designs will break under scale or stress before they reach service.
• Serve as the escalation authority for recurring or fleet-wide issues. Drive root cause analysis and coordinate resolution with Hardware, Software, Network Operations, and Product
• Manage a team of Support Engineers across one or multiple customers, including workload assignment, mentoring, and performance development.
• Break down complex problems into assignable pieces so multiple engineers can work in parallel. You manage the investigation, findings and conclusion, end-to-end.
• Conduct MTBF analysis, reliability trending, failure mode identification, and hardware/software investigations using repair-shop data, service-bulletin history, and field failure reports
• Author and maintain troubleshooting SOPs, work instructions, and decision trees that Support Engineers execute daily in the field
• Own the technical customer relationship. Lead the technical components of MBRs and QBRs, and present on in-service status, fleet performance, and top issues
• Drive product enhancement requirements by identifying gaps in monitoring data and validating that telemetry reflects actual system health
• Provide structured feedback to Product Management on field observations, reliability trends, and improvement opportunities
• Identify recurring hardware and software incidents and coordinate with engineering teams to plan and release fixes or modifications
• Establish triage processes for incoming incidents: severity classification, reproduction steps, and handover packages produced within SLA
• Support Entry into Service (EIS), retrofit, and new customer onboarding from a technical readiness perspective
• Quantify Cost of Non-Conformance (CoNC) for in-service incidents to target engineering investment and backlog reduction
• Lead alignment across Engineering, Product, Operations, and the customer when priorities conflict. Bring teams to agreement on resolution approaches for contentious issues
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, guiding trade-off decisions across cost, performance, instrumentation depth, and operational risk
• Own the quality bar for solutions. Fixes should be maintainable, scalable, and simplify existing approaches rather than add complexity
• Contribute to hiring. Participate in interview panels, assess candidates against the technical bar, and help calibrate promotion readiness for the team


Work in a rotating shift schedule, including weekdays, and weekends, with the requirement to be available for on-call duties as needed to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
In this role, you will serve as the conduit between field Support Engineers, internal engineering teams (Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Network Operations, Product), and enterprise customers. You will define what to monitor and why: fault taxonomies, telemetry pipelines, alerting thresholds, and the data requirements behind proactive support. You will lead investigations into recurring issues, improve fleet reliability, manage a team of Support Engineers, and own the technical customer relationship. You will balance hands-on escalation work with longer-term priorities: shaping how the support model evolves, influencing the product roadmap based on what you see in the field, and deciding where the team invests time versus accepts risk.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in technical troubleshooting or similar
- 8+ years of experience in satellite communications, in-flight connectivity, maritime connectivity, or equivalent enterprise connectivity systems in field support and/or in-service product support engineering roles.
- Industry-specific experience in connectivity systems product support in lieu of formal degree qualification (Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field is a plus)
- Experience leading hardware and software investigations: root cause analysis, failure mode identification, and resolution of recurring issues
- Experience with MTBF/MTBUR analysis, reliability trending, and using repair data to improve fleet performance
- Experience defining monitoring thresholds, data requirements, and fault taxonomies for in-service support tooling
- BITE (Built-In Test Equipment) fault interpretation across hardware and software systems
- Experience with Linux-based system diagnostics, log analysis, and network troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi-Fi)
- RF troubleshooting experience including VSWR, insertion loss testing, and satellite terminal diagnostics
- Experience producing executive-level technical presentations and leading customer business reviews
- Experience managing or leading a team of field or support engineers, including workload planning, mentoring, and performance management
- Ability to translate technical issues into actionable program decisions for non-technical stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Prior product support engineering or engineering management experience at a connectivity, IFEC, or satellite communications OEM
- Comfortable going deep in one area while picking up enough in adjacent systems (network, software, hardware, RF) to connect the dots when problems cross domains
- History of documenting and sharing what you’ve learned, whether through tech talks, written best practices, or industry events
- Experience managing incident backlogs of 100+ concurrent cases with structured triage and escalation processes
- Experience using data analytics to define KPIs, build threshold-based alerting, and support predictive maintenance
- Prior on-site field engineering experience embedded at customer operational facilities
- Experience with software release coordination, service bulletin management, and configuration/change control
- Knowledge of Entry into Service (EIS) processes, certification requirements, and OEM integration workflows
- Experience quantifying Cost of Non-Conformance and driving engineering investment decisions based on field data

title: Sr. Materials Lifecycle Specialist, WW Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

The Worldwide Environment team utilizes science-based approaches to lower Amazon’s environmental impacts across the operations of our business units and products, making meaningful and measurable impacts in the communities in which we operate.

The Worldwide Environment team is looking for a Senior Materials Lifecycle Specialist to apply deep technical expertise in materials science and engineering to help Amazon define and implement strategies that measure and mitigate the environmental and social impacts of commodity supply chains and improve their long-term resilience. Your expertise in materials characterization, lifecycle assessment, processing and refining pathways, and regional and geo-political risk analysis will enable you to develop and implement 3-5 year strategic plans that evolve our materials management standards. You will leverage additional technical knowledge of extended producer responsibility, risk- and impact-mitigating standards and certifications used within target commodity supply chains, and broad understanding of materials innovation, recycling chemistry, and circular economy frameworks to advance sustainability.

The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of material properties, extraction and processing science, and recovery pathways with strategic thinking to develop and drive best-in-class sustainability strategies for key materials across Amazon’s businesses, including sourcing guidance, circular recovery pathways, and supply chain resilience measures. Additionally, they will work with Tech and Science teams to develop advanced tooling (including geospatial and AI-enabled systems) for material impact and risk measurement, design multi-business KPIs, establish data pipelines, and work with internal and 3P partners to develop, pilot, and scale innovative technologies to strengthen our supply chains.

Key job responsibilities
-Serve as a company expert on one or more commodity supply chains, applying materials science and engineering knowledge to assess their environmental impacts and develop business-specific risk and impact mitigation strategies.
-Lead technical analysis and global dissemination of sustainability guidance for commodity sourcing, materials recovery from end-of-life products and infrastructure, and supply chain diversification strategies.
-Develop comprehensive 3-5 year strategic plans grounded in materials science to improve sourcing practices and mitigate supply chain risks and environmental impacts of key commodity sourcing.
-Collaborate with and influence Amazon business units and technical teams to execute strategic plans that result in impact avoidance, risk mitigation, and materials innovation.
-Collaborate with Amazon Tech and Science teams to develop tools for commodity impact and risk measurement, lifecycle assessment, and abatement scenario analysis.
-Design and manage pilots of new material production, processing, and recovery technologies with our businesses and develop the business case for scaling effective approaches.
-Build and maintain deep technical expertise including materials innovation, recycling and recovery chemistry, industry trends, institutional development, external stakeholder and industry coalition priorities, emerging technologies, and sustainability approaches that further risk and impact mitigation within commodity sustainability.

title: Sr. Production Operations Manager, Live Sports Production
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of Amazon's dynamic Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Production Operations Manager who brings both strategic business acumen and hands-on production expertise to own the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple live sports properties, from initial financial modeling and vendor strategy through boots-on-the-ground execution.

In this role, you will serve as the centralized operational lead for your assigned properties, driving strategic planning across the full project lifecycle. You will lead financial modeling, shape vendor strategy, and manage engagement with third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), coordinating backend functions including crewing, payroll, travel, and production accounting while maintaining Amazon's operational standards and ensuring productions launch on time and on budget.

Equally critical is your ability to deliver on the ground. You will work in lockstep with internal crewing, editorial, and technical workstreams to ensure each event or studio show is properly resourced, and will partner directly with PSPs to establish best practices, define operational standards, and ensure alignment across the vendor landscape. You will drive production readiness across all operational workstreams, ensuring each event is prepared for a clean launch and seamless restart.

This role requires deep knowledge of remote, event, and studio production operations, including broadcast positions, industry standard rates, vendor engagement models, and production service agreements. You will be responsible for issue spotting, driving decision making, and escalating matters that carry risk to the Global Head of Production Operations. Our production operation is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than modeled after a traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships, and workflows that will scale with us.

The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You can juggle competing priorities across multiple productions with autonomy, react with urgency when situations demand immediate attention, and bring a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business.

Key job responsibilities
• End-to-End Property Lifecycle Management: Own and manage the full project lifecycle for assigned properties, from projected business scope and production roadmap development, through execution and ongoing supervision of day-to-day live event and studio production, to post-mortem and financial reconciliation. Develop milestones, launch schedules, and workback timelines to ensure successful delivery of property launches and season restarts. Lead property transition planning for returning seasons, ensuring operational continuity, vendor re-engagement, and incorporation of prior-season learnings into the restart roadmap.

• Business Strategy and Vendor Management: Develop a deep understanding of organizational business objectives and production priorities to drive vendor evaluation, selection, and strategic recommendations that optimize cost, quality, and scalability across assigned properties. Shepherd the vendor selection process through RFPs and serve as the primary point of contact for vendors defining scope of work, deliverables, and engagement standards. Partner with Legal and Production Finance on contract terms, rate frameworks, and commercial agreements, and monitor vendor performance to ensure accountability against operational standards.

• Budget and Financial Management: Create and manage production budgets from initial scoping through execution. Work closely with Production Finance to track and reconcile all production costs, ensuring external vendors and the production team are aware of overall spend. Coordinate fee reconciliation and payment processing with third-party vendors to ensure accuracy and timeliness. Lead regular financial status updates to senior leadership, flagging variances and recommending corrective action.

• Crewing Coordination via PSPs: Ensure assigned properties are properly staffed by coordinating crew deployment through third-party vendors. Establish consistent frameworks for how Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) personnel are engaged across productions. Partner with the centralized crewing function to maintain visibility into crew availability, prevent scheduling conflicts, and ensure alignment with creative and editorial vision. Support rate structure consistency and market-competitive positioning across comparable roles.

• On-Site Event Operations and Health & Safety: Oversee on-site event production operations, including venue logistics and coordination with league and arena broadcast groups. Ensure Health & Safety protocols and risk management standards are maintained across all production environments. Work with vendors and internal teams to identify and mitigate operational risks in advance of air, and maintain contingency plans for live production scenarios.

• Labor and Workforce Compliance: Navigate both union and non-union production environments. Ensure third-party PSPs adhere to all applicable labor regulations and collective bargaining agreements. Work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to stay current on regulatory requirements, workforce compliance standards, and crew classification guidelines across domestic and international markets. Advise on compliance considerations as they arise, including jurisdictional rules and engagement terms.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Amazon teams including Editorial Production, Technical Operations, Business Development, Production Finance, Accounting, and Legal to operationalize properties and drive synergy. Align regularly with production teams across regions to share best practices and integrate new learnings. Support the Global Head of Production Ops in implementing operational strategy across all Prime Video Live Sports properties.

• Escalation and Risk Management: Proactively identify issues and blockers, providing timely solutions to resolve them. Exercise sound judgment in issue spotting and decision making, escalating to senior leadership when matters carry risk or require broader organizational alignment. Lead regular status updates on project timelines, budgets, and production readiness.

• Operational Process Improvement and Scalability: Seek continuous improvements in execution of existing productions. Recommend changes to operational strategy, seek alignment with stakeholders, and implement at regular intervals. Own and leverage internal production management tools to maintain full visibility into productions, track resource deployment, and surface issues. Contribute to frameworks, SOPs, and systems that enable the team to scale with increasing property volume and complexity.

About the team
The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of budgeting, scheduling and cost reporting experience
- Experience as a producer, production manager, line producer or in production risk management
- 6+ years of creative role understanding consumer trends and creating content experience
- 8+ years of experience in live sports production operations, production management, or operational planning, including hands-on, boots-on-the-ground execution across remote, studio, and event productions. Proven experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple simultaneous live sports properties, from initial scoping and financial modeling through production execution and post-season reconciliation. Strong command of production processes including vendor management, budgeting, roadmap development, and complex cross-departmental problem solving at scale. Track record of working with third-party production companies, including vendor selection, rate negotiation, and contract management; experience defining service requirements and ensuring commercial terms are captured in production service agreements and statements of work. Experience with both union and non-union crew across live productions, with a working knowledge of applicable collective bargaining agreements and labor guidelines. Experience reviewing and interpreting production service agreements, statements of work, and commercial contracts, with the ability to issue-spot and escalate matters that carry risk to the broader organization

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading large projects and facilitate group meetings
- Experience working for a production company, studio, or television network

title: Systems Development Manager, AWS Managed Operations
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to transform how support engineering operates at scale? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Operations Management is seeking an experienced Support Engineering Manager to lead a global team that's evolving from reactive troubleshooting to proactive automation and engineering excellence using Agentic Al. In this role, you'll eliminate repetitive toil and create a follow-the-sun support model while building a team culture where engineers grow their careers through strategic problem-solving, not just ticket resolution.

You'll have the opportunity to create transformational impact across AWS by leading incident management at massive scale, championing automation-driven solutions, and mentoring engineers to think beyond immediate fixes. This isn't traditional support management—it's about architecting operational resilience, meeting demanding SLAs through innovation, and shaping how AWS delivers world-class service reliability to millions of customers globally.

AWS Operations Management (AWSOM) handles operational infrastructure responsibility for all services in AWS commercial regions, enabling service teams to focus on customer engagement and innovation development. The team automates operational tasks to eliminate toil and simplify operations without requiring deep service expertise, providing consistent operational experience across AWS. AWSOM is accountable for critical operational metrics including service pipeline freshness, host maintenance, and security campaign remediation.

The team's vision centers on scaling operational excellence through automation and engineering discipline. You'll join a culture that values proactive problem-solving, continuous improvement, and developing engineers who take ownership of complex systems. This is an environment where your leadership directly impacts AWS's ability to maintain the reliability and security that millions of customers depend on daily.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a support engineering team through career mentoring, performance management, and strategic project assignments that evolve engineers from support mindset to engineering mindset, fostering continuous learning and next-level performance

- Drive incident management and problem-solving at scale by directing technical responses during critical outages, analyzing root causes, and collaborating with engineering teams to advocate for permanent code fixes rather than temporary workarounds

- Establish and optimize follow-the-sun support operations by managing global handovers, coordinating cross-regional resources, and ensuring seamless 24/7 coverage while maintaining work-life harmony for your team

- Build process automation and operational excellence mechanisms by identifying repetitive toil, implementing automation workflows using agentic Al, updating support playbooks, and establishing metrics to measure team performance against SLAs, response times, and resolution rates

- Partner with stakeholders across AWS to define team vision and long-term strategy, working backwards from customer problems to set goals, allocate resources effectively, and balance tactical operational needs with strategic engineering initiatives


A day in the life
- Lead the deployment and operation of services in regions with specialised security needs.
- Report on the health of these services.
- Drive root cause analysis and coach others on performing them.
- Lead local development efforts to improve operational performance.
- Drive continual improvement in systems operations through the development of new tooling and automation.
- Define and drive projects and report on their progress.

- Create and refine the staffing and support plan for the services that you support.

About the team

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (m/f/d), Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work on the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure? Then we have the perfect job for you!

Mid 2013, our Amazon Web Services S3 web service accepted its 2 trillionth object and that the service is regularly peaking at over 1.1 million requests per second. To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in every region. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you!

We are currently looking for an experienced, detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports our Data Center Organization within Amazon. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. This is data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

Amazon offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining our computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.


Responsibilities:
- You will assist in the operation, and maintenance of all electrical,mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility.
- You will assist in maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.
- You will monitor and troubleshoot of all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems,voice/data, chiller systems and generators.
- You will provide assistance to contractor or data center engineer to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment covered under level I plus areas in which they are certified such as making and running fiber optic, electrical certification, HVAC repair (training/certification), UPS and or generator certifications and training.
- You will provide assistance to contractor or data center engineer to deploy new equipment, such as, building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.
- You will responds to internal Rack customer maintenance, repair and additions/expansion requests through the ticketing system,
- You will perform site walkthroughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.
- You will maintain changes in state in Mission Critical infrastructure in support of corrective/ preventive maintenance.
- You will review the Test quality, performance, safety, and reliability of products, equipment, processes.



Key job responsibilities
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- You have received a technical (Military/ Trade School) training and/or have similar experience in that field.
- You will have such electrical qualification(s) as are necessary to operate Low Voltage equipment in accordance with applicable German regulations (Elektrofachkraft)
- You have several years of relevant work experience, ideally within Data Center operations.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state

Preferred qualifications

- You have several years of working within a data center.
- You have an associates or Bachelor’s degree in applicable engineering field or mechanical or electrical trades.
- Certified electrician as per German regulations

title: Solutions Architect, AWS Mexico Cross Industry
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges? As a Solutions Architect II at Amazon, you will partner directly with customers to design and deliver technical solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes. You will combine your technical depth with business understanding to architect solutions that are secure, scalable, reliable, and performant. This role puts you at the intersection of customer needs and technology innovation, where your recommendations shape how organizations leverage our platforms and services to reduce costs, mitigate risks, and accelerate growth.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end technical solutions for customers by understanding their business context, outcome priorities, and technology challenges, while applying sound judgment on trade-offs such as load distribution, data store choice, scaling strategy, and failover mechanisms.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, diving deeply into design choices, best practices, and use cases to help them identify opportunities and risks with their technical decisions.
- Leverage existing repeatable design patterns where appropriate and create new reusable solution designs when needed, seeking opportunities to simplify existing solutions and processes.
- Develop and deliver technical content including presentations, workshops, and written guidance that educates customers on best practices and incorporates lessons learned from real-world engagements.
- Collaborate with internal teams across sales, engineering, and support to progress customer opportunities through their lifecycle, while contributing to peer design reviews and sharing best practices with teammates.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing a customer's architecture proposal, identifying areas where a different scaling strategy could improve reliability. By midday, you are on a call with a customer's engineering team, whiteboarding a solution that addresses their data migration challenges. In the afternoon, you collaborate with internal engineering to translate customer feedback into product requirements, then wrap up by refining a workshop you are building to help customers adopt a new design pattern.

About the team
Our team is focused on helping customers succeed by providing technical guidance that translates business objectives into well-architected solutions. We operate in a collaborative environment where architects learn from each other through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship. We are building toward a future where every customer interaction results in reusable patterns that raise the bar for solution quality across the organization. If you thrive on solving technical problems while building lasting customer relationships, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

title: IT Support Engineer II, Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) - Fixed Field
descriptionHtml:
Amazonは「 地球上で最もお客様を大切にし、地球上で最も豊富な品揃え」というビジョンを目指しています。このビジョンを実現するために、素晴らしい仲間を求めています。オーナーシップを持ち変化と革新に情熱を持って取り組む方を求めています。
我々はカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上させるために進歩し続けています。我々の企業DNAとしてイノベーションと創造があります。皆さんにその力を発揮して頂き、日々発生する問題に工夫を凝らしシンプルな方法で解決し、これからのAmazonを一緒に作り上げ、Amazonと共に未来を歩みましょう。

Amazonは配送拠点で働くIT Support Engineerの応募をお待ちしております。日本のFCでは何百万点もの商品を取り揃えており、毎日世界中に配送しています。まずはFCの中の“物の流れ” を知って頂きます。その後、ITの観点から変更や改善を行って頂くようになります。ITインフラを運用し、FC内の全てのITインフラが問題なく安定的に稼働している事が求められます。Amazonでは一日として同じ日はありません。多くの変化と多様な環境の中で活躍して頂きます。
またチームワークの向上に必要な要素の一つが多様性です。性別、年齢、国籍、経験などは問いません。様々なバックグラウンド・経験を持った仲間と一緒に働ける仲間を求めています。

【どんな体験ができますか】
· 成長の機会 – Amazonの最先端のインフラに携わる重要な運用ポジションです。最新技術から現場の継続的な改善まで。我々の業務には運用といえどもイノベーションが不可欠です
· 配送拠点のネットワーク網は非常に早いペースで拡大しています。多くの挑戦や複雑な問題に取り組み、カスタマーの需要を満たすためにサービスをより拡大させていく事になるでしょう。

【配属先】
OTS Field IT
※ トレーニングは弊社指定のFulfilment Center で行い、その後、所属拠点で勤務となります。
※ OTSとは Operation Technology Solutionの略で配送センターのITシステムをメインに活動する部署の総称であり、Field ITとはその中でも配送センターの現場に寄り添って活動するチームになります。

【その他】
･勤務体系：土日含むシフト勤務 休日: 月10日
例）9:00-18:00, 8:00-17:00, 12:00-21:00等
所属先により勤務体系は異なります。 繁忙期による夜間勤務あり。
またその他、障害時、機器の入れ替え、工事等の理由により夜間帯の作業が発生し対応して頂く場合がございます。

・長期、短期の出張有り (所属拠点から2時間以上、宿泊を伴う場合もあり）
・長期、短期の転勤有り (自宅から2時間以内、または転居を伴う場合もあり）
※ 業務上の理由、またはキャリア形成等の理由による

【キャリアパスについて】
キャリアアップも積極的に推進しており、部署内外の多くのキャリアにチャレンジすることが可能です。上位エンジニアであるシニアサポートエンジニアを中心に人材管理、マネージメント分野ではエンジニアリーダー、IT マネージャーなどを様々なポジションがあります。また部署外でもリモートサポート部門、購買/資材管理部門、技術開発部門など多くのメンバーがチャレンジし活躍されています。

【職場環境について】
* 入社後のサポート体制について :

新入社員向けに細やかなトレーニングやOJTの制度があり、業務に必要なドキュメントや学習のためのコンテンツが豊富に準備されています。また、Amazonでは自分以外は同僚、関連部署を含めて全員がカスタマーという考え方があり、周囲が困っていたり、難しい問題で悩んでいる時にはチーム皆でフォローしていく文化があります。メンター制度や異なる拠点間の交流などもあり安心して業務に取り組めるサポーティブな環境が整っています。

* DEI (Diversity:多様性/Equity:公平性/Inclusion:包括性)の取り組み:

Amazonでは、自分らしく働ける包括的で公平性のある、誰もが働きやすい職場環境の実現のためにさまざまな取り組みを継続的に行っています。多様な価値観を理解し、尊重していけるようにDEIを知るためのコンテンツ、実現するためのプログラムコース、勉強会など定期的に開催されています。Amazon は男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/jp/

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Join our dynamic IT team and become a critical enabler of Amazon's global logistics network. As an IT Support Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining and optimizing the technological infrastructure that powers our fulfillment centers, ensuring seamless operations that deliver smiles to millions of customers worldwide.

About the Team
We are a passionate group of technology professionals dedicated to supporting Amazon's operational excellence. Our team thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, and solving intricate technological challenges. We believe in creating an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation and where every team member can contribute meaningfully to our shared goals.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
1. 社内ヘルプデスクサポート
2. Amazon配送センター内ITインフラ・システム・クライアント機器のサポート、安全管理
3. 新規ビジネス導入に伴う各種プロジェクトサポート

【主な職務内容】

* Windows PC及び周辺機器、Office機器(プリンタ、電話等)のサポート・トラブルシュー ティング

* ITインフラ、ネットワーク関連サポート
* Linux/Windows サーバ・ソフトウェア・ネットワーク機器等の運用サポート・トラブルシューティング・一次対応窓口及び海外チームへのエスカレーション

* 資産管理
* IT機器、サプライ用品の購買、管理、除却
* 安全管理
* 配送拠点内のIT設備に関する安全管理全般
* 各種プロジェクトサポート
* 配送拠点内の新規ビジネス導入に伴う各種プロジェクトサポート
* 他チームと連携しての導入サポート含む
* ITインフラを使用した倉庫内作業の改善、コンサルティング提案

• Provide comprehensive internal help desk support for Windows PCs, peripherals, and office equipment
• Manage and troubleshoot IT infrastructure, systems, and client devices across fulfillment centers
• Conduct first-line support for Linux/Windows servers, software, and network equipment
• Perform server room and rack operations management
• Support project implementations for new business initiatives

A day in the life
日々の業務内容 あなたの一日は、技術的な問題解決、インフラ管理、そして協働的なイノベーションが組み合わさったものになります。複雑なIT課題に取り組み、最先端の技術システムをサポートし、部門横断的なチームと緊密に連携してフルフィルメントセンターの円滑な運営を維持します。サーバー問題のトラブルシューティングから新しい技術ソリューションの実装まで、毎日が具体的な影響を与えるユニークな機会をもたらします。

Your day will be a blend of technical problem-solving, infrastructure management, and collaborative innovation. You'll dive into complex IT challenges, support technological systems, and work closely with cross-functional teams to keep our fulfillment centers running smoothly. From troubleshooting server issues to implementing new technological solutions, every day brings unique opportunities to make a tangible impact.

About the team
私たちは、Amazonの業務の卓越性を支援することに専念する、情熱的なテクノロジー専門家のグループです。私たちのチームは、協働、継続的な学習、そして複雑な技術的課題の解決に力を注いでいます。多様な視点がイノベーションを推進し、すべてのチームメンバーが共通の目標に有意義に貢献できる、包括的な環境を作ることを信条としています。

We are a passionate group of technology professionals dedicated to supporting Amazon's operational excellence. Our team thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, and solving intricate technological challenges. We believe in creating an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation and where every team member can contribute meaningfully to our shared goals.
