title: (Physical) Security Specialist Intern -  2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
NO CYBERSECURITY, READ DESCRIPTION

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Amazon's data centers house the infrastructure that powers the world's largest cloud. Protecting them is mission-critical — and as a Security Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help ensure the physical security of these facilities from the inside.

You will drive operational security excellence, write reports, create presentations, and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Security Management, Criminology, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

About the Role

As a Security Specialist Intern, you will work within the Data Center Security team and play a hands-on role in the day-to-day physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures.

This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe.

What You Will Do
- Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning.
- Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements
- Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls
- Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms
- Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations for management
- Assist with planning and coordinating security-related projects
- Support incident documentation and follow-up processes

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help protect the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work protects the physical infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. The security operations you support keep Amazon's most critical facilities safe and running.

Action. You will move fast, analyze real security data, and make recommendations that get implemented. Your ideas do not stay theoretical — they get tested and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how physical security operates at world-class scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.


About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Risk Management, Criminology, Security Management, or a related field, graduating in 2027 - before the internship´s end date
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head


Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

descriptionHtml:
Assurer la sécurité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs au travail est une priorité absolue chez Amazon. Nos Techniciens de Sécurité jouent un rôle essentiel dans ce domaine. Ce poste est l'occasion de débuter votre carrière dans la sécurité au travail et de vous développer au sein d'une entreprise internationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos experts pour surveiller votre site, ce qui vous permettra de constater chaque jour l'impact de votre travail sur le bien-être de chacun.

Key job responsibilities
- Effectuer des évaluations de risques et des audits
- Surveiller le site pour s'assurer que les processus sont conformes aux procédures de sécurité d'Amazon
- Créer et mettre à jour des rapports sur les indicateurs de sécurité pour vos collègues
- Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et d'autres services sur des tâches liées à la sécurité et offrir des conseils sur les processus
- Soutenir la mise en place de nouvelles mesures de sécurité

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez sur l'un de nos sites. Cela signifie que vous pourrez suivre de près ce qui se passe et que les collaborateurs pourront facilement vous poser des questions pendant leurs postes. Ce rôle consiste avant tout à repérer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent. Vous passerez beaucoup de temps à vérifier le site et à comprendre comment les collaborateurs utilisent les équipements. En comprenant le fonctionnement de chaque tâche et de chaque machine, vous serez en mesure de trouver la meilleure façon de garantir la sécurité des processus. Vous serez également l'une des personnes chargées de mettre en œuvre les changements en matière de sécurité, ce qui signifie que vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreuses personnes. En plus de vos tâches quotidiennes et hebdomadaires, vous apporterez votre soutien à notre équipe Operations sur des missions ponctuelles liées à la sécurité.

About the team
L'équipe Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) joue un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bien-être mental et physique de nos collaborateurs au travail. Notre équipe travaille avec les responsables, les associés et les administrations locales sur l'ensemble de nos sites, en assurant le respect des politiques d'Amazon et des réglementations légales, et en garantissant la sécurité de nos environnements de travail. L'équipe offre une variété d'opportunités, des Techniciens de Sécurité aux Responsables de Programmes.

Basic qualifications

- DUT HSE (Hygiène, Sécurité, Environnement) ou BUT (Licence) en HSE
- Expérience pertinente dans l'utilisation de l'analyse de données pour générer et expliquer des indicateurs
- Connaissance de la législation française en matière de santé et sécurité au travail

Preferred qualifications

- Maîtrise du français et connaissances de base en anglais (A2), à l'écrit et à l'oral
- Expérience avec les méthodologies Lean, 5S ou Kaizen
- Expérience dans la planification ou la gestion d'initiatives écoresponsables
- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Manager I, Operations, Centralised Monitoring Response System Auditing
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.

Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a fast-growing Last Mile support function – AMZL CO (Amazon Logistics Central Operations). AMZL CO is responsible for centrally supporting daily planning and execution of functions that impact Delivery Station (DS) operations across Routing, Scheduling, On-Road and Payments workstreams. The Marcopolo program under AMZL CO strives to operate heavily repetitive processes for NA, EU and JP COs, with standardized mechanisms, tools and technology and with a vision is to build a global Center of Excellence for Last Mile (LM) CO services across WW marketplaces in next 3 years. As a Manager I, Operations in the organization, this role will lead the operations management (tactical execution) charter for Driver support workstream supporting NA/EU. This role will influence and advice multiple senior level leaders and stakeholders.

Responsibilities of a NOC Manager I:
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.

title: Senior Strategic Partnership & Account Manager, DACH Retail, Amazon Devices
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Devices & Services, we imagine the future, and then create it. Join brilliant minds to build new categories of technology that become part of everyone's everyday life. Together, we create connected experiences and transform lives, communities, and the world with our work.

The Devices team for the DACH region is looking for a Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager. As a Sr. Account Manager, you will be the face of Amazon Devices to several of Europe's largest consumer electronics retailers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. You will shape how Amazon Devices, including Echo, Fire TV, Kindle and many more, reach customers in physical stores, and you will be accountable for the sales, the plan and the relationship behind them. Picture a customer in a consumer electronics store in Munich, Vienna or Zurich. They pick up a Kindle, ask an adviser how Alexa works, and walk out with an Echo for the kitchen. That moment is made by the partnerships you will own.

You will work with partners that are as ambitious as we are, in a category where customers increasingly expect their devices to work well together. You will decide where to focus, back those decisions with data, and bring colleagues from across Amazon along with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the partnerships. Act as the single point of accountability for Amazon Devices at our largest DACH retail partners. Build trusted relationships across multiple teams, including commercial, marketing, supply chain and distributors, up to senior leadership, in each of the three countries.
- Lead the field team and vendors. Manage the field team and the external vendors who support us in delivering for customers in stores. Set clear priorities, hold a high bar, and make sure their work drives sales for the partner and for Amazon.
- Set the strategy and the plan. Develop and deliver the annual joint business plans with the partners. They cover sales targets, assortment, pricing and promotions, marketing, and in-store execution, and they balance long-term growth against short-term results.
- Own the financials. Be accountable for the sales, margin and investment plan across the DACH retail partners. Set and forecast the sales targets, manage the promotional, marketing and trade budgets, and track return on that investment. Make clear trade-offs between growth and profitability, and take responsibility for delivering the plan and for explaining any gap to it.
- Negotiate. Lead commercial negotiations and agree terms that work for the partner and for Amazon, with a clear view of what each term means for sales, margin and long-term value.
- Grow the partner base. Build the case for, and bring on, new retail partners in the region, including in Switzerland. Own the business case, the commercial terms, the onboarding and the launch plan for each, so that new partners reach the customer quickly and profitably.
- Launch with impact. Coordinate go-to-market for new products and major events. This includes shaping launch timelines around retail channel requirements and making sure the plan is carried out well across stores and online.
- Drive performance with data. Review sales, inventory, forecasts, margin and promotional performance with the partner on a regular rhythm. Spot opportunities and risks early, and agree clear actions with the partner and Amazon’s internal teams.
- Run business reviews. Prepare and lead regular business reviews with the partners, and write the plans, forecasts and narratives behind them for Amazon's senior leaders. Use the reviews to move long-term initiatives forward and to deepen the collaboration.
- Represent Amazon, and represent the partner at Amazon. Present our devices and our plans to senior audiences with strong product knowledge. Bring the partner's priorities, and its customers' feedback, back to our product, marketing and supply chain teams.
- Test, learn and share. Pilot new in-store and online merchandising and marketing ideas with the partner. Scale what works, share lessons with Retail colleagues in other EU markets, and mentor colleagues who are earlier in their careers.
- Innovate and simplify, with AI. We are using AI to change how we work: automating recurring reporting and analysis, simplifying planning, and cutting the manual steps between a good idea and its execution. You will try new approaches, keep the ones that work, and help the team do the same. The aim is for more of your time to go to the partner and to long-term strategy, and less to routine tasks.
- Work across Amazon. Partner with Product, Channel Marketing, Supply Chain and Planning, Finance and Legal teams to deliver for the partners.

A day in the life
You might start the morning with a review of last week's sales and promotional performance, and send a partner's category team two priorities for the coming week. Before lunch you could be in a store with a partner's regional team, looking at how a new display performs against what customers actually do. In the afternoon you might be with colleagues from Marketing and Supply Chain, finalising the launch plan for a new device. Later you could be reviewing margin and promotional spend against plan with Finance, or on a call with a partner to align on next quarter's joint plan. The mix changes week to week, and so do the priorities. Some days are execution-focused: running the plan, solving problems with the partners and the field team, and making sure launches land. Other days are deeply strategic, spent on long-term planning for the partnerships and where they should be in two or three years. You will be comfortable moving between the two, and you will decide how to spend your time based on where you can create the most value for customers and for the partnerships.

About the team
Amazon Devices designs and builds products that customers use every day to read, watch, learn, stay connected and manage their homes, from Echo and Fire TV to Kindle and many more. Our Retail team in EU takes those products to customers where they like to shop, working in close partnership with retailers to deliver a great experience in stores and online.

You will join a team that values curiosity, high standards and sharing what works. We are a diverse group of people from different countries, backgrounds and ways of thinking. We invent, we simplify, and we hold ourselves and each other to a high bar. If you want to help build something new in a fast-moving business and are comfortable taking considered risks, Amazon Devices is a place where you can do your best work.

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German at C2 level
- Experience in account management, key account management, sales or retail partnerships, in consumer electronics, technology or a comparable retail category
- Experience using data to analyse omni-channel sales performance (i.e. physical stores, e-commerce), make recommendations and agree next steps with stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in product, program, or project management leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
- Experience managing strategic accounts across more than one country, ideally in Germany, Austria and Switzerland
- Knowledge of consumer electronics or smart home retail, including how physical stores and online channels work together
- Experience building the business case for, and onboarding, new retail or distribution partners
- Experience owning a P&L, or accountability for margin, trade terms and promotional investment, with a record of making sound trade-offs between growth and profitability

title: GEO editor, Amazon News
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is hiring an experienced GEO editor for the Amazon News website (AboutAmazon.com) to lead our evergreen story archive program. You will develop and execute a plan to 2X our archive of GEO/SEO-driven evergreen content, grow organic search traffic, support content creation, and help shape how Amazon News content surfaces across an increasingly AI-driven discovery landscape. You will coordinate closely with editorial and business communications teams to identify and prioritize these stories, edit and optimize content so it performs well in GEO, and lead the content creation process. Your focus will be on ensuring Amazon’s narrative is accurately represented, discoverable, and cited across LLMs such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

This role requires deep AI search engine optimization knowledge, strong editorial expertise, and the ability to work cross-functionally with editorial, communications, and technical teams across a global organization. This person must also be data-driven and be able to develop tactics to drive business goals, engagement, and reach. The ideal candidate is analytical, curious about AI, an effective storyteller, and thinks about content first — diving into GEO data to identify content opportunities that are both compelling for readers and optimized for machines.

This role is part of the Amazon News team, which sits within Amazon’s Communications & Corporate Responsibility org. Amazon News serves as the first and most trusted source of news and information about Amazon for external audiences. We help customers understand what Amazon is doing globally — from fostering a great workplace and driving innovation to supporting small business and sustainability. We tell the larger story of who Amazon is through compelling content on AboutAmazon.com and our off-platform distribution channels such as our email newsletter.

This is an individual contributor role based in New York, NY.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the GEO/SEO evergreen story archive, owning the editorial roadmap and prioritization for which stories to build, refresh, or optimize.
• Partner with editorial and business communications teams to identify, coordinate, and shape evergreen stories, aligning on goals, priorities, timelines, and messaging.
• Apply GEO best practices to content structure, framing, and language so stories perform in generative engines while remaining compelling and accurate for human readers.
• Experiment with and adopt emerging AI tools and workflows to scale GEO content production.
• Monitor and optimize how these evergreen stories surface in AI chatbots such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, including tracking citations and visibility.
• Develop and maintain editorial standards, guidelines, and best practices for GEO across the Amazon News content ecosystem.
• Use dedicated SEO tools (such as Google Search Console, SEMRush, Sistrix, Screaming Frog) and GEO tools (Scrunch, WriteSonic).
• Understand customer search and AI discovery behavior and provide guidance to teams to help them meet customers where they are.
• Develop and implement link and traffic building strategies.
• Stay current on industry trends, competitor techniques, and best practices across SEO, GEO, and AI-driven content discovery.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 4+ years of search engine optimization experience, with a track record of increasing organic traffic.
- 4+ years of editorial or content development experience.
- 4+ years of experience in marketing, journalism, or related fields.
- 2+ years of experience with Excel including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data manipulation.
- Familiarity with how LLMs surface and cite content, and strategies to improve AI discoverability.
- Experience working cross-functionally with editorial, communications, or marketing teams to coordinate and deliver content.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong story judgment and a genuine interest in storytelling.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize a high-volume content pipeline against clear targets.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in SEO/GEO within a journalism or media organization, with a strong track record of using search insights to shape and optimize editorial content.
- Experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) tools (e.g. Profound, ScrunchAI, Writesonic) — including tracking and optimizing content visibility in AI-powered tools and LLMs.
- Familiarity with SEO and data tools, including SEMRush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics, and Content Management Systems.
- Experience working at a global company managing international, multi-language projects.
- Demonstrated fluency with AI tools to accelerate content development, editing, and day-to-day work — with sound judgment about where AI adds value and where it does not.
- Proven track record assuming ownership, moving quickly to implement ideas, and delivering results and in a fast-paced online environment.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Within AIS and Data Center Engineering, the Mechanical Products & Services (MPS) team is driving rapid innovation in Mechanical Cooling and Controls systems used by AWS. Our designs are fundamentally changing the Data Center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business, and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to engage with and lead the Sustaining or Product Lifecycle Engineering aspect for these advanced cloud infrastructure solutions and the exceptional people that develop them.

AWS is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to be part of a global engineering team responsible for ownership and continuous improvement related to Mechanical (Cooling) infrastructure products within our rapidly expanding data center footprint.

We are looking for engineers with hands on Mechanical and Manufacturing experience of Mechanical (Cooling) products. If you have experience leading product design of Mechanical products, have an understanding of Mechanical Systems, and know how products should be manufactured to ensure quality you may be a good fit. You should be capable of understanding detailed Mechanical equipment specifications and evaluating the merit and risks of design changes.

title: NW Deployment Build Lead I, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
We are a collaborative network infrastructure group within Global Network Delivery dedicated to expanding and optimizing our technological capabilities. Our team values precision, innovation, and proactive partnership. We work together to develop scalable solutions that support our organization's growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can develop your skills and advance your career. You'll collaborate closely with network engineers, technical project managers, and stakeholders across the organization to deliver infrastructure solutions that matter.

You'll drive the complete lifecycle of network infrastructure projects—from planning through execution—solving complex connectivity challenges that keep our global operations running smoothly. In this role, you'll collaborate across teams to design, validate, and deploy network solutions at scale, ensuring our infrastructure supports continued growth and innovation.


Key job responsibilities
Manage project lifecycles for network infrastructure initiatives including late binding, recabling, network scaling, and expansion projects from planning through completion
Configure and troubleshoot network hardware, fiber optic connectivity, cabling infrastructure, and routing issues across diverse data center environments
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to conduct resource assessments, coordinate vendor execution, and resolve project roadblocks
Develop and maintain documentation including cut sheets, labels, change management procedures, and operational guidelines to support project execution and knowledge sharing
Coordinate hardware deployments and upgrades while ensuring compliance with safety protocols and change management procedures

A day in the life
Your focus will be on managing network infrastructure projects that span late binding, recabling, network scaling, and expansion initiatives. You'll spend your time configuring fiber optic connectivity, coordinating hardware deployments across data centers, and troubleshooting interconnectivity issues to keep projects on track. Throughout your day, you'll work with change management systems and ticketing platforms, collaborate with network engineering teams and vendors, and participate in planning sessions to remove roadblocks. You'll validate technical documentation, oversee equipment installations, and engage in cross-functional problem-solving to ensure successful project delivery.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, Data Center Operations, or Technical Project Management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- 2+ years of computer layer 1/2 networking (including troubleshooting and repair) experience
- 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

Preferred qualifications

- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

title: Principal, HRBP, HR AMZ Leo
descriptionHtml:
Leo is an initiative to increase broadband access through a constellation of satellites in low Earth orbit. Their goal is to provide fast, reliable, affordable internet to unserved and under-served places around the world. We’re investing in new technology that will impact millions of customers globally, including households, small businesses, and organizations. From designing satellite management systems to building solar panels, we create solutions that make technology more accessible. We’re aiming high. We want to help change the aerospace industry and close the global digital divide.

The Leo PXT team is looking for a talented and strategic Principal HRBP to help the Leo Technology teams develop and execute HR strategies that enable business priorities and foster the employee experience. As the Principal HRBP, this role will have to plan and execute work that touches all aspects of this unique business, from building workforce infrastructure to providing leadership coaching and driving HR functional excellence. We are seeking an experienced Principal HRBP who can effectively interact with the senior leadership team, possesses excellent communication skills, strong business acumen, and works effectively across multiple geographies.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
• Develop and implement people plans and solutions that enable the business to meet their goals.
• Partner with Vice Presidents, Directors, and their leadership teams to develop the talent strategy needed to support our tremendous growth, and build a work environment where all employees can thrive and grow.
• Partner with central HR partner teams and COEs (compensation, talent acquisition, employee relations) to implement policies, programs, and scalable solutions aligned with business needs.
• Function as a strategic consultant to key leaders and their organizations; translate business needs into HR plans through active participation in strategic planning.
• Lead Organization and Leadership Reviews focused on succession planning, talent development, and organizational health priorities.
• Partner with the business on organizational design, workforce planning, and skills assessment and development.
• Review and analyze business metrics including data on retention and employee experience to recommend systemic improvements.
• Build systemic and scalable recruiting programs in partnership with the Leo talent acquisition team to create a sustainable pipeline of talent.


A day in the life
Work with executive leadership team to develop and implement organizational initiatives and solutions at scale.
Define people goals that are based on business drivers and tied to strategic priorities of the business.
Earn trust as a partner to the extended PXT leadership locally and regionally/globally.
Partner with business leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and skills assessment and development.
Review and analyze business metrics including data on retention and employee experience in order to recommend systemic improvements.
Partner with the business to lead both annual and mid-year review processes which focus on performance management and talent development.


About the team
The Leo PXT team is a highly cross functional team. Given our startup nature, we work very closely across our COE (compensation, talent acquisition, employee relations, etc.) and international teams to present one people view to the business. It's also a very mission-based organization where we get to be an intimate partner to bring that mission alive.
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of Redmond, WA only.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 10+ years of leadership work as an HR generalist, preferably in a high tech environment experience
- Experience working with global teams, driving organizational change initiatives, and developing talent management plans for a global organization
- Experience with high quality document preparation and presentation
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in human resources
- Experience building and leading teams in a matrix/managed culture
- Experience coaching and delivering messages related to performance to direct reports and support teams
- Experience in senior level leadership support, or experience with end-to-end project management
- Experience communicating clearly and effectively with different functional groups including senior business leaders, finance, HR and developers

title: Customer Solutions Manager, Media & Entertainment, Media & Entertainment
descriptionHtml:
You will be a trusted advisor to your customer. You will leverage your program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand your customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges, and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through the obstacles.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
You will take end-to-end ownership of a diverse range of projects and initiatives, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi disciplinary teams (sales, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, partners). The Customer Solutions Manager role is responsible for cloud transformational programs (technical, operational, organizational, education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.

With a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions, driving innovation, and delivering successful migration programs.

In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solutions Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued.

Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, be detail driven, and have experience in managing virtual teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity and work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer.


Key job responsibilities
a) Co-Innovation - integrations between customer and AWS products or co-developing a new product. Examples include integrating Cisco SDWAN with AWS CloudWAN for one-click hybrid network deployments, onboarding 3rd party models on Bedrock, putting Factset API/MCP generated narratives and DataDog's Bedrock observability platform on AWS Marketplace to streamline workflows and enhance security capabilities.
b) Migration of the customer solution or ISV customer from external source (including 3rd party tools) to AWS (e.g., migration of on-prem database to AWS, migration from Genesys to Amazon Connect, migration from OpenAI to Bedrock, or from cloud provider ,e.g., Azure, to AWS).
c) Modernization of the existing customer solutions on AWS (e.g., modernizing the application to run on Graviton, modernizing from CockroachDB hosted on EC2 to Aurora, moving AI models from EC2 to SageMaker)
d) New Build - enabling the customer to develop a new product on AWS from scratch or jointly developing a new AWS service (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform on AWS, Trimble's design collaboration assistant or SonicWall's security management system)
e) Optimization – improving the existing workload to maximize efficiency, enhance performance and/or reduce cost. (e.g., cost optimization through waste removal, rightsizing EC2 and RDS instances, implementing S3 tiering strategies) to increase customer value.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 5+ years of work in enterprise IT, either as a vendor, consultant or have prior experience working with or managing technical programs experience
- Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Math, or a related field
- Experience in leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
- Experience working in enterprise IT, either as a vendor, consultant or have prior experience working with or managing technical programs
- Experience in customer-facing roles

Preferred qualifications

- AWS or other cloud certification
- Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery or IT lifecycle
- Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements

title: Pricing and Costing Manager, Business Product and Program Management
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at any time and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide.
The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
The Prime Video Store team is seeking a passionate, customer obsessed and data-driven Pricing & Costing Manager based in London to drive program delivery that will shape our pricing, costing & royalties operations and strategy in existing territories and in support of the expansion of Prime Video’s TVOD (Transactional Video on Demand) offering into new international markets.

Key job responsibilities
- Supporting roll out and scaling of operations to new and existing marketplaces.
- Shaping and refining pricing, costing and royalties strategy for multiple international marketplaces and content types.
- Ownership of core pricing, costing and royalty payment processes and relevant escalations, focusing on accuracy, controllership and operational efficiency.
- Proactive investigation and root cause analysis of trends seen in business metrics, targeted deep dives or marketplace studies.
- Build strong relationships with the VM, CAM, Finance, BI, and Tech/Product teams to maintain focus on addressing the most critical issues, and using this to inform product and program management that resolves them.
- Usage and identification of correct data to develop robust, scalable and automated processes to enable greater efficiency and business growth.
- Identify opportunities for data analyses and share informed insight & recommendations to drive strategic changes or automation/optimization of core processes.
- Delivery on critical projects to tight/hard deadlines, and comfortable prioritising tasks.
- Ownership of key pricing, costing and royalties metrics and reporting.

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role - we are reactive to the needs of our business and our customers, balance our time across the many distinct parts of pricing, costing and royalties, and work hard to optimise our processes to support the business as it grows now and in future. Our time can be spent on data analysis, operations automation and process improvement, tool/feature enhancement or strategic international document-writing.
Our work overlaps with Vendor Manager, Finance, Accounting, Tech, Product, Ops and Support teams, and the wider Prime Video business teams.

About the team
The team is comprised of folks from multiple backgrounds, skillsets and career-experience, showcasing that there is no 'one-type' of person who can add to our business and succeed in role.
Our environment is entrepreneurial and fast-paced and requires someone who is flexible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working effectively in a deadline-driven work environment. It is still firmly Day 1 for the Prime Video business.

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience defining and executing program requirements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions

title: Senior Construction Safety Manager, WHS Construction Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a Senior WHS Construction Manager to own construction safety across a region. In this role you set construction-safety standards and programs, hold vendors accountable across multiple concurrent projects, and drive compliance from contractual agreement through project close-out. You develop the standard operating procedures that scale safe construction across the network.

Key job responsibilities
- Own construction-safety standards and programs across a region and multiple concurrent projects.
- Establish and enforce H&S compliance within vendor contractual agreements.
- Develop standard operating procedures that scale safe construction across the network.
- Run vendor business reviews and use data and metrics to drive continuous improvement.
- Present regional construction-safety performance and risk to senior stakeholders.

A day in the life
You own the construction-safety agenda for a region spanning multiple countries and projects. Your day mixes program work - writing standards and SOPs, running vendor business reviews, analysing safety performance - with hands-on judgement on the highest-risk construction activity. You partner with commercial, project and vendor leaders to build safety into contractual agreements, and you present regional safety performance and risk to senior stakeholders. You set the approach that construction managers and vendors across the region follow.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in engineering (electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial).
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (C1), both written and verbal.
- Track record of implementing safety standards across construction projects.
- Experience owning construction-safety programs and managing vendors/contractors across multiple sites.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Membership of a professional body in the field of occupational health and safety.
- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- Degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. Construction Management, Civil/Structural Engineering, Health & Safety).
- NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
descriptionHtml:
Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.

The Mission
Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.

What You'll Build
You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.

Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.

This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

What We're Looking For

* Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models
* Track record of building scalable ML systems
* Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
* Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us.



Key job responsibilities
The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you'll lead the scientific vision for end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—pioneering algorithms that eliminate false information, designing frameworks that hunt down vulnerabilities before bad actors find them, and developing models that understand human values across every culture we serve. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll push the boundaries of model training, building agentic AI systems that coordinate multiple autonomous agents to solve complex safety challenges—transforming bold research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily while withstanding attacks and delivering exceptional experiences.

But here's what makes this role truly special: you'll shape the future. You'll lead efforts to identify, define, and mitigate risks early—protecting customers before they're impacted—and mentor the next generation of AI safety experts. You'll design multi-agent architectures where distributed AI systems exhibit emergent collective intelligence while maintaining human oversight and control. Every innovation you drive—from consensus-driven reasoning frameworks to sophisticated orchestration patterns—will set new standards for trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.

A day in the life
As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values.


About the team
Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Worldwide Grocery Stores-Tech (WWGST)
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build technology that changes how Amazon's physical grocery stores run? Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores-Tech (WWGST), Stores UTR Tech (UTRT) team is looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager to lead complex programs that span multiple teams across this charter. You'll own programs from the first idea to deployment across the network. You'll work closely with engineering, science, product, store operations, finance, and outside partners. You'll turn broad goals into clear technical plans and get teams delivering on them. And you'll explain tradeoffs and progress to senior leadership. This role has a lot of ownership, and its impact shows up directly in store floors, operator workflows, and the customer experience.

Stores UTR Tech (UTRT) invents the technology behind Amazon's physical store and food production operations. Our goal is to make store operations intelligent and effortless, so operators can focus on serving customers instead of working around systems, and every customer gets an excellent grocery shopping experience.

Our charter covers the full life of store operations. That includes inbound and receiving, inventory accuracy and cycle counts, labor and task orchestration, issue escalation, and food production. We build first-party platforms, connect them with partner technology, and deploy them across a growing network of stores. The goals are to cut cost-to-serve and operational complexity sharply, and to improve both convenience and quality for customers.

This Sr. TPM leads one or more multi-team technical programs within the UTRT charter. You'll own the program strategy, roadmap, architecture alignment, dependency and risk management, and the rollout across the store network. The right person can go deep with engineers on system design and integration choices. They're just as comfortable working with store operations leaders to make sure the technology works on the floor and delivers measurable business results.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end delivery of complex technical programs across the UTRT charter, from defining requirements through pilot, network rollout, and ongoing operation.
- Work with engineering, applied science, and product teams to define system requirements, architecture, APIs, and integration points across store systems, enterprise platforms (such as inventory, financial, and labor systems), and partner technology.
- Turn business goals and operator pain points into technical roadmaps, milestones, and success criteria. Write and contribute to PR/FAQs, BRDs, and planning documents (OP1/OP2, 3-year plans).
- Manage cross-team and cross-organization dependencies, the critical path, and risks. Raise blockers early and push them to resolution.
- Plan and run pilots and multi-site rollouts, including deployment playbooks, store readiness, change management, training, and post-launch stabilization.
- Design integration approaches so that partner-provided capabilities fit cleanly into our first-party platforms and data models.
- Set up and run program mechanisms: weekly business reviews, monthly progress reviews, gate reviews, and risk registers. Report clearly to senior leadership.
- Define and track program KPIs, such as inventory accuracy, labor productivity, cost-to-serve, system reliability, and adoption, and use the data to make tradeoff and prioritization decisions.
- Work with operations, finance, food safety, and compliance partners so that regulatory, audit, and financial controls are built into systems from the start.
- Raise the TPM bar across the organization by building scalable processes, sharing best practices, and mentoring other program managers.

About the team
Stores UTR Tech (UTRT) builds the technology behind Amazon's physical grocery stores and food production operations. Our vision is to make store operations intelligent and effortless, so operators can focus on customers instead of systems and every customer has a great grocery shopping experience.

We own technology across the whole life of store operations: inbound and receiving, inventory accuracy and cycle counts, labor and task orchestration, issue escalation, and food production. We're a cross-functional team of technical program managers, product managers, software engineers, and scientists. We build first-party platforms, connect them with partner technology, and roll them out across a growing network of stores. Our goals are to lower cost-to-serve and operational complexity for store operators, and to give customers a better experience in both convenience and quality.

We work closely with store operators, so the technology we ship shows up quickly on the store floor and in how customers shop. Our team values ownership, writing things down clearly, and moving quickly when the path isn't clear.

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

Preferred qualifications

title: Principal Program Manager, ASCS Product & Tech
descriptionHtml:
Ready to help build Amazon's next major business?

Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) brings together Amazon Shipping, Amazon Freight, and Multi-Channel Fulfillment to transform how businesses move goods through Amazon's logistics and transportation network.

We're evolving Amazon's fulfillment and transportation capabilities into an agile, intelligent supply chain network that helps businesses move products with greater speed, reliability, and efficiency. By connecting capabilities across Shipping, Freight, and Multi-Channel Fulfillment, we're creating a resilient system that continuously optimizes to deliver for every business and every customer.

Every shipment and fulfillment interaction strengthens the flywheel, enhancing our network through scale, density, and intelligence. As we expand our reach, we're building services for businesses beyond Amazon while simultaneously strengthening Amazon's own transportation and fulfillment capabilities, reducing costs and accelerating delivery across the broader ecosystem.

We're hiring a Principal Program Manager who will enhance our ability to deliver customer value with speed and predictability. Your mission is to create clear pathways for teams to rapidly transform customer needs into working solutions while maintaining transparency across our organization. You'll design and implement lightweight mechanisms for regular planning, goal-setting, and portfolio management that accelerate our ability to respond to customer feedback and market opportunities. You'll partner with product and engineering teams across ASCS to establish consistent frameworks that drive accountability while preserving the creativity and autonomy teams need to deliver great outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
Design and execute quarterly planning, OP1/OP2, and goal-setting processes that connect customer needs with team-level execution, resource allocation, and technical roadmaps across ASCS.
Lead the Portfolio Review Board process, providing regular visibility into at-risk projects, emerging issues, and cross-team dependencies while driving data-informed decisions that optimize for customer impact.
Coordinate Entitlement Attribution, ensuring consistent calculation and forecasting of resource utilization across customer-facing initiatives, and partner with finance and leadership to align resource allocations with growth objectives.
Build and refine lightweight planning and reporting mechanisms that surface the right information to the right stakeholders, remove barriers to delivery, and continuously improve based on team feedback and evolving business needs.
Drive cross-functional alignment by authoring clear written updates for senior leadership, facilitating decision-making around customer priorities, and partnering with product, engineering, and operations leaders to keep planning processes focused on outcomes.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing portfolio health and emerging dependencies before working with teams to unblock an at-risk initiative or refine plans for an upcoming quarterly planning cycle. Later, you could be preparing a concise update for senior leadership, aligning capacity assumptions with Finance, or simplifying one of our planning mechanisms to make it more effective. The common thread is creating clarity across a complex organization, helping teams make better decisions quickly, and ensuring we turn customer needs into predictable delivery without adding unnecessary process.

About the team
You'll join a collaborative team at the heart of Amazon Supply Chain Services, working across Product, Technology, Operations, and Finance to help bring together Amazon Shipping, Amazon Freight, and Multi-Channel Fulfillment. The team operates across a broad, fast-moving portfolio, partnering closely with senior leaders and delivery teams to create clarity on priorities, resources, risks, and dependencies. We're focused on building simple, scalable mechanisms that help teams move faster, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how ASCS plans, prioritizes, and delivers as the business continues to grow.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality

Amazonの先進的なロジスティクスシステムが運用されているラストマイル配送倉庫(デリバリーステーション)の1つに配属されます。注文の発送や配達がされると、ご案内が必要な場合に倉庫、アソシエイト、配送サービスパートナー、そしてお客様と連絡をとることになります。お客様が配達の再スケジュールが必要な場合、配送サービスパートナーに伝達します。配送問題を発見した際には、お客様がAmazonに連絡しなくても素晴らしい体験ができるよう、すぐにそれを解決します。

descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Manager is a key strategic partner on the PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

You will drive operational excellence through strategic leadership at your site(s), translating priorities into actionable plans while leveraging technology and data to enhance decision-making. Leading a diverse team of HR professionals, you'll balance automation with human insight to drive excellence throughout the employee lifecycle. Success demands operational excellence, leadership presence, and the ability to connect strategic vision to execution.

The HR Manager leads and is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health through strategic PXT leadership and effective people management. They strengthen culture and deliver business results by translating organizational priorities into actionable plans through their site’s PXT function. HR Managers execute business goals through hands-on leadership and data-driven decision making, while partnering with business leaders to improve leadership effectiveness and employee experience.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.

Key job responsibilities

Guide your team in ensuring practices comply with company policies, procedures, and federal, state, and provincial laws or regulations, while fostering their professional growth and expertise.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic leadership and hands-on people management, requiring excellent organizational and interpersonal skills to manage multiple priorities. Using cutting-edge AI-powered analytics and data insights, you'll identify trends and opportunities in areas like attrition, attendance, and engagement. You'll collaborate closely with business leaders, providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong relationships across all levels of the organization. Through these partnerships, you'll drive initiatives that enhance employee experience and strengthen cultural health.

From coaching leadership teams to implementing innovative HR technologies, you'll balance technical expertise with human judgment in complex situations. In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the opportunity to create sustainable improvements and meaningful impact across your site and broader organization, helping build a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to perform at their best.

title: Principal Engineer & Senior Principal Engineer, AWS Infrastructure Services
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Principal Engineers and Senior Principal Engineers to join AWS Network Services.
We meet our customers at the scale of quadrillions of transactions per second across every layer of connected applications. Our millions of customers, from single-developer startups to the largest companies in the world, rely on us to present their business to the world — seamlessly, without limits. We make use of innovative virtualization technology to make connectivity magical.
We don't build on top of the cloud. We build what the cloud is built on.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, protocols, hardware, and security, and every system we ship goes straight into production, powering the world’s most demanding workloads. Nothing we build sits on a shelf.

You won't be tuning knobs on an existing system. You'll be deciding what the system is. As a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the systems that make AWS possible where microseconds matter and billions of dollars of customer workloads depend on your decisions.
Here, great products start with Engineering. Principal Engineers work in close partnership with Product Management. You’ll propose new products born from deep technical insight and help shape and sharpen ideas. The roadmap grows with its Principal Engineers, so the systems you invent become the products customers rely on.



Key job responsibilities
Among the areas we’re hiring for today:
• Compute Connectivity: Deliver scale, security, and simplicity. Enable customers to focus on their applications and maximize their compute efficiency, while the connectivity underneath just works.
• Real-Time Media: Real-Time Media: Build the infrastructure for sub-second, bidirectional video and audio delivery at global scale, spanning interactive live streaming, AI-integrated experiences, real-time AI voice agents, and physical AI
• Security & Threat Defense: Ensure that connectivity brings only good to our customers' businesses. Innovate across traffic classification, adversarial defense, and application protection so that trust in AWS is never in question.
• Moving the Bytes that Move the World: AWS connectivity solutions power the largest companies in the world and provide critical support to governments. Other AWS services rely on our solutions too and even small features can support headline-driving events.
• VPC Core — Cross-Plane Networking Architecture: Turn customer and AWS-service intent into working network state across the planes that record it, deliver it, and enforce it in hardware. Own the contracts and scale models between those planes so a change that’s right in one never breaks another and keep VPC scaling as fast as the services built on it.



About the team
Our team sits at the intersection of the most critical trends in cloud infrastructure — AI-scale infrastructure, real-time media at global scale, intelligent threat defense, and the reinvention of internet-scale identity and trust.

Our services, including Amazon Route 53, AWS Direct Connect, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS PrivateLink, Elemental Media Services, AWS Interactive Video Service, Amazon GameLift, AWS Cloudfront, AWS Transit Gateway — take on systems challenges few teams anywhere must solve.
You know these problems because you've lived them - building and operating at this scale - and now you get to define what comes next.

We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where different perspectives drive better solutions and the best ideas win regardless of where they originate. We ship fast and iterate with purpose, and we believe work should be meaningful. You'll join a team that takes pride in building the foundation the rest of the cloud runs on.

Basic qualifications

• 15+ years of professional software development experience
• Experience owning technical architecture, end-to-end delivery, and partnering with senior leadership
• Track record of leading multiple concurrent technical initiatives and driving decisions across organizational boundaries
• Experience influencing VP/SVP-level technical and business strategy
• Deep expertise in at least one domain: real-time transport protocols (WebRTC, QUIC), DNS, distributed systems, network architecture, web security, game backend systems, large-scale packet processing, or cloud virtual networking and data-plane systems (e.g. VPC-style resource/distribution control, SmartNIC/DPU or Nitro-class pipelines)
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Go, or Java

Preferred qualifications

• Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
