title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview)

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High School Diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

title: Responsable Maintenance Industrielle (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon gère l'un des réseaux logistiques les plus sophistiqués au monde. Au coeur de ce réseau, nos centres de tri orchestrent chaque jour le mouvement de millions de colis entre nos sites logistiques et nos agences de livraison.

L'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) est le pilier technique qui rend cette promesse possible : sans équipements fiables, pas de colis livrés à temps. En tant que Responsable Maintenance pour notre centre de tri d'Orléans, vous dirigerez une équipe de techniciens et superviseurs dans un environnement à la pointe de la technologie, où maintenance préventive ultra sophistiquée, systèmes de tri automatisés et innovations facilitées par l'intelligence artificielle se conjuguent pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle.

Si vous adorez les challenges et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur des millions de clients, ce rôle est fait pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
- Promouvoir une culture de sécurité exemplaire : accompagner votre équipe dans le respect rigoureux des politiques et procédures de sécurité (notamment LOTO), animer les initiatives de sensibilisation (toolbox talks, Technician Safety Week), et maintenir notre objectif de zéro incident grave sur votre site
- Développer et faire évoluer les talents de votre équipe : diriger, coacher et accompagner les techniciens, superviseurs et apprentis dans leur progression de carrière, participer aux programmes RMEO et d'apprentissage, et célébrer les contributions exceptionnelles de vos collaborateurs

- Piloter l'amélioration continue et l'innovation : collecter et analyser les données pour identifier les opportunités d'optimisation, mener des projets Kaizen/QCC en collaboration avec les équipes internationales, et standardiser les meilleures pratiques à l'échelle du réseau
- Mener à bien des projets au niveau du site et du réseau, collaborer avec les fournisseurs tiers et les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME), et élaborer des plans opérationnels pour améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité

- Connaissance des outils d'analyse de données et des systèmes de contrôle basés sur des automates programmables (PLC)

descriptionHtml:

• Operational Analysis: Collect, analyze, and report qualitative and quantitative performance data, driving continuous improvements through data-driven decisions.
• Training and Development: Provide support and guidance to partners, promoting good operational practices, and fostering their growth within the Amazon culture.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with central teams (Legal, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and Central Team) to maintain alignment with national policies, processes, and objectives.
• Incident Management: Address and resolve operational incidents (lost packages, returns, low performance, etc.), ensuring operational continuity and customer satisfaction.

A day in the life
The HubDP Specialist drives the relation and communication with legal and tax team to ensure requirements and controlling all the micro-entrepreneurs, that are interested in joining Amazon program are met. The HubDP Specialist leads the analysis on quality and inventory metrics that affect directly to the customer’s satisfaction, providing visibility of the partner’s performance. The person on this position requires strong skills in qualitative and quantitative analysis to deep dive into the delivery standard metrics, implement actions and initiatives that help to improve the performance of the HDP program and achieve program goals.

Successful candidates will think like business owners and drive results by building solutions on behalf of our customers. They love innovation and enjoy interacting with leaders. They will be resourceful, customer-focused; team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work with some of the region's largest and most influential organisations in Financial Services, Retail, Travel & Hospitality, and Media. These are enterprises with complex technology estates, demanding regulatory and operational requirements, and big ambitions for what the cloud and AI can unlock next.

This is a role for a trusted technical advisor. You will earn a seat at the table with senior business and technology leaders and understand the business priorities behind their technology decisions. You will design architectures that help them scale, modernise, and innovate. That could mean migrating and modernising mission-critical workloads, building enterprise-grade data and analytics platforms, or moving generative AI and machine learning from proof of concept to production at scale. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and AI/ML.

You will partner with customers to shape their cloud strategy around business outcomes: speeding up time-to-market, unlocking new revenue streams, improving operational efficiency and resilience, and building the digital foundation for long-term transformation. You will earn trust by showing technical credibility, working through complexity across large organisations, and delivering results that move the business forward.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with enterprise customers end-to-end. This means:

- Engaging customers to understand their business drivers for cloud adoption, assess their existing on-premises or multi-cloud landscape, and architect a credible path to AWS
- Building the technical case for AWS: total cost of ownership analyses, migration strategies, and proof-of-value engagements that deliver value.
- Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, migration runbooks, landing zone blueprints, and production-ready reference architectures. You lead by doing, not just advising.
- Helping customers envision and build with generative AI and machine learning — often as the catalyst that makes AWS the platform of choice by demonstrating what's uniquely possible with AWS AI/ML services.
- Partnering closely with Account Managers and Business Development to shape the go-to-market strategy for accounts — you are the technical credibility that converts pipeline into adoption.
- Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights from customers into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.
- Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, immersion days, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.
- You make the team stronger by mentoring fellow Solutions Architects — sharing what you know and helping others grow.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning in a technical workshop with a financial services customer exploring whether to lift-and-shift their core banking platform or re-architect on AWS, then pivot to a hands-on proof of concept helping a retail customer build on Amazon Bedrock. In the afternoon you might build a landing zone design for a customer that just signed their Enterprise Agreement, draft a migration playbook for a hospitality company, or join a call with an AWS service team to advocate for a feature that would unblock a key deal. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and the patience required to build trust with the urgency of a team that moves fast.


About the team
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience demonstrating technical breadth in AWS and/or cloud fundamentals
- - Experience designing landing zones, multi-account strategies, and governance frameworks for new adopters

title: Sr Regional, Pre-construction, GES
descriptionHtml:
The AMET Head of Pre-Construction leads the delivery of pre-construction( engineering design) phases for significant Customer Fulfillment "FC", delivery station "AMZL", sort center "SC" and quick commerce projects and conversions (6k-1MM sqf) across AMET countries, managing an annual investment portfolio exceeding USD 1 billion. This role drives projects from site selection, site evaluation, budget estimate, concept design, schematic design, detail design through construction readiness, ensuring launches meet Plan of Record requirements for timeline, quality, and financial targets while building a robust 3+ year pipeline to anticipate future capacity needs.
You will reduce business risk by analyzing and developing projects that define the next generation of high-performing fulfillment centers across AMET. Working at the intersection of real estate, design, and construction, you'll evaluate opportunities, influence strategic decisions, and establish the foundation for successful project execution. This role offers significant impact on AMET's infrastructure growth and the opportunity to develop future leaders by identifying and coaching talent within your team.


Key job responsibilities
Strategic Project Leadership: Lead pre-construction activities (site selection, site evaluation, budget estimate, concept design, schematic design, detail design) for complex projects, partnering with Design & Construction stakeholders and Real Estate teams to develop construction and site strategies that deliver optimal quality and business outcomes.
Risk Management & Analysis: Identify process improvements, analyze design conflicts, evaluate resources, and predict and mitigate risks throughout the pre-construction phase. Balance strategic initiative deployment with consistent project management leadership.
Critical Decision Making: Assess complex situations requiring leadership visibility and involvement. Apply sound judgment to navigate decisions, weighing risks and opportunities while determining appropriate escalation paths.
Team Leadership: Lead and drive cross-functional teams to deliver results and execute project deliverables independently. Participate in and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
Technical & Analytical Excellence: Apply analytical skills to navigate local regulations and customer requirements. Challenge current practices and develop innovative solutions that meet timelines, raise the bar, and exceed expectations.
Stakeholder Communication: Create and own written communications to business partners and stakeholders on pre-construction matters. Build collaborative, influential relationships within GES and with critical stakeholders inside and outside Amazon.
Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot issues independently and drive them to closure with minimal supervision. Navigate internal and external barriers while managing multicultural teams and facilitating stakeholder alignment.
Travel: Up to 50% travel across AMET region to support site evaluations and construction oversight.


A day in the life
As the AMET Head of Pre-Construction, you will represent Amazon GES in ensuring the successful delivery of pre-construction phases (site selection, site evaluation, budget estimate, concept design, schematic design, detail design) for Amazon's projects while strategically advancing processes, health & safety standards, and sustainability performance. You will lead and mentor large cross-functional teams, serving as the subject matter expert to guide projects from concept through construction readiness.
Your expertise will drive critical decisions on technical solutions, cost implications, and risk mitigation strategies that impact project safety and delivery timelines. You'll balance strategic oversight with hands-on engagement, ensuring your team delivers excellence while developing their capabilities for future leadership roles.
Daily activities include reviewing the pre-construction program with your team and key partner organizations, conducting site validations during the site selection process, performing due diligence assessments, managing design development, leading risk analysis, negotiating contracts and costs, and maintaining stakeholder alignment. You'll travel to sites during the evaluation process and provide construction oversight during critical project phases.
Strong communication skills are essential—you'll engage effectively with both frontline teams and executive leadership, translating complex technical concepts into clear business recommendations and ensuring alignment across all organizational levels.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in one or more of the following areas: construction or engineering project management, real estate development, or architecture/design
- 15+ years of experience in construction management, pre-construction management, or related disciplines with progressive leadership responsibility
- 10+ years leading development and pre-construction activities for logistics facilities, warehouses, industrial facilities, and/or critical infrastructure projects
- Bachelor's degree in Civil, Architecture, mechanical, industrial Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or Building Information Modeling (BIM), as well as scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)
- certification such as Professional Engineer (PE), LEED, or Certified Construction Manager (CCM)
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- French, German, Polish, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Chinese (Mandarin), Afrikaans and Zulu are considered preferred qualifications.
- Master's degree in Engineering, or related field

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.


Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites


A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machine issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.
Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day MHE and facilities maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.


About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or innovative tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship, or NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics
- Relevant experience as a qualified engineer
- Relevant experience working in mechanical and/or electrical maintenance
- Advanced proficiency in the local language verbally and in writing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in condition-based monitoring
- Experience working with print and apply machines
- Experience in fault-finding and maintaining conveyor or automation systems

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities
Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services
Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations
Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects
Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team
We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French at C1 level or above
- Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
- Right to work in France for the duration of the internship
- Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts

- Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
- Interest in or experience with generative AI, for example building with LLM APIs, agents or AI coding assistants
- Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)

title: Site Procurement Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Procurement Manager for the Amazon Fulfillment Center team, you will serve as the bridge between centralized Procurement and the building leadership. You will own the site’s indirect procurement operation responsibilities at a site level, including vendor management of 3rd party service providers, purchase order management, and inventory management. You will lead supplier management KPI and metrics reporting, and work with stakeholders to find and understand deviation and improvement areas. You will provide procurement leadership and align with the building leadership team to drive efficiencies and improvements at the site(s).

Key job responsibilities
• Provide procurement operations support for fulfillment centers, including managing suppliers (goods and services), non-inventory labor, flow and space models, cycle counts, inventory management, and procurement transactions.
• Ensure compliance with organizational KPIs, working with the non-inventory team to measure, control, and benchmark procurement processes.
• Develop expertise in non-inventory items and collaborate with similar buildings to implement best practices.
• Build relationships across the network, ensuring the sharing and implementation of best practices. This includes training teams such as Operations, Loss Prevention, PXT, Transportation, Facilities Management, and Safety on procurement processes.
• Work with internal teams, Finance, and Procurement Operations to understand budgetary targets and establish methods for measuring savings, value, and category metrics.
• Assist Finance and internal teams in determining budgets and managing blanket POs.
• Monitor supplier performance using tools such as supplier scorecards and Global Audit Tools for 3P suppliers. Collaborate with Category and Global Supplier Management to drive improvements across categories like janitorial, food service, pest control, landscaping, snow removal, water coolers, PPE, and waste management.
• Ensure 3P suppliers comply with site-level contracts and service terms, including SLA response times.
• Track and measure savings performance, developing action plans to meet goals and reduce waste in FC procurement processes. Standardize best practices across the network.
• Collaborate with both internal teams and suppliers to develop innovative procurement solutions that support Operations.
• Implement methods to track supplier performance and drive continuous improvement.
• Partner with AP, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve vendor payment issues promptly.
• Support Procure-to-Pay execution and local sourcing activities to meet business needs.
• Assist the centralized Procurement team (GPCS) and Global Procurement Organization (GPO) pillars, including ProcOps, Category, Supplier Diversity, Supplier Management, Procurement Excellence, Reusables, Technology, and PMO.
• Work in a warehouse environment, requiring frequent walking and adaptability to varying temperatures due to open dock doors.
• Other responsibilities as assigned by your manager
• This position requires regular travel to assigned site(s); travel distances may exceed 50 miles depending on business needs.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business, IT or any other procurement related career
- 1+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Experience with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with supplier or vendor relationship management
- Experience in procurement
- Experience with project management
- Experience in Coupa or other financial management/procurement software
- Experience with cost accounting
- Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma
- Must be highly self-motivated and customer-centric
- Ability to work with ambiguity
- Provide a positive customer experience internally and externally

title: Principal WW Partner Growth Specialist, Life Sciences, Partner Growth & Strategy(PG&S), Industry team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises accelerate business capabilities using information technology and powering the next generation of global industry leaders. Would you like to be part of a team focused on helping customers realize new value by transforming how they discover, develop, and deliver life-changing therapies and precision medicine?

AWS is seeking a Worldwide (WW) Partner Growth Specialist to accelerate our Life Sciences partner ecosystem across the full biopharma value chain — from genomic discovery and drug development through clinical trials, manufacturing, regulatory, and commercialization. This role is part of the Partner Growth & Strategy (PG&S) organization, which operates a dual motion model: Depth (deep engagement with named strategic partners) and Growth (scaling the broader ecosystem to drive net-new capability, revenue, and customer outcomes).

This is not a follow-the-playbook role. You will be building the growth engine for Life Sciences partners( Consulting and Technology) in a team that formed in 2026 and is actively defining its operating model. The strategy is clear — proactively sense demand, recruit the right partners, co-invest in capability, land with anchor customers, and scale — but how you execute will be shaped by your judgment, industry instinct, and ability to navigate ambiguity across a matrixed organization. If you need every process documented before you act, this is not the right fit. If you energize at the intersection of industry depth, partner economics, and senior leader influence — and you are comfortable being the one who writes the playbook — this is for you.


Key job responsibilities
Demand Signal Identification & Alignment
- Proactively identify, validate, and align industry demand signals across AWS , Industry & Specialist (I&S), Industry BUs, market trends, and key partners. Translate converging forces (agentic AI, federated data, precision medicine, regulatory change) into actionable partner investment theses that connect partner capability to customer urgency.
Plan Partner Capability — Recruit, Win P&L Owners, Co-Invest
- Identify and recruit the right partners to across the Life Sciences portfolio (9 solution areas ). Build executive-level relationships with partner P&L owners. Structure and execute co-investment in net-new capability, offerings, and solutions — from GSIs building agentic platforms to niche ISVs delivering specialized R&D tools.
Drive Revenue — GTM Packages, Anchor Customers, Field Handover
- Deliver and Guide end-to-end GTM packages: from solution definition and reference architectures through anchor customer engagements. Land lighthouse wins, then scale through campaigns, AWS Marketplace listings, and an agentic context/findability layer for field teams. Hand over successfully launched solutions to Partner Development Specialists/Managers for ongoing management.
Portfolio Management — Lifecycle, Relevance & Revenue
- Own the ongoing lifecycle of partner solutions in the Life Sciences portfolio. Monitor relevance, quality bar adherence, revenue contribution (LARR, pipeline, GenAI LARR), and APT attach rates. Make invest/scale/retire decisions using data. Ensure operational hygiene( AWS Solution Repository) so solutions are findable by field teams.
AWS Applied AI Service Interlock
- Serve as the industry connective tissue between AWS Applied AI services (Amazon Bio Discovery, HealthOmics, HealthLake, HealthImaging, Connect Health) and the partner ecosystem. Ensure partner build readiness for newly launched services, escalate feature requests, and champion partner integration as the last-mile for customer adoption.
Competency & Quality Bar Ownership
- Own Life Sciences Competency bar-raiser standards and Alchemy(AWS Internal solun. repository) quality gates. Validate partner offerings meet technical and industry requirements. Ensure the right partners are findable, qualified, and recommended to customers by field teams and agentic systems.
Scale Beyond Direct Coverage
- Design and execute mechanisms to extend impact from ~92 directly managed partners to 10,000+ through programmatic motions: Marketplace, field campaigns, startup/VC partner pathways, and agentic findability. Build self-service enablement that reduces dependence on direct human coverage for the long tail of the ecosystem.


A day in the life
In this role, a typical week might include: facilitating an Executive Briefing Center (EBC) session between a top pharma account and a GSI partner; pressure-testing a partner's agentic AI solution demo with specialist SAs; presenting a partner investment thesis to HCLS IBU leadership; recruiting a niche ISV into the Bio Discovery partner ecosystem; and troubleshooting a metadata/tagging gap that is blocking field findability for a high-value solution. No two weeks look the same — and that is intentional.

About the team
This position is part of the PG&S Team within the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C-level)
- 7+ years working across the Life Sciences value chain — spanning at least 2 of: R&D/Drug Discovery, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs/Manufacturing, and Commercialization — with demonstrated ability to translate industry dynamics into partner and business strategies
- 5+ years in Partner Management, Business Development, Strategic Alliances, or Consulting in Life Sciences or a related regulated industry — ideally in a matrixed organization where you influenced outcomes without owning every resource
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity: experience building new functions, programs, or coverage models from scratch — defining playbooks rather than inheriting them — in environments with evolving priorities, organizational change, and limited precedent
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level and holding your own in rooms with senior leaders who challenge assumptions
- Comfort presenting to both scientific/technical audiences (CSOs, Heads of R&D, VP Informatics) and business/commercial audiences (CFOs, P&L owners, Chief Strategy Officers)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with global teams and diverse partners
- Familiarity with agentic AI architectures and generative AI applications in life sciences — understanding how partner ecosystems deliver AI-native solutions at enterprise scale (e.g., clinical operations agents, commercial intelligence, regulatory automation)
- Experience with AWS HCLS Applied AI services (Amazon Bio Discovery, AWS HealthOmics, AWS HealthLake, AWS HealthImaging, Amazon Connect Health) or comparable cloud-based life sciences platforms
- Track record managing partner portfolios with a Depth vs. Growth segmentation lens — knowing when to double down, when to recruit, and when to retire
- Experience with Strategic Collaboration Agreements (SCAs), AWS Partner Transformation (APT), or similar joint investment vehicles with large consulting/technology partners
- Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements in life sciences (GxP, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ICH guidelines)
- Understanding of partner economics — how to win a partner's P&L owner and structure co-investment that aligns incentives and drives mutual accountability

descriptionHtml:

title: Business Intelligent Engineer II, Amazon Shipping
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.

We have built a highly respected BI and Data Engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will develop datasets, dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools, and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning within Amazon Shipping. Additionally, you will deliver across planned projects that will improve overall cost and profitability for the business.

Key job responsibilities
- Data Management and Integration: Collect, process, and manage large datasets from various sources, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.

- Data Analysis: Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business decisions.

- Reporting and Visualization: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present data insights in an understandable and actionable format.

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs, provide data-driven recommendations, and support strategic planning.

- Tool and Technology Utilization: Utilize and stay updated with the latest BI tools and technologies to enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about Generative AI (GenAI)? Do you want to help define the future of Go to Market (GTM) at AWS using generative AI? In this role, you will help some of our largest customers build and deploy GenAI enabled applications using Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, fine tune and build Generative AI models, and help enterprise customers leverage these models to power end applications. You will engage with AWS product owners to influence product direction and help our customers tap into new markets by utilizing GenAI along with AWS Services.

At Amazon, we’ve been investing deeply in artificial intelligence for over 20 years, and many of the capabilities customers experience in our products are driven by machine learning. Amazon.com’s recommendations engine is driven by machine learning (ML), as are the paths that optimize robotic picking routes in our fulfillment centers. Our supply chain, forecasting, and capacity planning are also informed by ML algorithms. Alexa is fueled by Natural Language Understanding and Automated Speech Recognition deep learning; as is Prime Air, and the computer vision technology in our new retail experience, Amazon Go. We have thousands of engineers at Amazon committed to machine learning and deep learning, and it’s a big part of our heritage.

AWS is looking for a Generative AI Solutions Architect who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for helping customers in designing solutions that leverage our Generative AI services. title: Data Scientist, CloudTune
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's eCommerce Foundation (eCF) organization provides the core technologies that drive and power Amazon's Stores, Digital, and Other (SDO) businesses. Millions of customer page views and orders per day are enabled by the systems eCF builds from the ground up. CloudTune, within eCF, empowers growth and business agility needs by automatically and efficiently managing AWS capacity and business processes needed to safely meet Amazon's customer demand. CloudTune serves its primary customers, internal software teams, through forecast-driven automation of cost controllership, capacity management, and scaling. We predict expected load, and drive procurement and allocation of AWS capacity for new product launches and high-velocity events like Prime Day and Cyber Monday.

CloudTune is looking for a Data Scientist to join our forecasting and optimization team. The team develops sophisticated algorithms that combine machine learning-based demand forecasting with mathematical optimization to solve large-scale capacity planning problems under uncertainty. We work with massive datasets — spanning thousands of availability zone and instance family combinations across global regions — to determine optimal resource allocation strategies that balance infrastructure holding costs against service availability requirements. These models directly inform multi-million dollar capacity investment decisions and drive automated procurement, retention, and release policies across Amazon's compute infrastructure.

As a Data Scientist in CloudTune, you will work with other scientists, software engineers, data engineers, and product managers on a variety of important research problems in the areas of stochastic optimization, time series modeling, and operations research. You will work on statistical problems with a high level of ambiguity. You will analyze and process large amounts of data, develop new algorithms and improve existing approaches based on statistical models, machine learning algorithms and big data solutions to automatically scale Amazon’s compute infrastructure, optimizing the balance between availability risk and cost efficiency for all of Amazon businesses.

Key job responsibilities
- Process and analyze large data sets, mining additional data sources as needed
- Build statistical models and drive scalable solutions for multi-year capacity demand forecasting horizons
- Create, enhance, and maintain technical documentation, and present to other scientists and business leaders
- Process and analyze large-scale operational data to identify patterns and inform model development
- Create, enhance, and maintain technical documentation, and present research findings to scientists, engineering teams, and senior leadership

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of data scientist experience
- 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
- 1+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience
- Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

Preferred qualifications

- Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
- Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
- Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
- Knowledge of relevant statistical measures such as confidence intervals, significance of error measurements, development and evaluation data sets, etc.

title: EU Head of Regulatory Approvals, Drone Delivery, EU/UK Regulatory Affairs Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is bringing drone delivery to Europe and needs someone to secure the approvals that make it legal to fly. You will own the EU regulatory approval programme end to end, from first authority conversation to authorisation granted.
You will be our named point of contact to EASA and national aviation authorities, sign our submissions, and own both the operational and the airworthiness sides of each application. You will build the safety cases, run the in-country consultants who support them, and carry the accountability they cannot. Success is authorisations in hand for our first European sites, strong authority relationships behind them, and a route to scaling across EU Member States after that.

Key job responsibilities
Own Operational Authorisation and airworthiness applications for EU site approvals, from scoping to grant.
Build and own relationships with EU National Aviation Authorities; sign submissions and represent Prime Air in authority meetings.
Act as Prime Air's EU airworthiness point of contact to EASA, working with the wider Regulatory Affairs and Engineering teams on design validation inputs (Design Verification Report, type validation, system-level airworthiness).
Own the complete application package and its submission for every EU site, integrating the airspace and air risk work delivered by the EU Regulatory Affairs Specialist.
Own the SORA safety case: ground risk assessment, SAIL determination, Operational Safety Objective compliance and the environmental evaluations each application needs.
Manage in-country regulatory consultants for local-language filing, safety-case drafting and authority logistics, owning the accountability that consultants cannot.
Build the evidence base and authority track record that positions Prime Air for a Light UAS Operator Certificate (LUC) and scaled operations across Member States.

A day in the life
You will spend your time in front of authorities, inside safety cases, and across our engineering, safety and operations teams pulling the evidence together. Expect regular travel to authority meetings and candidate sites in the EU.

About the team
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers and are excited for what's to come.
If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Amazon is the place for you.
Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
- Experience in program or project management
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
- Extensive experience working directly with an EU National Aviation Authority on Operational Authorisations, type certification, airworthiness or operational approval project.
- Working knowledge of the EU UAS framework (2019/947 and 2019/945), SORA methodology, Operational Authorisations and U-Space, and the associated acceptable means of compliance and guidance material.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience engaging multiple national aviation authorities simultaneously.
- Engineering or operations experience in drone operations.
- Experience with EASA design verification of drones, Special Conditions for Light UAS (SC-Light UAS) and SAIL determination.
- Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment.

title: Principal GNSS Systems Engineer, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Principal GNSS Systems Engineer with a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in GNSS engineering, satellite systems, and advanced positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technologies. This is a senior-level technical leadership role requiring deep, first-principles expertise across the full GNSS signal chain — from satellite constellation physics and signal generation through receiver design, carrier phase tracking, and precision position and time solutions delivered to ground terminals.
The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of a custom satellite-based wireless positioning and timing transfer service operating across S-Band and L-Band frequencies. This system will transmit simultaneous multi-source signals that ground terminals can receive, correlate, and process to extract carrier phase differentials, enabling high-accuracy ranging, time delta computation, and precise geolocation. The role demands mastery of both the theoretical underpinnings of GNSS — including relativistic time corrections, ionospheric and tropospheric propagation modeling, and CDMA spreading code correlation — and the practical engineering required to implement real-world satellite communication subsystems. This position sits at the intersection of satellite communications engineering, precision time and frequency, and advanced signal processing. The engineer will own the GNSS subsystem architecture end-to-end, contribute to the TT&C subsystem, and serve as the technical authority on all matters related to satellite-based PNT service design, clock disciplining, and time transfer over wireless and optical physical mediums.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
The Principal GNSS Systems Engineer will serve as the technical lead and subsystem owner for the spacecraft GNSS architecture, driving all aspects of design from initial requirements definition through hardware acceptance.

Basic qualifications

• Master's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field. A Bachelor's degree may be considered with exceptional demonstrated experience.
• Minimum 10 years of professional engineering experience in GNSS systems engineering, RF systems engineering, satellite payloads, TT&C design, or precision PNT system development.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least two of the major GNSS constellations (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo) at the signal and systems engineering level — not limited to receiver integration.
• Proven experience designing or significantly contributing to precision time transfer systems, including two-way time transfer (satellite or optical medium), with documented accuracy results at the nanosecond level or better.
• Demonstrated experience implementing Kalman filter-based navigation or timing solutions in real-world systems, with measurable performance results.
• Experience with RF systems engineering across S-Band and/or L-Band frequencies, including link budget derivation, antenna specifications, and receiver performance analysis.
• Proven track record managing RF hardware development cycles with external suppliers and defining strict test and qualification parameters for flight hardware.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience designing a custom satellite-based PNT service from initial concept through operational deployment — including waveform design, ground terminal specification, and algorithm development.
• Practical experience with optical time transfer systems (White Rabbit, TWFTF) and integration of optical and RF time references in hybrid synchronization networks.
• Expertise in Alternative PNT (Alt-PNT) system design and evaluation, including non-GNSS positioning technologies and GNSS-independent timing sources.
• Experience with GNSS security: anti-spoofing detection, signal authentication (OSNMA, Chimera), and cryptographic protection of PNT services.
• Background in precise orbit determination (POD) and its integration into GNSS timing error budgets for high-accuracy applications.
• Familiarity with satellite communication standards (CCSDS) and their application to TT&C and custom PNT service link layer design.
• Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for signal simulation, filter design, and automated test data analysis.

title: Risk Manager, NA Water, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As the NA Water Program Manager, you own the lifecycle of Amazon's most complex water compliance programs across North America and translate an ambiguous, fast-moving regulatory landscape into program frameworks the field can execute. That scope covers water quality and discharge compliance, stormwater and wastewater management, water stewardship and conservation, and emerging water regulatory obligations across the NA region. You take partially defined business problems and regulatory requirements and turn them into structured programs with clear objectives, milestones, and success criteria, owning each program through its pilot, prove, and scale phases.


As an individual contributor, you own the strategic definition and lifecycle management of these water programs. You decompose ambiguous challenges into program plans that account for real field constraints, define what "done" looks like, and design the systems, processes, and tools, with measurement built in, that the field organization adopts and sustains without ongoing program-level intervention. You partner with Legal, regulatory affairs, operations, technology, and procurement to keep programs aligned with the operating model, and you contribute to OP1 and OP2 narratives while owning organizational goals within the NA water program portfolio.


You identify and influence cross-functional investments that solve long-term water compliance requirements, negotiating resources, priorities, and timelines across organizations. You build business cases with quantified risk and ROI, present them to Director and VP audiences, and represent EAP in cross-functional planning cadences so that water compliance requirements are embedded in business decisions. You own program controllership mechanisms, business review cadences, escalation paths, and metric dashboards, that surface risk and drive accountability in real time, and you independently proxy for the Senior Manager in business reviews and cross-functional forums with full ownership.


This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to find a path forward where solutions are not pre-defined, driving cross-functional alignment without deferring decisions upward. You communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and you use data and business intelligence to look around corners, spotting and mitigating risk before it materializes. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the NA water compliance vision into executable program frameworks, integrating program objectives into OP1, OP2, and quarterly planning cycles across in-scope business units.
- Own the lifecycle of NA water compliance programs, including water quality, discharge, stormwater, and wastewater, taking each from problem definition through pilot, prove, and scale.
- Contribute to multi-year operating plans and program budget inputs, and recommend resource allocation trade-offs that balance immediate compliance obligations against long-term infrastructure investment.
- Design and operate program controllership mechanisms, business review cadences, escalation paths, and metric dashboards, that surface and mitigate water compliance risk and drive accountability across internal and external stakeholders without requiring manager intervention.
- Communicate compliance program status, risks, and escalations clearly and concisely to Director and VP-level audiences across Operations, Legal, Finance, and Technology, and independently proxy for the Senior Manager in WBRs, MBRs, and cross-functional forums.
- Partner with Amazon Legal, state and local regulators, environmental consultants, and technology teams to resolve water compliance barriers, accelerate engineered solutions, and reduce manual dependency in compliance execution.
- Define and implement KPI and compliance metric frameworks that provide real-time visibility into water program performance, milestone achievement, and regulatory posture across in-scope business units.
- Build data-driven business cases with quantified risk and ROI to secure cross-functional investment, negotiating priorities and timelines across organizations.
- Oversee work performed by third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding external partners accountable to program milestones and quality standards through structured audit and governance mechanisms.
- Work autonomously in a highly ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, exercising independent judgment to find paths forward where solutions are not pre-defined and driving cross-functional alignment without deferring decisions upward.
- Embed water compliance objectives into day-to-day operational rhythms and design mechanisms the field sustains without ongoing program-level intervention.
- Travel expected up to 25-50% of the time.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Master's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- Experience developing and implementing water compliance programs, for example water quality, discharge, stormwater, and wastewater, in accordance with applicable laws
- Professional water credential where applicable, for example a Professional Engineer (PE) with a water or wastewater focus, a Certified Water Professional, or an equivalent professional environmental certification
- Experience with ISO 14001 environmental management system design, implementation, or certification

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Deployment
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
· Primarily work in and support multiple Data Centers by Deploying, Servicing, and Upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
· Mentor and train Facilities team members on operation and control of the BMS and EPMS systems.
· Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations
· Manage small to medium size projects and programs.
· Perform point to point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
· Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with the BMS and EPMS in data centers.
· Perform provisioning process for servers, controllers, industrial PCs and network configurations and communication testing between third party devices and controllers or servers.
· Installation, replacement, configuration, and calibration of sensors.
· Able to read and understand Electrical schematics, control panel drawings. Basic understanding of close loop controls, field sensors scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
· Supervise low voltage electrical contractors who performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
· Commissioning and systems level testing support.
· Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
· Follow change management process to generate work requests and method of procedures.
· Participate in Factory witnessed tests at vendor's or panel builder's facility.
· Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.
· Recommend design improvements based on consultation with users and system operation.
· Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
· Ensure all personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
· Work on-call and a rotating schedule when required and respond to after-hours emergencies.
· Perform service activities such as monitoring/reviewing ticketing systems, performing root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
· Actively manage service agreements to include vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Physical Requirements:

· Walk jobsites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Technical (Military/ Trade School) School diploma or Associate degree with one year experience related to industrial instrumentation/controls or equivalent electrical or mechanical operations experience.
- Minimum one year of experience with mission critical low and medium voltage electrical and/or mechanical systems.

- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, controllers, and programming including troubleshooting of industrial controls analog, discrete and networked input/output field signals.

title: Engineering Operation Technician Night Role
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience
