title: Senior Air Cargo Network Planner - Flight Scheduling, Amazon AIR
descriptionHtml:
Amazon AIR is building one of the most ambitious dedicated air transportation networks in the world, designed to redefine delivery speed and selection for hundreds of millions of customers. As we scale this network, we need leaders who can tackle complex operational challenges and deliver results that customers feel every single day.

We are seeking a Senior Air Cargo (ACAR) Network Planner to join the Flight Scheduling team and help shape the future of Amazon AIR. In this role, you will own the development and optimization of flight capacity strategies meeting Amazon internal and external customer demand trends across long, medium and short term planning horizons, including flight schedule design, capacity allocation, and network modeling. You will also lead high impact, cross functional initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce cost, and improve service performance across the air network.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You will partner with leaders across Amazon AIR, including Operations, Finance, and Analytics, and directly influence senior leadership decisions that shape how millions of packages move through our network. Your recommendations will balance customer experience with cost effectiveness, and your work will have a measurable impact on Amazon's end to end transportation ecosystem.

If you thrive on solving complex, ambiguous problems at scale, want to innovate across air and ground transportation solutions, and are passionate about delighting customers, we'd love for you to help us make Amazon AIR history.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead Long term to short term flight schedule solutions to enable within Amazon AIR to service both Amazon internal and external customer demands, serving as the primary point of contact for cross functional business units
- Develop and present data driven recommendations to senior leadership on network design changes, route adjustments, and capacity investments.
- Develop and optimize capacity plans and network strategy, driving continuous improvement across customer experience, cost efficiency, and sustainability metrics.
- Evaluate complex tradeoffs between customer needs and cost, building consensus across partner teams such as Finance, Operations, Process Engineering, and Procurement to drive aligned decision making.
- Partner with Research Science and Technology as a subject matter expert to design and develop next generation planning and forecasting tools.
- Monitor and manage flight capacity allocation across the network, ensuring alignment between demand forecasts, and operational constraints.
- Navigate ambiguity while managing and coordinating multiple concurrent projects in a fast paced, deadline driven environment, taking full ownership and accountability for processes and delivering on commitments.
- Domestic travel up to 10% of the time.


A day in the life
As a Senior ACAR Network Planner, you will identify and incorporate long term ACAR vision into AIR's planning model - this includes developing and optimizing flight schedule operating plans, identifying new mechanisms, and communicating those plans across internal teams. You will also contribute to long term strategic recommendations to align with AIR's future vision

Your day will blend data analysis, network modeling, and cross functional collaboration. You will build flight schedules to accommodate peak volume, analyze network to identify under-performing routes, or present capacity tradeoff scenarios to senior leadership. You will regularly partner with AIR carriers, operations, ground transportation teams to ensure flight schedules are tightly integrated with the broader network.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced environment and is energized by solving complex network optimization problems that directly impact millions of customer deliveries.

About the team
Flight Scheduling is one of the pillars of the Planning & Performance (P&P) organization within AIR Supply Chain and Analytics (SC&A). Flight Scheduling owns the creation and revision of short to medium to long term operational plans, developing flight schedules from several months out through just days before departure. The team is responsible for setting the course for Amazon AIR to continuously raise the bar for customers by delivering the best possible mix of fast delivery speeds, low costs, and superior quality and reliability across the network.

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- 5+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in the aviation industry

title: Safety Monitoring Compliance Analyst, NAST Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's North American Surface Transportation Safety & Compliance team (NAST S&C) is hiring a Compliance Analyst for Safety Monitoring. The team measures carrier safety performance against Amazon's standards using FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS) data and Amazon's Violation Rate Metrics (VRM), and takes action when a carrier falls below the standard.

This role supports either third-party (3P) carrier monitoring or monitoring of Amazon's own fleet, Transportation Operations Management (TOM); the core work is the same for both. You will run recurring monitoring steps on a fixed schedule, pull and validate data, keep every case record current, and report results. The work is methodical and procedure-driven: each step follows written procedures and fixed thresholds, and every result can trigger an enforcement or safety action, so you will verify the data before it moves. You will report to the Safety Monitoring manager and escalate anything that falls outside the procedure.

Key job responsibilities
Pull safety data from FMCSA SMS and internal sources on the monthly schedule.

Validate every record against source data before it goes out, reconciling counts, spot-checking individual records, and documenting each check.

Maintain SIM and Asana so the current status of every case lives in one place.

Prepare recurring metrics for business reviews, including suspension and reinstatement counts, exception outcomes, inspection results, and cycle timeliness.

Maintain procedure documents and recommend process improvements.

Escalate data discrepancies, new case types, and anything with possible legal exposure.

Prepare the monthly BASICs and VRM suspension and reinstatement lists against the written thresholds.

Log carrier exception requests, build each case file against the written criteria, and present cases at the weekly exception review.

Record every review decision as granted, denied, or pending final review.

Submit suspension and reinstatement tickets to Carrier Health and confirm they are actioned.

Send carrier notifications from approved templates once a decision is recorded, answer carrier questions about their status, and route anything outside the templates to your manager.

Monitor carriers under review each week for new violations, out-of-service events, and safety rating changes.

Run the same monitoring steps for Amazon's own fleet, tracking roadside inspection results, out-of-service events, violations, and BASICs results for TOM.

Report trends and open items to TOM safety and operations leaders on a set schedule.

Flag changes that need attention, such as a rising violation rate or a new out-of-service event, to your manager and TOM safety leaders.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management
- Experience working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams, including operations

title: Sr. Business Development Manager, Delivery Services Partner (DSP)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Business Development Manager to join our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business. This is a unique opportunity to own new Partner Acquisition for Last Mile Logistics in South Africa, based in Cape Town. You will collaborate with various internal teams to create, innovate and transform our processes to launch and expand logistics partnerships. As a Business Development Manager (BDM), you source, vet, and guide candidates who apply to our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program, a diverse network of independent small business owners who facilitate deliveries on behalf of Amazon Logistics. This role will require some travel, as it is part of the Middle East, Africa, and Turkiye (MEATR) region.

Key job responsibilities
A BDM owns the recruitment funnel and partners with DSP candidates through all stages of their journey as they apply to launch and scale new businesses in one of the fastest growing networks in the world. The BDM oversees a regional candidate acquisition pipeline and is accountable for leading candidate outreach, ensuring quality candidate vetting, and driving ongoing engagement with candidates preparing to join the DSP program. The successful candidate will demonstrate an ability to identify high-quality owner operators to join the program, using data to drive decisions to analyze their regional capacity needs and pipelines, building and bolstering process to ensure that recruitment and engagement can be applied consistently, and ensuring quality candidates are matched to the right logistic opportunities. The right candidate will serve as both trusted advisor of candidates and an ambassador for Amazon. A BDM will collaborate with an integrated internal team of Operations leaders, Program Managers, and Compliance teams to ensure we identify highly qualified candidates to join the network. The BDM is also accountable for developing and maintaining external longer-term relationships within the business communities from which we source DSP talent and nurturing talent from within our existing DSP community.

A day in the life
- Developing recruiting and placement strategy to identify DSP prospects to meet logistics growth plans in market.
- Overseeing the entire candidate journey, from sourcing, to interviewing and business launch, and driving improvements that lead to higher-quality candidate outcomes.
- Coaching and consulting with DSP owner candidates on program expectations, business plan best practices, operational requirements, and safety.
- Collaborating cross-functionally with internal partners including regional Delivery Partner Management Team (DPM) and operations teams to ensure we are adding high-quality DSPs to the program, leveraging insights to refine DSP selection and on-boarding DSPs to launch phase.
- Driving engagement, education, and support of the DSP owner candidates who have earned a position within the program.
- Evolving candidate and stakeholder experience through continual process improvements.
- Developing relationships with key industry and corporate partners as well as professional associations as part of being a strong regional ambassador for the DSP program and Amazon.
- Traveling to support candidate recruitment and experience (approximately 10 days/month); but Candidate should be flexible with hours and travel to support the portfolio of assigned DSP candidates as needed.

About the team
At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. We partner with a network of DSPs to deliver customer orders. Utilizing continuous improvement initiatives and creative thinking, our DSPs ensure that millions of packages reach their final destination as efficiently as possible. To meet this goal, Amazon Logistics is continually striving to innovate and provide best in class service levels through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space. Come join the team and help us make history!

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Engineer is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.


Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

• Act as the site primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders involving communication and relationship management.
• Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
• Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
• Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
• Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analysis, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
• Work with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
• Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
• Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
• Assist in recruiting efforts.
• Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues
- fine with 24x7 rotational shift hours

• Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
• Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
• Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
• Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
• Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.

title: Product Designer III, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon OpenSearch Service is how customers search, analyze, and make sense of their data at massive scale — powering application search, log analytics, observability, and increasingly AI-powered and agentic investigation workflows. It's a product where the data is enormous, the queries are complex, and the users range from developers running their first search cluster to SRE and security teams triaging an incident at 2 a.m. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience for a core part of OpenSearch and make that complexity feel effortless.

Search itself is being reinvented. With Winnow, OpenSearch is moving from keyword-and-query mechanics toward agentic search — where a customer expresses intent and an AI agent plans, retrieves, reasons, and returns answers rather than ten blue links. That shift rewrites the design problem: the interface is no longer a search box and a results list, but a conversation with a system that acts on the customer's behalf, shows its reasoning, and has to earn trust with every answer. You'll help invent what that experience looks like.

This isn't a role where design hands off mockups and walks away. Our designers are end-to-end builders — embedded in OpenSearch builder pods, shaping product decisions, prototyping in real code, shipping to production, and measuring what happens. You'll own your problem space from framing through launch, ground your decisions in research that actually feeds the roadmap, and help push OpenSearch into its next chapter — agentic search and observability where the design challenge is as much about trust and verification

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end design for a core OpenSearch experience — from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, production implementation, and post-launch measurement.
2. Help define the experience for Winnow / agentic search: how a customer expresses intent, how the agent's planning and reasoning are surfaced, how results and their provenance earn trust, and how the customer stays in control.
3. Embed in a builder pod with product and engineering as a true end-to-end builder: shape what gets built and in what order, not just how it looks.
4. Design for genuine complexity — search relevance, vector and semantic search, log analytics, dashboards, observability workflows, alerting, and root-cause investigation — and make dense, high-volume data feel clear and navigable.
5. Help define the experience for agentic observability alongside agentic search, where interfaces surface agent reasoning, findings, and remediation — and where earning the customer's trust is the core design problem.
6. Run research that ships: structured research cycles, trust-calibration studies, and competitive signal capture that feed directly into the roadmap rather than sitting in a deck.
7. Contribute to and extend the OpenSearch design system (OUI) so patterns are consistent, accessible, and scale across the product.
8. Partner daily with PMs and engineers to balance customer needs, deep technical constraints, and business goals.
9. Raise the design bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and reusable patterns.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review where you present a systems-level concept to product and engineering partners, walking through how a new interaction pattern scales across multiple surfaces. After lunch, you shift into hands-on craft work in Figma, refining a prototype informed by recent research findings. Later, you facilitate an alignment session with cross-functional stakeholders who have competing priorities, helping the group converge on a shared path forward. Throughout it all, you mentor fellow designers, write persuasive strategy documents, and use AI tools to rapidly explore ideas.

About the team
We're the design team behind Amazon OpenSearch Service, and we work differently: six designers embedded directly in OpenSearch builder pods, owning the experience from problem framing through production. We're designing OpenSearch's shift to agentic search and observability so the work is net-new: inventing the patterns for how customers trust a system that searches, reasons, and acts for them. We operate on three principles: end-to-end builders (we shape, build, ship, and measure), research that ships (structured research and trust-calibration work that feeds the roadmap directly), and a self-learning design system (OUI, evolving toward agentic patterns). We treat design as a competitive weapon, not a line item. We're a senior, tight-knit group that gives designers genuine ownership of their problem space, invests in craft and research, and cares deeply about raising each other's work.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience

Preferred qualifications

- Have an available online portfolio

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL Logistica, Trasporti & merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
Responsabilità per il funzionamento efficace e continuo dei processi operativi di Amazon e partecipazione al coordinamento e allo sviluppo ulteriore di tutti i processi nell’area CF Flex, nell’ambito della partnership tra Amazon e i Vendor/3PL.
Monitorare i processi operativi chiave all’interno del magazzino, garantendo l’assenza di difetti. Questi processi includono, ma non si limitano a: Receive, Stow, Pick, Pack, Shipping & Transportation, Quality, Stock Integrity e Transfers.
Contatto diretto con i rappresentanti dei nostri Vendor/3PL, nonché con le funzioni di supporto Amazon appartenenti a diversi team, tra cui, ma non solo: WHS, Retail, Transportation, IT e Business Development.
Responsabilità del monitoraggio e della progressione verso gli indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) in linea con gli obiettivi generali di CF Flex.
Supporto alla rete CF Flex, inclusi, ma non limitati a: copertura dei magazzini, aperture (launch), chiusure, trasferimenti e conversioni dei siti, oltre alla gestione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo e di nuovi progetti.

A day in the life
Come Logistics Assistant, agirai come rappresentante locale di Amazon, comunicando quotidianamente con stakeholder esterni (fornitori e 3PL) e interni (senior management e altri dipartimenti, tra cui, ma non solo, WHS, Retail, Transportation, IT e Business Development).

Siamo sempre alla ricerca di modi per migliorare i nostri processi, e tu sarai una parte fondamentale nell’identificare e contribuire all’implementazione di questi miglioramenti. Avrai una buona conoscenza delle attività operative quotidiane di un Logistics Assistant, ma agirai anche come modello di riferimento per Amazon, dimostrando impegno, affidabilità, attenzione alla salute e sicurezza sul lavoro, oltre a garantire elevata qualità nei risultati consegnati.

L’organizzazione CF Flex prevede principalmente la presenza individuale del Logistics Assistant sul sito, supportata da lavoro di squadra e gestione da remoto; per questo motivo, le capacità di comunicazione sono fondamentali.

È inoltre necessaria la disponibilità a viaggiare, poiché potresti essere talvolta assegnato temporaneamente ad altre sedi CF Flex per fornire supporto.

Basic qualifications

- Esperienza rilevante nell’utilizzo della suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) in un contesto professionale.
- Conoscenza avanzata dell'italiano sia scritto che parlato (livello C1 del Quadro Comune Europeo di Riferimento per le Lingue – QCER/CEFR).
- Esperienza rilevante nell’analisi dei dati e nell’utilizzo di metriche per identificare problemi.

Preferred qualifications

- Esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder, inclusa la capacità di costruire e mantenere relazioni professionali e una comunicazione efficace.
- Esperienza in un ambiente operativo, come logistica, retail, hospitality o servizio clienti.

title: Quality Manager, WW Consumables Private Brands
descriptionHtml:
The WW (World Wide) Consumables Private Brands (CPB) team is building a global portfolio of consumables products and is seeking an experienced Quality Manager to support end-to-end product lifecycle management. This role is responsible for ensuring product quality from early product development through mature assortment already launched in the marketplace.

Would you like to be part of an organization that is developing a pipeline of leaders in a growing, highly innovative, global business? Are you passionate about driving continuous improvement through the strategic application of the newest technologies? Are you curious about Amazon's Private Brands business and do you want to be part of it? If yes, the Amazon Private Brands team is the right fit for you.

This position will work with internal cross-functional stakeholders and external suppliers to develop and implement Amazon Private Brands' quality program. You will use customer insights to drive product development and improvement opportunities, assess product performance and quality attributes, ensure quality standards in manufacturing, develop and manage risk assessment plans, manage corrective actions, manage audits and supplier relationships, and develop SOPs and templates. You will manage quality programs in conjunction with Food Safety and Compliance teams, Product Development and Sourcing teams, and various other stakeholders.

Your role will also involve optimizing our global supplier quality management program and building manufacturing excellence, as well as designing and implementing scalable Quality Assurance solutions in collaboration with Product Development, Sourcing, and Tech teams. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply AI solutions to monitor, evaluate, and improve supplier quality performance to ensure the highest quality products for our customers.

This role requires expertise in consumer-packaged goods manufacturing, strong organizational and communication skills (verbal and written), a solution-oriented mindset, a high bar for quality, a clear focus on customer needs, and a track record of operating in a dynamic environment. A successful candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, has strong attention to detail, can operate autonomously, is motivated by a fast-paced environment, and has the capacity to invent and simplify their ways of working through the use of AI tools.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
-Own end-to-end product quality from a customer perspective, from concept to launch, developing new products and improving existing products to meet customers' expectations
-Partner closely with suppliers to influence product quality and ensure an optimized selection of new products that customers love, based on product assessment against technical documentation and customer preferences
-Drive manufacturing excellence through data-driven approaches to identify quality trends, predict potential issues, and implement preventive measures across supplier networks
-Maintain product quality metrics for assigned assortment in alignment with APB Quality goals, including technical product and packaging specifications, tolerances, and quality testing plans
-Write, maintain, and update SOPs to develop quality assurance programs; design and operate scalable quality management programs and drive continuous improvement across different business models
-Work with suppliers to ensure adherence to GMP requirements, Factory Quality Audits, CAP development, implementation and closure, product specifications, finished product production approval, product traceability, ongoing supplier quality programs, and continuous product improvement
-Ensure products continuously comply with Amazon's quality, performance, and reliability requirements, as well as industry safety and regulatory requirements worldwide
-Develop and audit processes and tools to ensure supplier compliance to internal (Amazon) and external (Regulatory) standards and requirements
-Establish, manage, and monitor key performance metrics for suppliers, internal stakeholders, and Amazon customers; manage supplier performance proactively to ensure consistent quality of finished products
-Manage and coach strategic suppliers to improve quality management systems, manufacturing processes, and customer satisfaction; utilize AI-powered analytics to provide data-driven recommendations for improvement
-Manage corrective actions with suppliers in response to customer review feedback and concessions, and manage product improvement activities post-launch
-Communicate technical, quality, and process requirements effectively to non-technical stakeholders through data visualization and analytical insights
-Collaborate with other members of the WW Amazon Private Brands team, including other Quality Managers, Category Managers, Product Managers, Instock Managers, Packaging Managers, Sustainability Managers, Compliance, Safety, Food Safety, Legal, and all relevant stakeholders involved in supporting project timeline deliverables

About the team
The WW Consumables Private Brands team is a growing, highly innovative, global organization developing a pipeline of leaders who are passionate about delivering the highest quality consumables products to Amazon customers. We operate across multiple countries with a highly diverse group of colleagues, united by a shared commitment to customer obsession and continuous improvement.

Our team thrives in a highly collaborative, analytical, creative, and fast-paced environment. We have a strong inclination to get things done and deliver scalable results at speed. We work cross-functionally with Product Development, Sourcing, Food Safety and Compliance, Tech, and other teams to build and maintain a world-class quality program. We are committed to leveraging the newest technologies—including AI and data-driven analytics—to optimize our supplier quality management programs and build manufacturing excellence across our global supply chain.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with quality tools such as statistical process control, Six Sigma and Lean tools including Pareto charts/8D problem solving, FMEA, MSA/GR&R, FAI (first article inspection), Cpk (statistical process capability), or PPAP
- Experience managing multiple development programs in parallel
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, material engineering, mechanical engineering or related fields

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

title: Data Scientist, Edge AI Product Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Devices is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile devices like Echo, Fire Tablets, Fire TV, and other consumer devices. We are looking for an exceptional data scientist to join our Edge AI Product Science team to advance the state-of-the-art in developing efficient multimodal deep learning models across our product portfolio. Through close hardware-software integration, we design and train models for resource efficiency across the hardware and software tech stack.

Edge AI Product Science team is looking for a talented Data Scientist who will introduce and model best practices around our dataset curation, annotation pipelines, and data driven model development. This role will take a data-first approach to improving model and system performance and work alongside other scientists to develop new evaluation methods for multimodal language models and agents for our devices, including audio and vision experiences.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineers and scientists to advance the state of the art in multimodal model evaluations for devices, including audio, images, and videos
- Invent and validate reliability for novel automated evaluation methods for perception tasks, such as fine-tuned LLM-as-judge
- Develop and extend our evaluation frameworks to support expanding capabilities for multimodal language models
- Analyse large offline and online datasets using Python or similar to understand model gaps, develop methods to interpret model failures, and collaborate with training teams to enhance model capabilities for product use cases
- Work closely with other scientists, compiler engineers, data collection, and product teams to advance evaluation methods

A day in the life
As a Data Scientist with the Edge AI Product Science team, you'll contribute to innovative methods for evaluating new product experiences and discover ways to use data to enhance our model capabilities and enrich our customer experiences. You'll have opportunities to collaborate across teams of engineers and scientists to bring algorithms and models from inception through prototype all the way to production.

About the team
Our Edge AI Product Science team brings together our unique skills and experiences to deliver state-of-the-art multimodal AI models that enable new experiences on Amazon devices. We strive to deliver customer experiences driven by AI at the edge which are only possible with tight model, hardware, and system co-design.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science
- Experience with machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g. SQL, Python, R etc.) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, or Matlab)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
- Experience in manipulating/transforming data, model selection, model training, cross-validation and deployment at scale
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model (LLM) fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and training recipe refinement

title: Senior Security Solutions Architect, AWS Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about cloud computing with a special focus on information security and compliance? Do you have a unique combination of deep technical knowledge, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills? Do you like helping organizational leaders think through how to secure services in the AWS Cloud?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a security solutions architect to work with some of our largest Strategic customers. At AWS, customer obsession is in our DNA. The successful candidate will become a trusted advisor to our customers and will work with AWS sales, business development, solutions architecture and product teams to develop the security and compliance expertise needed to deliver results. In this vital role, you will help customers achieve their business goals on AWS by identifying and tackling major security, risk, and compliance questions from stakeholders in areas such as Identity, Data Protection, Network Security, and Generative AI. You will work directly with customer security, engineering, audit, risk and compliance teams to help them understand how to confidently use AWS.




Key job responsibilities
- Work with AWS Strategic customers to convey cloud computing security, compliance, and risk management best practices
- Provide subject matter expertise on security topics including identity, data protection, network security, and agent-based AI
- Design and Build working proof-of-concept architectures to tackle emerging security challenges
- Develop technical content, such as white papers and reference architectures, that can be used by our customers to assist them in deploying secure and compliant cloud-based solutions
- Provide mentorship across AWS sales and solutions architecture teams regarding Security and Identity to build skills in the field
- Work with customers to better understand compliance models in the cloud
- Represent AWS at trade events by delivering presentations and workshops

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Experience using AI tools to support or enhance security engineering work

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
- Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Sr. HR Specialist, AIS HRP Team, AIS HRP Team
descriptionHtml:
This role sits on the Data Center's People Foundations team, which owns the Data Center's time, pay, and people-infrastructure demand signal. The team turns diffuse requirements from across the DC network into delivered, compliant solutions by working through the central teams that own each domain (TimeHub, Workforce Solutions, Payroll, Compensation, policy, and Benefits), then operationalizing the result with the business. The team is small and specialist. It builds the standards and mechanisms the network runs on, and partners with those owner teams to make sure the data center use case is built in, not bolted on.
You own how people-infrastructure needs get gathered from the field across the network and see them through to delivery. You gather what the business actually needs across every workstream, translate it into structured requirements, and partner with the central owner teams to land real solutions, running against the prioritization criteria and roadmapping mechanisms the function sets. You are fungible by design: one week you're supporting a site launch, the next a retrofit or closure, the next carrying a time and pay requirement into the owner teams or building something net-new for how DC operations run. You go where the highest-value problem sits, and you're trusted to size it, work it, and see it through. You're based in the EU, and where the work calls for on-the-ground regional support, your focus is EMEA and APJC.
Specifically, you will support the full site lifecycle (launches, retrofits, closures, and replacements) so the people experience holds through every transition; support accurate time and pay for the DC population by bringing clear requirements to the timekeeping and payroll owner teams and helping operationalize the fixes; and take a solution proven in one market and help turn it into the standard other markets adopt, so the network solves once rather than rebuilding in parallel. This is a net-new operating model for the data centers, so you'll help stand up the mechanisms as you run them.


Key job responsibilities
• Own how the people-infrastructure demand signal gets gathered from the field across every workstream: translate needs into structured build requirements, and drive each one through to a delivered, compliant solution rather than letting it resurface as a post-launch defect.
• Support the full site lifecycle (launches, retrofits, closures, and replacements), making sure people transitions are planned before the physical work begins, not after; where on-the-ground support is needed, your focus is EMEA and APJC.
• Support accurate time and pay for the DC population: bring clear, well-structured requirements to the timekeeping and payroll owner teams and partner with them to operationalize solutions through launches and site transitions.
• Partner with the owner teams (TimeHub, Workforce Solutions, Payroll, Compensation, policy, and Benefits) as a single, reliable point of contact: bring them the data center use case early, work alongside them to land it, and track progress so requirements arrive as delivered solutions.
• Solve once, apply everywhere: take a problem worked to a solution in one market and help turn it into the standard other markets adopt, running against the mechanisms and standards the function sets.
• Surface risks in the intake-to-delivery pipeline early and work them to resolution with the owner teams, so a gap is closed before it becomes a compliance issue or business disruption.
• Flex across the team's workstreams as priorities shift, taking on the highest-value problem wherever it sits.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- • 5+ years of HR, talent program, or program and project management experience.
- • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
- • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured requirements and delivered solutions.
- • Experience supporting or leading initiatives across multiple countries or business lines.
- • Experience working cross-functionally with teams you influence rather than manage

Preferred qualifications

- • Experience with intake, prioritization, and delivery across a portfolio of requirements or programs.
- • Experience in site launch, expansion, or new-market or greenfield operational stand-up.
- • Direct experience with time and pay / timekeeping systems (e.g., TimeHub, MyTime, payroll platforms) or comparable HR-systems configuration environments.
- • Experience partnering with policy, benefits, legal, tech, and operations teams in a matrixed environment.
- • Experience in a data center, mission-critical facility, or high-growth infrastructure environment.
- • Readiness to operate with increasing scope and ambiguity, and to grow into broader ownership over time.
- • MBA or advanced degree in Industrial/Labor Relations, Organizational Development, HR, or a related field.

It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon. The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production. title: Thermal & Mechanical Engineer, Annapurna Labs - AI Silicon Packaging
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Machine Learning Acceleration team you'll be responsible for the design and optimization of hardware in our data centers. You'll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale server deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you'll work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You'll have high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you'll be constantly looking for ways to improve your products performance, quality and cost. We're changing an industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Key job responsibilities
- Perform finite element simulations and analytical modeling to evaluate assembly, test, and reliability risks for advanced semiconductor packages
- Design and execute experiments on materials and packaging or system structures to validate performance and inform design decisions
- Develop risk evaluations for future Annapurna packages, providing data-driven recommendations that shape next-generation package designs
- Collaborate with Quality and Reliability, Package Design, Test, and System Design teams to optimize package architectures and resolve cross-functional technical challenges
- Communicate findings through clear documentation and design reviews, contributing to specifications and trade-off analyses that guide team decisions

A day in the life
Your primary focus is ensuring the thermal and mechanical integrity of Annapurna's semiconductor packages. On a given day you might run finite element simulations to stress-test a new package stackup, then head to the lab to collect experimental data on material behavior under thermal cycling. You'll review results with Package Design engineers, flag risks to the Quality and Reliability team, and refine your models based on real-world feedback — all while keeping an eye on how your work feeds into the next product generation.

About the team
Annapurna Labs, our organization within Amazon Web Services (AWS), designs custom silicon and software that accelerates cloud innovation. Within Annapurna, the Packaging team focuses on the thermal, mechanical, and materials engineering challenges that come with pushing semiconductor package performance forward. We work closely with Quality and Reliability, Package Design, Test, and System Design groups to deliver robust, manufacturable solutions at data-center scale.

Our team values collaboration and knowledge sharing. We are investing in advanced packaging technologies to support the growing demands of machine learning and compute workloads, and you will play a direct role in shaping those next-generation solutions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years industry experience in mechanical design of semiconductor-based systems – silicon, packaging, and system design
- 3+ years industry experience in advanced packaging of semiconductors
- Direct experience in designing and testing of test vehicles to assess future packaging architectures and evaluating properties of next-generation materials
- Expertise in optimizing in packaging architectures to meet quality, performance, and cost goals
- Industry experience of working with packaging component vendors and ODMs, and internal design teams on cross-boundary triaging, debugging, and resolving issues across organization
- Proficiency with simulation tools such as ANSYS, ABAQUS, COMSOL, FLOTHERM, ICEPACK or equivalent FEA/CFD software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in advanced packaging metrologies for characterization, and design validation of semiconductor components, packages, and platforms. Hands-on experience with lab-based thermal and mechanical measurements, including instrumentation, infrared thermography, acoustic chambers, mechanical stress/strain gauges, power measurement equipment, and thermal test setups for package and system-level characterization.
- Strong understanding of product development lifecycles from concept through high volume manufacturing
- Experience with various types of technologies used for Heatsink solutions, Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs) and liquid cooling technologies - including cold plate design. Working knowledge on fans, UQDs, manifolds, and CDUs.
- Developed detailed CFD and compact RC models for SoC and Package thermal analysis. Experience correlating simulation models with experimental data and iterating designs based on empirical findings.
- Demonstrated ability to design, set up, and execute experiments in a lab environment, including building custom test fixtures, operating data acquisition systems, and performing root-cause failure analysis on hardware. Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE) and Six Sigma methodologies.
- Knowledge of hardware and software based thermal / power management control algorithms
- Validated thermal models through power/thermal measurements on Hardware

title: Corporate Counsel, Satellite & Broadband Infrastructure, Amazon Leo Product
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is seeking an exceptional Corporate Counsel to advise on the legal and regulatory questions that arise from building and operating a global satellite broadband network. You will work closely with engineering and product teams on questions involving network design, infrastructure deployment, and interconnection arrangements.

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The role sits at the intersection of technology, regulation, and operational strategy. You will help teams understand the legal implications of technical decisions, develop frameworks for evaluating new proposals, and build processes that allow engineering and product teams to move quickly while maintaining compliance. This role requires someone who is curious about how complex technical systems work, comfortable developing expertise in unfamiliar areas, and able to translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance for engineering and product teams.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Advise engineering and product teams on the legal and regulatory implications of network architecture and infrastructure decisions, including network design, routing, interconnection, and the use of third-party infrastructure
- Develop scalable legal frameworks for evaluating proposed technical and operational changes, distinguishing changes to implementation from changes that materially affect service commitments or regulatory obligations
- Identify, assess, and mitigate legal and regulatory risks arising from network operations across multiple jurisdictions, including telecommunications regulation, data localization, and cross-border compliance requirements
- Build cross-functional coordination mechanisms and repeatable processes that enable engineering and product teams to scale efficiently while maintaining appropriate legal oversight

A day in the life
You'll start your morning embedded with the engineering and product team as they design network architecture for a new region, helping them understand which design choices carry regulatory implications. Mid-morning, you'll research how a country's telecommunications framework applies to satellite broadband infrastructure, building the legal analysis that informs the team's technical approach. After lunch, you'll join a cross-functional session to map regulatory requirements for a new connectivity offering across target jurisdictions. Later, you'll build a legal playbook that standardizes how the team evaluates regulatory readiness for new deployments. Throughout the day, you're helping build the legal foundation for a network still taking shape.

About the team
Amazon Leo's legal team operates at the forefront of innovation, supporting one of Amazon's most ambitious global expansion initiatives. We're a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving and business partnership over simply identifying obstacles. Our team culture emphasizes proactive engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and finding pragmatic solutions to complex legal challenges. You'll work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about enabling Leo's mission while maintaining the highest legal and ethical standards. We believe great legal counsel empowers businesses to scale efficiently and responsibly across borders.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of legal experience
- Juris Doctor and membership in one state bar or equivalent
- Experience in private practice or in house experience at a technology company or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience of a mix of corporate law firm and in-house work
- Experience engaging and influencing senior executives
- Experience solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry
- Experience with telecommunications regulatory matters, ISP obligations, or network management legal frameworks
- Background in technology or product-focused legal support

title: Software Development Engineer - AgentCore, AWS Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is building the foundational services developers use to create, deploy, and operate production-ready AI agents at scale. AgentCore Harness, launched at AWS Summit New York in June 2026, provides a managed agent loop that enables customers to define an agent through configuration rather than build and operate orchestration infrastructure themselves.

Customers specify their model, instructions, tools, skills, memory, and execution limits. AgentCore Harness manages the agent loop, secure execution environment, session isolation, identity, networking, observability, and deployment lifecycle. This allows developers to move quickly from an idea to a production agent while retaining the flexibility to integrate custom tools, models, and environments.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, implement, test, deploy, and operate core components across the Harness control plane and data plane. You will solve challenging distributed systems problems involving agent execution, session state, tool orchestration, security, scalability, reliability, and low-latency streaming. You will own features throughout their lifecycle, contribute to technical designs, and deliver high-quality solutions for customers.

Harness sits at the intersection of AgentCore Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Browser, Code Interpreter, and Evaluations. You will collaborate with engineers across these services to integrate capabilities, improve cross-service APIs, and reduce friction throughout the agent development lifecycle.

A central part of this role is making sophisticated agent capabilities dramatically easier to use. You will work backward from customer needs to turn complex infrastructure and orchestration tasks into intuitive configuration, sensible defaults, reusable templates, and guided workflows. Your work will help customers move from an idea to a secure, observable, production-ready agent in minutes while preserving the flexibility advanced builders need for customization.

You will help develop capabilities that make agent development faster and more accessible. This may include simplifying how customers connect tools and memory, building richer agent templates and skills, automating permissions and resource wiring, shortening the build-test-deploy loop, and creating safer ways to evaluate and release changes.

This is an opportunity to join a newly launched service at an early stage, contribute to its architecture and customer experience, and deliver capabilities with broad industry impact. Machine learning experience is helpful but not required. We are looking for strong engineers with distributed systems experience, sound technical judgment, a commitment to operational excellence, and the ability to deliver in a fast-moving environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate highly available control plane APIs, data plane services, and managed agent loops for production AI agents.
- Build secure, isolated execution capabilities spanning tool orchestration, memory, context management, streaming, identity, networking, observability, and failure handling.
- Develop integrations between Amazon Bedrock and third-party models, AgentCore services, MCP servers, AWS Step Functions, Strands Agents, and customer-defined environments.
- Implement versioning, endpoints, progressive deployment, rollback, evaluation, and optimization capabilities that help customers safely improve agent behavior.
- Analyze and improve latency, scalability, availability, resource efficiency, and cost controls across multi-tenant workloads.
- Simplify the developer journey across APIs, SDKs, CLI, console, infrastructure as code, and local workflows by building cohesive abstractions, templates, defaults, and automation.
- Work directly with customers and partner teams to identify and reduce friction, accelerate time to production, and balance approachable experiences with the flexibility advanced builders need.
- Contribute to architectural decisions within Harness and collaborate with teams across AgentCore. Help raise the engineering bar through design reviews, operational readiness, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Engineering Operation Technician (Night Shift)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

We are seeking experienced Engineering Operations Technicians to join our data center operations team, specifically focusing on liquid cooling infrastructure and water distribution systems. This role is vital in maintaining the continuous operation of our advanced cooling systems that support critical data center operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

title: Human Resources Partner (HRP), Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide. We're looking for a Human Resources Partner (HRP) to join the team shaping the people experience behind this industry-changing initiative.

In this role, you'll serve as a strategic and hands-on HRP to site leadership and frontline managers across the Leo organization. You'll collaborate with senior leaders, HRBPs, and cross-functional PXT teams — including Employee Relations and Labor Relations — to design and execute people strategies that drive engagement, build manager capability, and strengthen the employee experience. A core focus of this role is leveraging listening mechanisms — including regular floor walks and sentiment analysis — to proactively surface trends, recommend actions, and close the loop with leadership.

You'll also play a key role in building the HR infrastructure for a scaling operation: launching policies, processes, and tools; leading change management; and standing up programs tailored to Leo's unique operating environment. Until centralized solutions are fully in place, you'll provide interim support for employee lifecycle processes and serve as the first point of escalation for employee concerns and time-sensitive issues, including labor relations matters.

This is an on-site role based in Everett, WA, working Wednesday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. You must be reachable for escalations outside standard hours on a rotational or as-needed basis. Travel to the Kirkland or Redmond facility is required as driven by business need.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct regular Gemba walks and analyze employee sentiment data to advocate for employee needs, enhance engagement, and develop proactive strategies with leaders.
- Partner with business leaders and cross-functional PXT teams (HRBPs, Employee Relations, Labor Relations) to align on engagement actions and execute site-specific programs, including defining ER/LR strategy for the Florida site.
- Consult on talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations — including coaching, Focus & Pivot/PIP guidance, promotion and talent review support, and off-cycle compensation changes.
- Conduct workplace investigations and support employee queries with discretion, applying Amazon policies and high judgment. Serve as first point of escalation for concerns beyond MyHR (policy exceptions, emergency management, regulatory escalations).
- Build and launch HR infrastructure — policies, processes, and tools — followed by change management and manager training (e.g., performance management practices, ADAPT).

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Software Development Engineer II. You will build the backend-for-frontend layer, the service that sits directly behind the customer-facing surfaces and orchestrates over the many backend systems that make satellite internet work: ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support.

The job is to shape what the frontend needs, route and orchestrate requests across those systems, translate between them, and compose their responses into reliable operations the customer experience can depend on. The core of the work is integration: calling many APIs, handling partial failures gracefully, mapping between different service models, and keeping latency and reliability high across a lot of moving parts. Much of this is built zero-to-one and expanding into new countries, so you will move from ambiguous problems to working products. You will own the full development lifecycle and work closely with frontend, product, and partner service teams.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build backend gateway APIs in Java that route and orchestrate requests across many downstream services, from concept through deployment and operation.
- Integrate with ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support services: calling their APIs, translating between their models, and composing their responses.
- Handle the realities of a distributed system: partial failures, retries, timeouts, error translation, and keeping latency and reliability high across many dependencies.
- Work with product managers, frontend engineers, and partner service teams, and help the platform expand into new countries.
- Use agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to deliver faster, and improve the system with AWS native services.
- Review code, give feedback, and coach teammates on service integration patterns and well-tested code.
- Document your team's software and train new team members on how it is built, tested, and operated.

About the team
We build the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base at Amazon Leo. Our team owns the backend-for-frontend layer: the single API the customer-facing app talks to, and the orchestration behind it that connects to the systems provisioning and running satellite internet. We work hand in hand with the frontend team, shaping our APIs around what their experiences need. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows.

descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles.
