title: Sr. Manager, EAP, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As Senior Manager, Global Air & Energy Programs, you own Amazon's global air & energy strategy and are accountable for steering Amazon toward that benchmark. That scope covers air quality and emissions compliance, air permitting and greenhouse gas reporting, energy management and efficiency, and emerging regulatory obligations. You will build and govern global programs from multi-year planning through real-time execution. You lead a team that turns regulatory requirements into durable, auditable field execution.

The Senior Manager, Global Air & Energy Programs establishes and maintains cross-organizational alignment on a unified compliance vision across all regions, business units, and dependency stakeholders. This leader develops multi-year compliance plans that account for emerging regulations, manages program budgets, and holds internal and external stakeholders accountable to compliance milestones through structured program controllership mechanisms. They embed air and energy compliance objectives across organizations so that environmental accountability becomes part of day-to-day operations.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in air and energy regulatory compliance combined with the strategic leadership capability to drive accountability across VP-level organizations. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and use data and business intelligence to drive continuous improvement at scale.

This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to define the right organizational structure, mechanisms, and strategy to meet long-term compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-growth business environment. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Establish and maintain cross-organizational alignment on a unified air and energy compliance vision, spanning all in-scope business units and integrating objectives into OP1, OP2, and quarterly planning cycles.

Own the strategic air and energy program roadmap, including air quality, emissions, air permitting, greenhouse gas, and energy management compliance programs and field execution frameworks.

Develop and govern multi-year operating plans, program budgets, and resource allocation strategies that balance immediate compliance obligations against long-term infrastructure investment.

Build and operate program controllership mechanisms that drive speed, quality, and accountability across internal and external stakeholders, proactively surfacing and mitigating air and energy compliance risk.

Communicate compliance strategy, program status, and escalation risks clearly and concisely to Director and VP-level audiences across Operations, Legal, Finance, and Technology.

Partner with Amazon Legal, state and local regulators, environmental consultants, and technology teams to resolve air and energy compliance barriers, accelerate engineered solutions, and reduce manual dependency in compliance execution.

Define, implement, and govern KPI and compliance metric frameworks that provide real-time visibility into air and energy program performance, milestone achievement, and regulatory posture across all business units.

Lead the talent management lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, and structured development planning that builds organizational depth and capability.

Oversee work performed by third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding external partners accountable to program milestones and quality standards through structured audit and governance mechanisms.

Work autonomously in a highly ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, exercising independent judgment to define the right strategy, structure, and mechanisms for delivering compliance outcomes at scale.

Embed air and energy compliance objectives into day-to-day operational rhythms.

- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities

title: Risk Manager, NA Air & Energy, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As the NA Air/Energy Program Manager, you own the lifecycle of Amazon's most complex air and energy compliance programs across North America and turn an ambiguous, fast-moving regulatory landscape into program frameworks the field can execute. That scope covers air quality and emissions compliance, air permitting and greenhouse gas reporting, energy management and efficiency, and emerging air and energy regulatory obligations across North America. You take partially defined business problems and regulatory requirements and build them into structured programs with clear objectives, milestones, and success criteria, owning each program through its pilot and scaled rollout.

As an individual contributor, you own the strategic definition and lifecycle management of these air and energy programs. You break ambiguous challenges into program plans that account for real field constraints, define what "done" looks like, and design the systems, processes, and tools, with measurement built in, that the field organization adopts and sustains on its own. You partner with legal, regulatory affairs, operations, technology, and procurement to keep programs aligned with the operating model, and you contribute to internal operations planning while owning goals within the NA air and energy program portfolio.

You identify and influence cross-functional investments that solve long-term air and energy compliance requirements, negotiating resources, priorities, and timelines across organizations. You build business cases with quantified risk and return, present them to director and vice-president audiences, and represent EAP in cross-functional planning forums so that air and energy compliance requirements are built into business decisions. You own the program governance, business reviews, escalation paths, and metric dashboards that surface risk and drive accountability in real time, and you stand in for the senior manager independently in business reviews and cross-functional forums with full ownership.

This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to find a path forward where solutions are not predefined, driving cross-functional alignment without pushing decisions upward. You communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and you use data and business intelligence to look around corners, spotting and mitigating risk before it surfaces. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the compliance vision into functional programs. Integrate them into annual and multi-year planning and shape the budgets that fund them, weighing near-term compliance needs against long-term infrastructure investment.
- Work independently in an ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, finding paths forward where no solution is predefined and driving alignment without pushing decisions upward.
- Own compliance programs end to end, taking problem definitions through pilot to full rollout, and build the resulting standards into daily operations so field teams sustain them on their own.
- Build the metrics and review system that holds the program accountable, covering KPIs, business reviews, escalation paths, and dashboards that give leaders real-time visibility into performance, milestones, and regulatory standing.
- Report program status, risks, and escalations clearly to director and vice-president audiences across operations, legal, finance, and technology, and stand in for the senior manager in business reviews and cross-functional forums.
- Oversee third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding them to program milestones and quality standards through structured audits.
- Travel up to 25 to 50% of the time.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Master's degree in environmental engineering, chemical engineering, atmospheric or air quality science, energy systems, or a related field
- Experience developing and implementing air and energy compliance programs, for example Title V and minor source air permitting, greenhouse gas reporting, emissions inventories, refrigerant management, and energy or utility compliance, in accordance with applicable laws
- Professional credential where applicable, for example a Professional Engineer (PE), a Qualified Environmental Professional (QEP), a Certified Energy Manager (CEM), or an equivalent professional environmental certification
- Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 management system design, implementation, or certification

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.

- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.

Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience

title: Software Development Engineer II, Digital Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Digital Acceleration is the commerce engine for Amazon's digital businesses, built on a simple premise: build for one, available to all. With over 20 years of proven capabilities and more than 10 billion digital transactions processed in the past year, we power purchases and subscriptions across Prime, Prime Video, Audible, Kindle, Music, Alexa+, Luna, and 40+ other businesses. Now we are transforming these capabilities into a shared, AI-native commerce foundation, providing ordering, transactions, and fulfillment through a unified model, shared gateways, and common client experiences.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and launch AI-native features that digital product lines can adopt out of the box, without custom integration work. You will write production-ready Java code on AWS, collaborate with Technical Program Managers and Product Managers, and contribute across the full software development lifecycle. If you are a curious engineer who wants to help build the standardized commerce layer behind some of Amazon's most recognized products, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, and deploy AI-native feature standardizations in Java on AWS that digital clients across Amazon can adopt with zero custom integration.
- Integrate AI models and AI knowledge bases into commerce workflows, staying current with new technologies to improve productivity and code quality.
- Write logical, well-organized, and maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms, making thoughtful trade-offs between performance and readability.
- Collaborate with Technical Program Managers, Product Managers, and peer engineers on scoping, code reviews, and operational support to ship high-quality software.
- Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and contribute to improving system reliability across the ordering platform.

Your day starts with a team standup where you align on priorities with your Manager, Technical Program Manager, and fellow engineers. From there you dive into coding, building features, writing tests, and refining your implementations based on code review feedback. You might pair with a teammate to debug a tricky ordering flow or prototype a new AI-driven capability that dozens of digital product lines will use. You also participate in operational reviews, learning how your services perform at scale and spotting opportunities to make them better.


About the team
Amazon Digital Acceleration powers ordering, subscriptions, and device management for Prime, Amazon Video, Music, Audible, Alexa, and Kindle, amongst other digital businesses. We process billions of digital purchases every year and enable our digital businesses to grow their businesses worldwide. We are on a mission to be earth's best provider of one-time and recurring digital commerce, delivering a seamless and enjoyable post-purchase customer experience.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you have a background in electrical power systems and working with operations or program management teams? Are you excited to work on the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure? In this role, you will own a global program to design and build power infrastructure that meets the highest bar for reliability and robustness, including reporting on reliability metrics across AWS’s global footprint.

You will engage with electric utilities across AWS’s global footprint to specify and contribute to the design of reliable transmission and distribution power infrastructure. You will manage multiple projects and evaluate the impacts of design considerations in medium and high voltage electric systems on existing and future data center operations.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong electrical engineering background, coupled with experience in data center program management. They will have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the skill-set to successfully lead complex projects with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships, and managing the day-to-day interactions with these partners, this candidate will be responsible for ensuring the critical electrical infrastructure that serves AWS meets the highest standard for reliability and availability.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Own program management for the global power reliability program
• Specify requirements for high and medium voltage systems that supply AWS data centers
• Manage technical elements of the interconnection of AWS data centers to the electric grid by working with utilities and local AWS operations and engineering teams across the globe
• Work with engineering teams at utilities and design firms to put forth innovative solutions to meet AWS requirements
• Support the development and execution of a comprehensive energy and utilities strategy for AWS data centers
• Drive process improvement to streamline execution of strategic initiatives and technology solutions
• Lead the development of metrics to ensure the most impactful delivery goals are formulated to meet program goals, including defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive high impact business decisions and reporting to senior leadership.
• Establish cadence to review overall program performance with internal and external stakeholders

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 3+ years of experience designing high and/or medium voltage power systems

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in a related field
- Experience solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries
- Experience using data to drive root cause elimination and process improvement
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience evaluating power system reliability and resilience
- Experience with data center electrical infrastructure
- Experience diving deep into data, existing processes, people, and systems to simplify complex processes

title: Supply Chain Manager II, Global Engineering Materials and Sustainability (GEMS)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Engineering Services (GES) is seeking a results-driven and customer-obsessed Supply Chain Manager to support and improve the ordering function for new build infrastructure and expansion/retrofit projects within our Global Engineering Materials and Sustainability (GEMS) Organization. This individual will contribute to the vision for ordering operations by executing and refining scalable processes, identifying opportunities to leverage AI and automation for efficiency gains, and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver outcomes across a portfolio of 450+ projects valued at $5B+.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working in ambiguous environments, can identify and solve problems with guidance from leadership, and drives meaningful improvements within their area of ownership. The ideal candidate will balance tactical execution with developing strategic thinking, operating as both a process improver and a reliable partner to stakeholders.

This is an office-based role requiring regular presence at a corporate location, with up to 10% nationwide travel as needed. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Process Ownership & Execution
- Own and execute key components of the ordering function's roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve cycle times, reduce defects, and increase quality within assigned workstreams.
- Implement and refine scalable processes, standard operating procedures, and mechanisms that support the team's ability to manage growth effectively.
- Identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and tooling improvements to reduce manual effort and improve workflow efficiency within defined scope areas.

- Contribute to executive-level communication including Monthly Business Reviews by preparing data, insights, and supporting materials that inform leadership decisions.
- Work with technical teams to define requirements for system enhancements and tool improvements that support the ordering process.
Operational Excellence & Team Contribution
- Support the establishment and maintenance of service level agreements (SLAs) with internal customers, helping to monitor performance and escalate issues as needed.
- Contribute to training programs and knowledge management efforts that enable effective onboarding and reduce key-person dependencies.
- Participate in continuous improvement efforts by contributing to feedback loops, retrospectives, and mechanisms that capture learnings and share best practices across the team.

About the team
The NA Supply Chain team empowers Startup Project Managers by delivering ordering excellence with agility, accuracy, and quality. We ensure timely inventory flow, seamless supplier payment execution, and rapid issue resolution through standardized processes that adapt to customer needs with speed and flexibility. Our commitment to attention to detail and exceptional service enables projects to launch on schedule and within budget, building trust and lasting value for our customers.

GREF is responsible for Amazon’s corporate office portfolio, creating the spaces that inspire Amazonians to make history. The globally diverse team manages Amazon’s corporate offices in more than 60 countries. GREF provides real estate transactions expertise, business partnering, space and occupancy planning, design and construction, capital investment program management, facility maintenance, and operations all contributing to the employee experience and leveraging places and programs to enable culture to thrive at Amazon. title: Senior Technical Customer Solution Manager, India CSM Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

At AWS, we are leading the cloud revolution in India. As a Senior Technical Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in India, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration and modernization outcomes for the customer in relation to AWS Cloud.


Key job responsibilities
You will be a trusted advisor to your customer. You will leverage your program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand your customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.

You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Technical Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.

Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration across the customer organization. You will use the AWS Transformation Guide and other mechanisms, to inform the customer migration journey.

#aws-ags-india

A day in the life
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, IT services, quality assurance
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in trade compliance, import/export operations, customs regulations, cross-border logistics, or regulatory compliance processes related to global trade operations is preferred
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

title: SLAM / Computer Vision Intern, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
Embark on an exciting journey at Amazon as a Specialised Software Development Engineer! Join our cutting-edge teams working on innovative technologies that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Shape the future of autonomous systems at Amazon! Join elite teams developing cutting-edge robotics and computer vision solutions that power Prime Air drones and revolutionize warehouse automation. Work on groundbreaking projects that combine advanced perception, machine learning, and simulation to create the next generation of autonomous technologies.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and scientists to build and deploy state-of-the-art systems that push the boundaries of what's possible in robotics and computer vision. Your work will directly impact millions of customers and transform industries on a global scale
Applicants will be reviewed on a rolling basis and are matched to teams aligned with their experience plus location and availability preferences prior to interviews. Applicants will remain under consideration until we have assessed all potential team matches or finished recruiting.


Key job responsibilities
Job Description
As a SLAM Intern, you will join our team to advance the localization and mapping capabilities of our last-mile delivery robot. Your work will directly shape how our robot perceives and navigates complex urban environments from benchmarking existing approaches to prototyping novel algorithms and validating them on hardware. This role offers hands-on experience in spatial perception, algorithm development, and real-world deployment within a dynamic and collaborative environment. We are committed to finding and nurturing exceptional talent; our internships are a key pathway to recruiting outstanding graduates who can make a significant impact in our team.

Important Notice: For this position, we are only able to accept applications from citizens of Schengen Area countries. This restriction does not apply to ETHZ and EPFL students who are required to complete compulsory internships as part of their studies.
What you'll be doing
Work closely with senior engineers to integrate SLAM modules with hardware components and contribute ideas to enhance system robustness and accuracy.
Support the team in benchmarking, evaluating, and developing novel state-of-the-art localization and mapping algorithms for robotic applications.
Engage in continuous learning and gain exposure to recent developments from the SLAM and computer vision literature.


A day in the life
As a Specialised Software Development Engineer, you'll immerse yourself in challenging projects that push the boundaries of technology.
Your day might involve fine-tuning perception algorithms for drone navigation, developing simulation scenarios to test edge cases in warehouse robotics, or collaborating with and learning from hardware engineers to optimize software for new sensor configurations.

title: Supply Chain Specialist, GPCS, GPCS
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Business Area: Operations – Procurement
We make sure Amazon gets value for money every time it buys non-inventory goods and services for its Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and corporate business. It’s a fast-paced operation that supports growth and change, works with every department and is driven by Key Performance Indicators – and there’s plenty of healthy competition. We work individually and as part of teams, meeting regularly to cement our relationships and approach.

The Global Procurement Central Services AMER (GPCS AMER), reporting into the Global Procurement Organization (GPO), ensures that Amazon gets value for money for non-inventory goods to provide the Fulfillment Centers with the necessary shipping supplies they need to operate smoothly. The team has two divisions: North America (NA) and Costa Rica (CR). As a supply chain specialist, you will provide functional support to a group of Fulfillment Centers (FCs) for all aspects of procurement. The number of FCs within a group will depend on FC size and other relevant parameters. This includes securing the constant flow of packaging goods and services, supplied at the best overall value to the business on a day to day basis, Blanket Purchase Order management, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) bridging ownership, Accounts Payable invoice hold resolution, site launch support, and escalation management. SPOC currently provides these services for ~1200 sites across 14 countries.

GPCS AMER is a 24/7 team (shifts both days and nights) supporting Operations & the Field Procurement team and follows Amazon Corporate guidance for working in our office in Tempe, Arizona. Based on business need, our Specialists are slotted into different shifts. You may be required to work Days or Weekends. You must be open to any shift.


Key job responsibilities
· In partnership with the Supply Chain Leadership, provide support for the fulfillment centers, including: forecasting of non-inventory products, inventory management, non-inventory flow and space models, cycle counts, procurement transaction and expediting support
· Develop deep knowledge of non-inventory items and align with like buildings to drive best practices
· Ensure best practices are being shared and implemented
· Work in partnership both internally and with suppliers to develop innovative solutions to provide Supply Chain support to the Operations network
· Coordinate the demand identification, procurement, and inventory management of all non-merchandise items required for building operation. This includes corrugate, packing materials, labor and janitorial services, etc.
. Partner with Accounts Payable, Suppliers and various internal teams to ensure timely resolution of vendor payment issues

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Experience with MS Office, in particular MS Excel

title: Design Engineer, North America AMZL Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon operates a world-class network of delivery stations across the globe. The LastMile organization is responsible for the acquisition, design, construction, and management of all facilities in the Amazon Delivery Station Network. We are looking for a Design Engineer to join our North America LastMile Design Team who will support the expansion of Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Delivery Station Network in North America (NA). In this role, the Design Engineer will drive delivery station process, building design, and standardization across our Last Mile delivery network. As a member of the NA LastMile Design team, the individual will be responsible for designing and optimizing the delivery and sortation network, enabling operations processes to meet safety, customer experience, quality, and cost goals that span delivery stations, outside traffic flow and on-road operations.

Key job responsibilities
Responsible for building design, development, review, and release for approval of new delivery station layouts and capacity improvements to existing stations. Provide engineering design expertise including material flow, labor placement, conveyors, equipment, operations modules, packaging profiles, and physical building and site layout components. Achieve the daily and weekly plan set in front of the Design Engineers, and lead new expansion and retrofit initiatives at the project level to improve associate and driver safety, quality, productivity, and station capacity. Implement new design standards in collaboration with Worldwide Design, Safety, Process Engineering, Material Handling Equipment, and Launch, and support the design quality control process that strives for accurate, zero-defect designs. Contribute to a network culture of standardization by sharing best practices with European (EU) and Worldwide (WW) counterparts and incorporating the most up-to-date design practices. Collaborate with Design Managers, CAD drafters, Real Estate Transaction Managers, Worldwide Engineering (WWEI), Pre-Construction and its architects, material handling equipment suppliers, Launch and Start-Up teams, Finance, and Volume and Capacity Planning teams. Facilitate cross-functional, project-specific design reviews, and implement solutions for recurring process issues along with mechanisms to increase the scale, speed, and quality of designs within the team.

** Travel up to 25% to support complex designs with quick, simple, and standard solutions.

A day in the life
A typical day involves critical problem solving for the optimization of stations layouts. You'll analyze high-level demand projections to inform design decisions, ensuring future scalability. Collaborating with operations teams, you'll translate workflow needs into practical designs. Expect to juggle multiple projects, participating in design review meetings and coordinating with architects and civil engineering on detail drawings. You'll troubleshoot design challenges, conduct capacity analyses, and stay updated on industry innovations. The role demands a balance of analytical thinking, creative problem-solving, technical expertise, and effective communication to meet operational goals and deadlines.

About the team
The Last Mile Design Engineering team raises the ceiling of logistics innovation. We're a dynamic group of creative problem-solvers dedicated to optimizing Amazon's delivery network. Our diverse team combines expertise in industrial engineering, operations research, and CAD design to create robust solutions for our rapidly expanding last-mile operations. We thrive on challenges, collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, and take pride in seeing our designs come to life in Amazon's delivery stations worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Knowledge of automated material handling systems, packaging technologies and storage solutions
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Civil Engineering or other related discipline

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- Knowledge of AutoCAD at the intermediate level
- Experience in the real estate and construction process, including architecture, civil, structural engineering or construction as relates to the development of manufacturing facilities

descriptionHtml:
When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Every day, Amazon delivers millions of packages to customers around the world with clock-like precision. Behind every successful delivery, billions of decisions are made by systems and by people in real time. Is the customer's address accurate? Can we pinpoint it on a map? Is an unattended delivery safe? Is there an access code for the building? What are the business hours if it's a commercial address? Excellent communication skills and executive presence to get in front of VPs and SVPs across Amazon will be imperative.

Fiumicino - 38,900€ lordi annui.

Interventi di manutenzione preventiva e a guasto su un’ampia gamma di macchinari in sede.

Utilizzo di strumenti all’avanguardia per massimizzare l’efficacia dei macchinari.

Conformità a tutte le normative e prassi in materia di salute e sicurezza.

Favorire lo sviluppo e l’avanzamento di chi partecipa ai programmi di apprendistato nelle nostre sedi.

Sovraintendere a progetti di miglioramento continuo e implementare procedure chiave in una gamma di sedi europee.

I nostri RME Technician operano sul campo, in modo da intervenire prontamente nell’eventualità di problemi ai macchinari. La nostra forza è focalizzarci sul pensiero creativo e sul miglioraci continuamente per assicurare che milioni di prodotti arrivino nelle mani dei nostri consumatori. title: Head of Expansion and Deployment, Amazon Prime Air Europe
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization.

How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Own the European site infrastructure and launch program: the site pipeline, the launch forecast, and delivery of every site from test fit to launch readiness

Own the master programme schedule across the European site pipeline, integrating design, build and launch milestones for every site

Set targets for time-to-launch and cost per site, and drive them down site by site through standardisation, parallel workstreams and better mechanisms

Lead, develop and grow a team of Expansion Program Managers working across the UK and the EU

Own engagement with host sites, and hold Prime Air’s senior relationships with regional operations leadership and with Amazon GES, Amazon’s in-house engineering and construction organisation, agreeing the approach, priorities and capacity for each site and across the network

Build and run the site prioritisation framework with the Head of Commercial Operations, weighing return, cost, time to launch and readiness, and use it to decide which candidate sites to launch and in what sequence

Own the business case and capital request for each site, working with Finance, host business lines and the Head of Commercial Operations, with the Expansion Program Managers providing the design, cost and schedule inputs, and present the investment decision to leadership

Be accountable for cost, scope and schedule across all sites, within the budget for Prime Air-specific site technology and infrastructure

Own the infrastructure inputs to annual and multi-year planning, including the launch gearing model, capital and operating budget, and headcount case

Own the European Prime Air site design standard and the test-fit and launch playbooks, and adapt them to each country’s building, planning and safety requirements

Chair launch readiness reviews and take the launch go/no-go decision for every site, and run the program mechanisms that give leadership visibility of the launch plan: risk and change control, and regular reporting, integrated with the regulatory, operations, engineering and safety plans

A day in the life

Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!

Amazon Prime Air is seeking an experienced infrastructure and launch leader to roll out our drone delivery sites across Europe, and to make each launch faster than the last. You will be Prime Air’s senior partner to host site leaders and to Amazon’s regional operations and engineering and construction leadership, and you will build the standards, playbooks and mechanisms that let us launch multiple sites a year across several countries. title: Tier 2 Technical Care Associate (Spanish speaker), Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

At Amazon Leo, our Technical Care Associates (TCA) deliver timely, accurate, and professional general and technical support to all Amazon Leo customers. The Amazon Leo Customer Support (CS) team is looking for driven individuals who are up to the challenge of solving customer issues while providing positive customer experience. TCA are technically savvy problem-solvers with a focus on customer account security. An ideal candidate would be an excellent listener, handle change easily, be a quick learner and critical thinker, and be able to handle ambiguity. The position requires the ability to communicate professionally, with maturity and self-confidence, in Spanish and English.

Shifts are assigned on a rotational basis and may include early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends and public holidays. You will be required to work all shift patterns.

This position may require access to export-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations

Key job responsibilities
• Receive and manage customer escalations from Tier 1 support, delivering timely and effective resolutions across phone, email, and chat channels.
• Offer detailed technical support with clear and professional communication
• Collaborate with other customer support teams to resolve complex issues
• Document steps and resolutions in a clear, easy-to-follow format
• Identify trends in customer issues and propose improvements to support processes
• Help create knowledge base articles and team documentation
• Stay current on new Amazon Leo products and features


A day in the life

title: Health and Safety Auditor, AWS Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
For more than 14 years, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform. What is cloud computing? Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the Internet. Instead of buying, owning, and maintaining physical data centers and servers, companies can access technology services, such as computing power, storage, and databases, on an as-needed basis from AWS. AWS offers over 175 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, mobile, security, hybrid, virtual and augmented reality, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 77 Availability Zones across 24 geographic regions. AWS services are trusted by millions of active customers around the world - including the fastest-growing start-ups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—to power their infrastructure, make them more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com.

The AWS EHS team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. The EHS team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS’s global environmental and safety programs. This includes defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems and driving their continuous improvement; setting and refining global policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics, and employee training; ensuring effective engagement by environmental and health & safety teams on global initiatives, including those that are part of Amazon’s ambitious sustainability goals; providing specialist expertise; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and effective environmental and health & safety compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring employee safety and compliance with environmental and health & safety regulations.

We are looking for a Health and Safety (H&S) Auditor who will be responsible for driving a systematic approach to delivering high-level, programmatic requirements of the AWS Safety Management Program (SMP), with a focus on defining the program structures, ownership, auditing mechanisms, policies and procedures necessary to formally measure, evaluate and improve individual and organizational H&S performance. The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated individual with a solid knowledge foundation in safety management systems, local and regional safety standards, and a proven track record of designing & improving safety programs & policies. They will have a history of building partnerships with diverse teams across multiple jurisdictions. The candidate must have the ability to define clear requirements in ambiguity, proactively educate team members, leaders, and other support teams, and communicate effectively and consistently throughout all levels of the business. The role will evolve with the maturity and growth of the SMP and requires a high degree of flexibility, including the ability to deep dive time critical programs, manage compliance assurance, and deliver continuous improvement actions.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities
- Plan and conduct audits of the SMP including on-site verification and remote assessments
- Develop programs, standards, tools, or best practice documentation reflective of regulatory requirements and current-state operations
- Support SMP initiatives and programs, including the initial communication and implementation of SMP
- Act as the subject matter expertise for SMP related questions
- Partner with local operational staff in communication, training, and execution of the SMP
- Provide timely communications to data center (DC) Operations leadership when needed
- Provide SMP program-level training and coaching to local operational staff to ensure technical competence across the region
- Follow up to ensure that corrective actions are implemented where necessary
- Act as a resource to field operations on regulatory compliance documentation to ensure accurate and up to date adherence to SMP requirements
- Implement and oversee SMP related performance metric reporting and communication
- Partner with DC support functions such as DC H&S, Legal, Engineering, Human Resources, Procurement, etc. to continuously capture opportunities for improvement, and facilitate the implementation of these improvements
- Act as a subject matter expert in safety and health standards, possess excellent safety program management skills, and be an effective communicator capable of sending clear, concise, and consistent messages both verbally and in writing.
- Travel estimated at 20-40%.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- Experience handling confidential information

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL and Excel

title: Supply Chain Category Principal - Packaging, Global Packaging Category
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Packaging Organization is seeking a Supply Chain Category Principal to architect the supply chain strategy for our global packaging program. This role sets the technical bar for how we source, convert, and deliver packaging worldwide.

As the Supply Chain Category Principal, you will be the decision-maker on end-to-end supply chain process design, the authority on cross-pillar standards, and the architect of the systems and frameworks that every packaging category adopts. You will go deep into global supply chains, from raw material sourcing across multiple continents to converting partnerships and distribution logistics, and pull them into a single, integrated program. You will make definitive calls on process standards, supplier strategy frameworks, and technology adoption, and you will be accountable for delivering measurable commercial outcomes. This role combines deep supply chain expertise, cross-functional leadership, and AI-driven transformation to fundamentally change how packaging procurement operates at scale.

Key job responsibilities
* Set the technical bar for end-to-end supply chain process design across all packaging categories, establishing the standards, playbooks, and governance frameworks that pillar teams are required to adopt and execute

* Make definitive decisions on cross-pillar supply chain strategy, including supplier tiering frameworks, sourcing methodologies, risk management protocols, and contract management standards

* Architect the integrated global supply chain program that connects raw material sourcing, converting, manufacturing, and distribution logistics across all packaging types into a single cohesive model

* Build multi-tier supplier visibility across the global value chain, setting the strategic direction for supplier partnerships while pillar leads execute within their categories

* Define and drive the AI and automation roadmap for the packaging supply chain, deciding which tools, systems, and workflows are adopted to make operations scalable without proportional headcount growth

* Identify and deliver cross-pillar commercial synergies through cost optimization, risk reduction, and supplier consolidation initiatives

* Enable supply chain readiness for new packaging type introductions by ensuring the frameworks, supplier qualification processes, and systems are built and validated ahead of launch

* Chair cross-pillar governance forums, making binding decisions on process standards, resolving escalations between pillars, and holding teams accountable to the unified operating model

A day in the life
Your morning starts by reviewing AI-generated risk alerts across the global supplier base and making calls on which require immediate intervention vs. pillar-level response. By mid-morning, you're chairing a cross-pillar governance forum where you're making a binding decision on a new sourcing methodology that all categories will adopt. After lunch, you're deep in a supplier strategy review, assessing multi-tier risks across regions and setting direction for how pillar leads should approach an upcoming raw material market shift. Later, you're presenting your AI/automation roadmap to senior leadership, defending your prioritization and making the case for investment. You end the day working with a pillar lead to validate supply chain readiness for a new packaging type launch. The mix is strategic decision-making, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership at a global scale.

About the team
The Global Packaging Organization manages billions in annual spend across all packaging categories worldwide. The team includes category managers and leaders organized into packaging pillars (corrugated, flexible, protective, sustainable, and more), each with their own pillar lead. This Principal role sits across all pillars as the strategic architect and process authority, reporting into senior leadership. We are in a transformation phase, moving from siloed category management to an integrated, AI-enabled supply chain model, and this role is the catalyst for that shift.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 7+ years of working cross functionally across several teams experience
- 10+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:

As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
